links.title: Thinking at the Right Size: Amortized Distillation Across Post-Trained LLMs

evidence: Abstract: ADAPT produces L×K models across L interpolated sizes and K post-trained variants from a single distillation run via two-phase distillation and weight-delta initialization
Section 4.1: teacher Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, student initialized at 2.7B parameters, 1B token budget, deduplicated Pile for pre-training and Nemotron math split for SFT

Section 4.2: five setups compared under equal training budget on three ID math tasks and two OOD tasks; ADAPT (distilled) achieves strongest interpolation, BD variants and cross-patch collapse at small/medium sizes

Section 4.3 and Appendix G Table 5: weight-delta transfer reliability correlates with delta cosine similarity (0.73-0.75 for instruct/hybrid, 0.57-0.64 for thinking, 0.30 for Llama); authors note analysis is correlational

Section 4.4 and Appendix I.1: adaptive model-size selection on MATH traces a Pareto frontier using teacher-predicted difficulty (teacher MAE 0.970 vs student 1.995); cost of difficulty classification excluded from results
Appendix H: ADAPT outperforms ShortGPT and LLM-Streamline layer pruning baselines on generation tasks at all sizes

Limitations: interpolation dips at specific sizes are unexplained, weight-delta is not uniformly reliable on Olmo/Llama OOD settings, scope limited to 4B-14B with math/coding SFT data, and base checkpoints must be available
Appendix A/B and Reproducibility Statement: full hyperparameter tables, GPU-hour estimates (e.g., 12h on 4 H100 for 4B runs), code at github.com/dcml-lab/ADAPT, models to be released under Apache 2.0
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on amortizing knowledge distillation across model size and post-training variant axes, squarely matching LLM, training/optimization, and efficiency preferences. The contribution is a sensible combination of boomerang distillation with task-vector-style weight arithmetic (two-phase distillation + weight-delta initialization) rather than a fundamentally new technique, but it is executed thoroughly: five compute-matched baselines, extensive ablations (phase ratios, loss components, single-phase deltas, continued training), three model families, layer-pruning comparisons, and an adaptive size-selection demonstration. The mechanism analysis (delta cosine similarity, smooth interpolation) is correlational and acknowledged as preliminary. Key caveats: weight-delta transfer is not uniformly reliable across families (fails on Llama), results are limited to 4B-14B scale, and the method requires access to base checkpoints. Strong reproducibility via code/model release and detailed hyperparameters.

primary_link.title: Thinking at the Right Size: Amortized Distillation Across Post-Trained LLMs

papers.summary: Practical deployment of large language models (LLMs) requires families of post-trained variants---instruction-tuned, reasoning-tuned, and chat-style models---each at multiple sizes to meet diverse latency and memory budgets. Producing each (variant, size) pair independently is prohibitive, so model families typically span only a handful of coarse-grained sizes per post-trained variant. Boomerang distillation (Kangaslahti et al., 2026) reduces this cost along the size axis for base models. Throug
papers.summary_zh: 實務部署需要涵蓋多種規模與後訓練變體（指令微調、推理微調、聊天風格）的模型家族，逐一訓練成本高昂。本文提出 ADAPT 框架，將蒸餾沿「規模」與「後訓練變體」兩軸攤提：單次蒸餾即可為 L 個內插規模與 K 個變體產生 L×K 個模型。方法包含兩部分：兩階段蒸餾先以預訓練資料對齊、再以 SFT 蒸餾恢復指令遵循與推理能力，實現平滑的規模—效能內插；權重差值初始化則將基礎模型蒸餾所得的權重變化量，加到以不同後訓練變體初始化的學生上，免去額外蒸餾成本。實驗以 Qwen3、Olmo、Llama 家族驗證，ADAPT 在數學推理與指令遵循基準上明顯優於直接套用 boomerang 蒸餾與層剪枝方法；內插模型的連續譜亦支援依輸入難度自適應選擇模型規模，畫出優於任何單一模型的計算—準確率 Pareto 前沿。機制分析顯示基礎與後訓練模型間的平滑線性權重內插在蒸餾後仍保留，解釋了權重算術遷移的成功，並與線性模式連通性相關。限制包括權重差值遷移在不同模型家族（如 Llama）間可靠度不一，且需能存取對應的基礎模型檢查點，更大規模與更廣資料混合尚待驗證。
papers.title: Thinking at the Right Size: Amortized Distillation Across Post-Trained LLMs

links.title: Pipeline-Native Transformers: Co-Designing Model Architecture and CPU Inference for Bandwidth-Efficient Autoregressive Decode

evidence: Abstract & Table 1.1: arch2_4_combined achieves 2.00x critical-path bandwidth reduction (9.00 to 4.50 MB/token) within 0.24 perplexity of the best candidate; tile layout yields 7.29x fewer L1-d read misses; cflow decodes 5.94 tok/s vs llama.cpp 4.75 and vLLM 1.65 on a 32-vCPU Ice Lake server.

Sections 5.8/5.12 (Table 5.3): Claim 6 (PREFETCHT0) refuted at both 64 MB and 4.7 GB scales (PF=1 ~4% worse at 4.7 GB direct I/O) and Claim 8 (stage-major layout) inconclusive due to SSD cache-state confound; six of eight claims reported as proven.

Section 5.13.3 (Table 5.5) and Section 6.4: the author explicitly states the cflow-vs-baselines comparison is 'not model-matched' and an 'engine-plus-architecture' result; the clean model-matched row is llama.cpp 2.9x faster than vLLM CPU on the same dense Qwen2.5-32B.

Section 5.4.2 (Table 5.2): PMU L1-d miss reduction 7.29x for dense-down (2.64M vs 19.3M) at 8.34B geometry on Xeon E5-2650, but raw counts were recorded only for dense-down; remaining rows log ratio alone (6.72-6.88x).

Section 5.14.3 (Table 5.6): expert-delay overlap A/B on EC2 r6id.8xlarge NVMe tier measures net win up to 1.68x at T=4 threads with the (C+IO)/max(C,IO_eff) model matching all four points within 1%; bit-identical greedy output across all 24 cells.

Sections 4.3/5.2.2/6.4: five architectures trained on TinyStories for 10K steps at d=512, L=6 (test ppl 6.26-7.24), seed ablations at seeds 7 and 13; limitations state single-token decode only, x86-64 only, and Section 5.2.3 notes no undelayed control was trained at the 8.34B scale.

Section 7.1 (Contribution 4): codebase, benchmark scripts, reference traces, and training logs are claimed committed alongside the code and 116 unit + 8 integration tests pass, but no public repository URL or artifact link appears in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Solid LLM systems/efficiency work squarely on-topic for the LLM, Transformer Architecture, Scaling & Efficiency, and Inference & Serving preferences (CPU-first inference, MoE, quantization, KV cache), though it does not touch the other high-weight preference areas (agents, reasoning, Japanese, alignment). Novelty is genuine: rewriting the transformer inter-layer dependency DAG (dense_delay/expert_delay, CombineStyle variants) to make vertical stage-major scheduling mathematically valid is claimed without precedent, and the closest prior work cited (GPT-J/PaLM parallel blocks, HW-NAS, FlexGen) does not do this. Rigor is above average for an independent report: an eight-claim scorecard with two negative results reported with mechanistic explanations (Claim 6 refuted, Claim 8 inconclusive), PMU counter measurements, Rust-PyTorch parity tests (124 tests), and seed ablations. Evidence strength is limited by the headline 2.00x bandwidth figure being analytic rather than a wall-clock measurement at the trained geometry, PMU raw counts logged for only one workload (Table 5.2), and the 5.94 tok/s vs llama.cpp comparison being explicitly cross-architecture (30.9B MoE vs dense Qwen2.5-32B), which the author himself flags as not quality-controlled. Generalizability is bounded: single-token decode only, x86-64 only, TinyStories proof-of-concept training, no undelayed control at 8.34B, and the co-design requires retraining rather than retrofitting. Reproducibility claims (code, traces, logs committed) are detailed but no public repository URL is verifiable from the document.

primary_link.title: Pipeline-Native Transformers: Co-Designing Model Architecture and CPU Inference for Bandwidth-Efficient Autoregressive Decode

papers.summary: Single-token autoregressive decode on CPUs is bound by memory bandwidth, not arithmetic: a modern CPU sustains roughly 1 TFLOP/s of compute but only about 50 GB/s from main memory, and each generated token must stream every active weight once. This report argues that the most effective response is to co-design the model architecture and the inference runtime together. It presents cflow, a CPU-first streaming engine, alongside a family of pipeline-native transformer architectures whose inter-laye
papers.summary_zh: CPU 上的單 token 自迴歸解碼受記憶體頻寬而非算術限制：其算術強度約 4 FLOP/byte，遠低於現代 CPU 約 20 FLOP/byte 的機器平衡點。本文主張模型架構與推論執行期必須協同設計，提出 cflow——CPU 優先的串流引擎——與管線原生 Transformer 架構家族。執行期將權重切為 L2 快取大小的瓦片並按計算消費順序存放、只讀取 MoE 層的 top-k 專家、融合投影，並執行延遲感知排程；架構則透過 dense_delay 與 expert_delay 重寫層間依賴圖，使垂直階段式執行在數學上成立。五個候選架構在 TinyStories 上穩定收斂，其中 arch2_4_combined 在僅差 0.24 困惑度的情況下達成 2.00 倍關鍵路徑頻寬削減（9.00→4.50 MB/token），瓦片版面減少 7.29 倍 L1 快取未命中。在 30.9B 參數 MoE 上，cflow 以 5.94 tok/s 領先 llama.cpp（4.75）與 vLLM CPU 後端（1.65）；專家延遲視窗的非同步 I/O 重疊於 NVMe 層實測最高 1.68 倍淨增益。報告誠實記錄兩項未成立的主張：PREFETCHT0 在 I/O 瓶頸下無益，階段式磁碟版面效果未定，並完整說明其成立條件。
papers.title: Pipeline-Native Transformers: Co-Designing Model Architecture and CPU Inference for Bandwidth-Efficient Autoregressive Decode
papers.title_zh: 管線原生 Transformer：協同設計模型架構與 CPU 推論，實現頻寬高效的自迴歸解碼

links.title: TailSieve: Partial-Rollout-Guided Tail Routing for LLM Rollouts

evidence: Abstract: claims up to 1.67x routing-only speedup and 2.59x with MTP/DFlash, preserving on-policy generation

Section 4.2 Table 1: TailSieve beats Uniform/Uniform-Oracle/StreamRL-style/Seer-style baselines on five Qwen models across DeepScaleR and KodCode-10K, with oracle-style baselines assuming known realized lengths
Section 4.5 Table 3: downstream GSM8K/MATH-500/AIME24/25 accuracy of TailSieve checkpoints broadly comparable to uniform-routing baseline after 30-step GRPO
Appendix A.4: per-group best-k isolation within 4% of exact DP optimum for all 100 rollout groups, within 1% for 72%
Appendix B: cross-checkpoint tail-ranking AUC 0.952-0.985 and prompt identity explains 64.8% of response-length variance, supporting the cross-round tail signal
Section 4.4: inner and outer controller converge to q=4 and m=2 from both minimum and maximum initializations
Appendices A.1-A.3: full hardware (8x H100), vLLM backend and PR reference, sampling table, prompt templates, GRPO optimizer settings, and random seed documented; no explicit code/artifact release
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-systems work: tail routing and replica allocation for synchronous LLM rollouts in RL post-training (GRPO), combined with route-specialized speculative decoding (MTP/DFlash) on five Qwen configurations. Strong preference fit to LLM efficiency, RL training, and reasoning-prompt workloads (DeepScaleR math, KodCode coding). Novelty is solid rather than exceptional: tail-aware scheduling, partial rollout, and length-aware dispatch exist (RollPacker, StreamRL, Seer, APRIL); the distinguishing contributions are the training-free cutoff-status tail signal with full regeneration to preserve on-policy-ness, the joint (q,m) hierarchical controller, and a formal no-length-bias analysis (Appendix E). Rigor is good: exact DP oracle with Pareto pruning, top-k within 4% of optimum over 100 groups (A.4), controller convergence study (4.4), fixed-allocation ablation, concurrency scaling (Table 4), and downstream accuracy checks (Table 3). Evidence is credible but has caveats: key baselines are oracle-style simulations assuming known lengths rather than running StreamRL/Seer systems, evaluation is single 8-GPU node, end-to-end RL is only 30 steps, and some gains are modest (e.g., 1.10-1.21x on several model/workload cells in Tables 1 and 4). Generalizability is decent within synchronous rollout/sampling-heavy pipelines but depends on tail skew, multi-replica budgets, and partial-rollout infrastructure. Reproducibility is supported by unusually detailed setup appendices (hardware, sampling params, prompt templates, optimizer table, seed) and public datasets, but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: TailSieve: Partial-Rollout-Guided Tail Routing for LLM Rollouts

papers.summary: Large-scale rollouts have become a core component of modern LLM systems, spanning reinforcement learning (RL) post-training, on-policy distillation (OPD), and sampling-heavy evaluation pipelines. Unlike online serving, which is typically optimized for request-level latency and throughput, a small number of long-tail generations can dominate the end-to-end makespan of an entire rollout step. In practice, rollout requests are often routed uniformly across replicas, which can place extremely long g
papers.summary_zh: 大規模 LLM rollout（RL 後訓練、on-policy 蒸餾與抽樣密集評估）的整體完成時間由最慢的長尾生成決定，均勻路由可能將極長生成置於高併發解碼批次中。本文先在完成長度已知的理想情境下刻畫離線最佳解：長尾情境下的 makespan 最佳路由結合「尾部隔離」與「負載平衡」，且簡單的 top-k 政策即可逼近離線最佳值，於 100 個 rollout 群組中與精確最佳值的差距在 4% 以內。TailSieve 據此以部分 rollout 作為免訓練的長尾訊號：截斷時尚未完成的提示群組成為下一輪候選，於低併發尾池重新生成；階層式控制器再依池完成時間、回應工作歷史與實測併發—吞吐量模型，聯合調整隔離量與副本分配。所有被選提示皆依當前政策從頭重新生成，保持 on-policy 生成且不引入額外的路由誘發長度偏差。在五個 Qwen 模型與數學、程式兩類工作負載上，純路由加速最高 1.67 倍，結合 MTP 或 DFlash 投機解碼可達 2.59 倍；端對端 GRPO 實驗顯示加速隨政策演化持續存在，且訓練品質與下游準確率與基準相當。
papers.title: TailSieve: Partial-Rollout-Guided Tail Routing for LLM Rollouts
papers.title_zh: TailSieve：以部分 Rollout 引導的 LLM Rollout 長尾路由

links.title: Agent-G$^2$: Gaussian Guidance for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

evidence: Abstract/Section 1: evaluates on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct; claims 95.3%/98.4% ALFWorld overall success and under one-third rollout cost of per-sample probing.

Section 2 (Figure 3(b)): diagnostic depth sweep with 32 rollouts per (task, depth); aligned Bernoulli-variance informativeness fit by Gaussian (sigma=0.22, R^2=0.92); Table 6 extends fit across training windows (R^2 in [0.89,0.94]).
Table 1/Section 4.2: verified margins — 95.3 vs Enumeration 86.0 (+9.3) and 98.4 vs 96.1 (+2.3) on ALFWorld All; RLVMR margins +7.4/+6.6; BEACON margins +3.9 at both scales.

Section 4.4 (Table 3): ablations on ALFWorld/1.5B — w/o sampling 89.8%, uniform sampling 88.3%, w/o adaptive center 91.4%, w/o adaptive spread 93.8% (Long 94.7->78.3), K=1 89.1%, w/o L_aux 86.7%, w/o L_GRPO 26.6%.
Table 2: median per-step wall-clock 88s (Agent-G2) vs 57-80s scheduled and 285-425s probing baselines (3.24-4.83x), supporting the cost claim.
Table 4 (Appendix A): shared-scheduler mismatch persists across six checkpoints (Fix-step 48.3-75.0%, Tar-acc 32.1-50.0%), not a step-50 artifact.
Table 8 (Appendix B): clustering ablation K=3 95.3±2.3, K=5 96.5±1.9, K=10 86.2, random K=3 89.4 — reveals sensitivity of the method to cluster granularity; main Table 1 lacks per-method variance.

Limitations: method requires one expert trajectory per training task; Gaussian family and offline length-based clustering may not transfer to tasks with multimodal depth profiles or shifting difficulty.

Ethics Statement/Appendix B: code to be released under MIT License upon publication (promise, not verified); implementation on verl, 8x H800, ~10h per 1.5B ALFWorld run; full hyperparameters in Table 5 (Delta=0.1, alpha=0.2, lambda=gamma=1.0, sigma_min=0.1, eta=0.5, K=3).
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope methodological paper on RL training of LLM agents: hint-based guidance depth for GRPO on long-horizon agentic tasks, strongly matching Agents & Tool Use and Reinforcement Learning preferences. Novelty is moderate: recasting depth as a sampled Gaussian is incremental over existing curricula/reverse-curriculum and hint-RL schedulers, though the online estimation from rollouts already collected for policy optimization (no probe rollouts) and the Section 2 band/Gaussian diagnostic are genuine contributions. Rigor is solid: shared-GRPO-backbone baselines isolate the depth-assignment variable, 5-seed averages, component ablations (Table 3), clustering ablation (Table 8), and checkpoint-robustness checks (Table 4/6); but main tables lack variance, 7B results sit near ceiling (many 100% cells), and intro/abstract margin numbers (e.g., '1.5' over strongest hint-based) are inconsistent with Table 1 even though Section 4.2 numbers reconcile. Evidence is self-consistent on inspection (e.g., 95.3 vs Enumeration 86.0 = +9.3; cost 88s vs 285-425s = 3.24-4.83x as claimed in Table 2) but relies on unshown plots for convergence claims. Generalizability is limited by dependence on one expert trajectory per task and offline length-based clustering, as the authors honestly state in Limitations. Reproducibility is high: full hyperparameter table, baseline configs, expert-data provenance, hardware/runtime, and promised MIT-licensed code release (promise only, no verified artifact).

primary_link.title: Agent-G$^2$: Gaussian Guidance for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

papers.summary: Hint-based reinforcement learning addresses reward sparsity in long-horizon agentic tasks by retaining a prefix of an expert trajectory before each rollout, letting the policy explore from a state closer to success. Its effectiveness hinges on the guidance depth: how much of the trajectory to keep. Existing methods treat this depth as a deterministic scalar. Scheduled approaches share one value across samples and ignore per-task heterogeneity; per-sample probing estimates it separately at the co
papers.summary_zh: 提示式強化學習在每次 rollout 前保留專家軌跡前綴，以緩解長程代理任務的獎勵稀疏問題，其成效取決於引導深度的選擇。既有方法將深度視為確定性純量：排程式方法在樣本間共享單一數值而忽略任務異質性；逐樣本探測則需額外 rollout，且在雜訊下仍不準確。本文診斷發現有效引導並非集中在單一最佳點，而是形成資訊量近似高斯的深度帶（σ=0.22，R²=0.92）。據此提出 Agent-G²，從高斯分布為每個任務抽取深度，其中心與散布由已用於政策最佳化的 rollout 線上估計：全域基線追蹤整體進度，各難度群集以成功率均值修正中心、以組內變異數放大散布，無需探測 rollout 或學習深度預測器。在 ALFWorld 與 WebShop 上以 Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct 評估，Agent-G² 於 ALFWorld 達 95.3% 與 98.4% 成功率，超越最強提示式、無提示與輔助 RL 基準 2.3/3.9/7.4 點，成本僅為逐樣本探測的三分之一以下；消融證實高斯抽樣、群集感知中心與自適應散布皆屬必要。限制包括需每任務一條專家軌跡，群集亦以軌跡長度離線劃分，無法隨政策演進調整。
papers.title: Agent-G$^2$: Gaussian Guidance for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: Agent-G²：代理式強化學習的高斯引導

links.title: Language Chain in Alignment: Cross-lingual Ranking Preference Optimization

evidence: Section 4.1: experiments use Llama-2-7B, Llama-3-8B, Mistral-7B across zh/id/ko/sw/bn, with 3,000 UltraFeedback instances translated via 'gpt-5-chat' into fully parallel preference pairs.
Section 4.1: baselines SFT+DPO and CLO use 'identical hyperparameters and the same amount of parallel datasets to ensure a fair comparison'.
Table 1: AlpacaEval LC/WR across five languages; e.g., Llama-3-8B Swahili CRPO WR 62.17 vs SFT+DPO 46.95 and CLO 44.93, while CRPO gains shrink for Llama-2 in Swahili (43.72 vs CLO 43.97).
Table 2: MMMLU/Belebele results are mostly favorable but mixed, e.g., Llama-3-8B Korean MMMLU CLO 40.19 > CRPO 39.84, while Indonesian MMMLU CRPO 45.94 > SFT+DPO 41.69.
Table 4 (Appendix A): gain-value ablations (7,3,1,0), (9,5,7,4), (9,7,5,4) empirically justify the hierarchy, with an acknowledged anomalous Swahili result.
Table 7 (Appendix F): PRO comparison under the same training budget, e.g., Mistral-7B Swahili WR 6.58 vs CRPO 51.98, attributing gains to rank-position-aware weighting rather than ranking per se.
Table 3 (Section 5.3): external Skywork-Reward-V2-Qwen3-8B scoring, e.g., Mistral-7B Indonesian 0.805 (CRPO) vs -0.037 (SFT+DPO).
Appendix B: implementation details (lr 8e-6, 2 epochs, beta 0.1, alpha 0.2, seq len 3072, 4x A100); abstract and Section 1 claim code release at github.com/dltmddbs100/CRPO.

Limitations: authors concede higher training compute from four-candidate ranking and that translated benchmarks 'may not fully capture' cultural/language-specific competence; no variance, seeds, or significance testing is reported anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM alignment work (DPO/preference optimization, multilingual transfer) squarely matching top-weight preferences for Large Language Models and Alignment & RLHF, with supporting matches to Training & Optimization and evaluation benchmarks; not Japanese-specific, which caps relevance slightly below maximum. Novelty is moderate: it adapts the existing LambdaLoss/LiPO listwise-ranking machinery to cross-lingual alignment via a hand-designed hierarchy over parallel English/target pairs rather than introducing a fundamentally new objective. Rigor is solid: three models, five languages, two cross-lingual baselines (SFT+DPO, CLO), a PRO comparison (Appendix F), weighting-scheme ablations, gain-value ablations including a hierarchy-violating configuration (Table 4), reward/log-likelihood analysis, external reward-model scoring, and alignment-tax checks (Appendix D). Evidence is quantitative but single-run with no seeds, error bars, or significance tests, and win rates depend on an LLM judge ('gpt-5-chat'); some MMMLU/Belebele cells favor baselines. Generalizability is supported across model scales (7-8B only) and resource tiers but limited to Llama/Mistral families and 3k translated samples. Reproducibility is aided by a code release claim, full hyperparameters (Appendix B), and public datasets, though the translation/judge model naming is odd and unverified.

primary_link.title: Language Chain in Alignment: Cross-lingual Ranking Preference Optimization

papers.summary: The alignment of Large Language Models heavily relies on English-centric high-quality preference data, which often leads to suboptimal performance in other languages. In this paper, we propose Cross-lingual Ranking Preference Optimization~(CRPO), a novel framework that leverages robust preference knowledge from English to facilitate preference alignment in the target language. We design a hierarchical structure within parallel preference pairs across the target language and English to jointly op
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型的對齊高度依賴以英文為中心的高品質偏好資料,導致其他語言表現不佳。本文提出跨語言排序偏好最佳化框架 CRPO,利用模型內建的英文偏好知識來對齊目標語言的偏好分布。有別於 DPO 僅在單一語言內做二元比較,CRPO 借鑑 Learning-to-Rank 理念,在目標語言與英文的平行偏好對間建立階層式排序結構,賦予相關性標籤使目標語言的勝出回應排最高,並以 LambdaLoss 框架同時最佳化語言一致性與回應品質,另加入 NLL 損失。作者以 Llama-2-7B、Llama-3-8B 與 Mistral-7B,在中文、印尼語、韓語、史瓦希里語與孟加拉語五種資源規模不同的語言上,以 AlpacaEval、MMMLU 與 Belebele 評估。結果顯示 CRPO 一致優於 SFT+DPO 與 CLO 基線,在低資源語言尤其穩健,例如 Llama-3 在史瓦希里語勝率達 62.17;獎勵與對數機率分析顯示 CRPO 透過提升勝出回應的似然而非僅壓制落選回應來達成對齊,外部獎勵模型評分亦證實生成品質提升。限制方面,單一步驟需處理四個候選回應,訓練計算成本較高,且評測資料集未必涵蓋文化語境。此研究將跨語言對齊從孤立二元比較轉向整合的跨語言排序視角,具實務意義。
papers.title: Language Chain in Alignment: Cross-lingual Ranking Preference Optimization
papers.title_zh: 對齊中的語言鏈:跨語言排序偏好最佳化

links.title: Mitigating Reasoning-Induced Misalignment via Safety-Direction Penalty

evidence: §1/Abstract: proposes Safety-Direction Penalty, a training-time fix for RIM, claiming prior work (Yan et al.) identified neuron-level entanglement but left mitigation open
§3.1 Table 1: AM-SFT raises HEx-PHI harmfulness 10.00→20.33 (3B) and 13.33→25.33 (7B) while GPQA/AIME roughly preserved, satisfying the operational RIM criterion
§3.2/Table 7: MetaMathQA, Gemma 3 4B, Ministral 3 3B, and Qwen2.5-14B runs all fail the RIM criterion; paper explicitly characterizes RIM as conditional, not universal
§3.4/Fig 2: harm-perception probe stays ~0.98 after fine-tuning while safety-decision probe collapses to majority-class baseline — 'decision failure, not perception failure'
§5.1 Table 2: SDP restores HEx-PHI to 10.0 (3B) and 11.3 (7B), SafetyBench to 69.6/79.4; GPQA drops 3.8 pp (3B) and 2.0 pp (7B) vs base
Appendix B.1: judge noise quantified by re-judging three configurations five times (std 0.35–0.52 pp, max range 1.3 pp)
Appendix D.3/D.6: 3B displacement compensation (post-M1 dS remains −3.006 after penalizing M1) and 7B boundary-violation ablation (HEx-PHI 11.33→19.33 when expanding to r_CKA<1 layers)
Appendix D.9 Table 17: γs ablation over {0.01,0.05,0.1,0.5,1.0,5.0}; 0.5 chosen as best safety/reasoning balance
Limitations section: acknowledges no matched comparisons with external fine-tuning defenses, single fixed-template direction, last-token representation only, and Qwen-focused positive results
Appendix F.1: full hyperparameters, seeds (3407/42), software versions, ~120 GPU-hours documented; code 'will be released upon publication'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper sitting squarely on high-weight preferences: LLMs (Qwen2.5-Instruct), reasoning/CoT fine-tuning, AI safety/alignment, and interpretability (activation-space directions, CKA, probes). The contribution is real but incremental: it applies a known technique (difference-in-means refusal direction, Arditi et al.) to a recently identified phenomenon (RIM, Yan et al.) and adds a simple squared-displacement regularizer plus a diagnostic-driven layer-scope procedure; the compensation phenomenon and boundary-violation ablation are the most original pieces. Rigor is solid: explicit operational RIM criterion, honest cross-dataset/architecture/scale checks showing RIM is conditional, judge-noise quantification, γs ablation, scope ablations, and position robustness checks. Key weaknesses: no comparison to external fine-tuning defenses (Safe LoRA, Vaccine, etc.), only LoRA (no full FT), fix validated on only two settings where RIM emerged, and γs selected partly on the same benchmarks used for reporting. Evidence is internally consistent and quantified (HEx-PHI 20.3→10.0 / 25.3→11.3 after SDP; GPQA costs of 3.8/2.0 pp). Generalizability is limited by the conditional emergence of RIM and single-direction, last-token design, though limitations are candidly stated. Reproducibility is strong on hyperparameters, seeds, prompts, and compute, but code is only promised 'upon publication'.

primary_link.title: Mitigating Reasoning-Induced Misalignment via Safety-Direction Penalty

Cross-architecture, cross-scale, and cross-dataset checks show that RIM does not always emerge. Previous work attributed RIM to neuron-level entanglement, but did not identify the geometry of the representation space underlying
papers.summary_zh: 推理誘發失準(RIM)指模型僅在數學、程式碼與思維鏈等無害推理資料上進行 fine-tuning,安全對齊卻隨之退化。先前研究將 RIM 歸因於神經元層級的推理與安全迴路纏結,但未指出表示空間的幾何結構,也未提出訓練時的修復方法。本文提供兩者:作者從基礎模型的隱藏狀態萃取推理方向與安全方向,發現在 Qwen2.5-3B 與 7B 中,兩方向於中後層呈持續負的 whitened cosine 相似度,且安全表示偏移越大的提示詞安全退化越嚴重;CKA 距離比值與線性探針進一步定位出安全決策層——模型仍能辨識有害請求卻不再據以拒絕,屬決策失敗而非感知失敗。據此提出安全方向懲罰(SDP):在訓練損失加入沿安全方向位移的平方懲罰,以診斷流程選定懲罰層範圍,當範圍外產生補償性位移時迭代擴張。在 Qwen2.5-3B 與 7B 上,SDP 將 HEx-PHI 有害率恢復至基礎模型水準,同時大致保留 GPQA 與 AIME 推理成績。作者另以跨資料集、跨架構與跨規模檢驗,發現 RIM 並非普遍出現,而是條件性失效模式。限制包括 RIM 僅於 Qwen2.5 系列重現、安全方向採單一固定範本,以及幾何分析屬局部解釋而非因果定律。此工作為訓練時的安全維護提供無需安全資料與參考策略的低成本路徑。
papers.title: Mitigating Reasoning-Induced Misalignment via Safety-Direction Penalty
papers.title_zh: 以安全方向懲罰緩解推理誘發的失準

links.title: Don't Repeat Yourself: Stopping Verbatim Loops at Sampling Time

evidence: Abstract and Section 5.1/Table 1: DRY reduces SER@4 from 0.124 to 0.065 (47% relative, 95% CI [0.045, 0.085]) while placebo control is 0.121, statistically indistinguishable from no intervention.

Section 1 and references (Weidmann 2024, l3utterfly 2024, awtrisk 2024): DRY was previously implemented and merged into llama.cpp, ExLlamaV2, and text-generation-webui; paper states 'no controlled empirical study has evaluated DRY' prior to this work, bounding novelty to formalization and evaluation.

Section 5.5 and Appendix O (Table 13): on Llama-3-70B-Instruct DRY preserves MT-Bench 8.97 vs 8.95 baseline, MMLU 79.1% vs 79.2%, GSM8k 92.0% vs 92.1%, while no-repeat n-gram drops to 8.12/71.4%/81.2%.

Appendix I.1 (Table 9): breaker ablation shows removing breakers lowers SER@4 (0.041 vs 0.053) but false-positive penalty rate on structural tokens spikes from 1.2% to 28.4% and structural MAUVE collapses from 0.94 to 0.61.

Section 5.6: blind MTurk A/B with 600 pairs x 3 annotators, loop-avoidance preference Win 48%/Tie 45%/Lose 7% (p<0.001, two-sided binomial), formatting win 64% vs repetition penalty 1.15; human study limited to Qwen 2.5-7B outputs.

Appendix P (Table 14): macro MAUVE-vs-WikiText DRY 0.095 vs repetition penalty 0.089; per-model values highly variable (DRY 0.091 on Qwen-7B vs repetition penalty 0.147), supporting the paper's own caveat that these are rankings only.

Appendix T (Limitations): method targets exact surface-form loops only, not semantic repetition or hallucination; breakers are tokenizer-dependent; results may not transfer to closed proprietary systems.
Appendix R: claims a full artifact package (prompts, configs, raw generations, scripts, MTurk protocol) but the document shows no explicit code or data release URL.
Appendix L/M: latency overhead under 3% at 128K context (2.6% at 128K, Table 11), benchmarked on a single RTX 4090 with Llama 3.2-3B only.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A decoding-time LLM inference paper (DRY sampler) squarely matching LLM, inference/serving, and text-generation preferences. Rigor is strong: six baselines plus an intervention-matched placebo (Section 4.2), nine prompt families with negative and false-positive controls (Section 4.3, Appendix G), cluster-bootstrap CIs (Table 1), hyperparameter sweep of 34,944 generations (Appendix I), and a 600-pair blind MTurk study with Krippendorff's alpha 0.68 (Section 5.6). Evidence is solid but with soft spots: MAUVE-vs-human margins are thin (0.095 vs 0.089) with high per-model variance (repetition penalty 0.147 on Qwen-7B vs 0.049 on 1.5B, Appendix P), and human evaluation covers only Qwen 2.5-7B. Novelty is capped because the method itself predates the paper, having been merged into llama.cpp, ExLlamaV2, and text-generation-webui in 2024 (Section 1, Weidmann 2024 GitHub PR); the contribution is formalization plus the first controlled evaluation. Generalizability is good (1.5B to 120B, two tokenizer families, two decoding regimes, AWQ quantized frontier models) but limited to open weights and exact surface-form loops (Appendix T). Reproducibility is supported by full hyperparameter tables (Appendix H) and a claimed artifact package (Appendix R), though no explicit release URL appears in the document.

primary_link.title: Don't Repeat Yourself: Stopping Verbatim Loops at Sampling Time

papers.summary: Large Language Models generate text autoregressively, but open-ended generation is prone to verbatim looping, in which models repeat spans already present in context. Standard defenses such as repetition, presence, and frequency penalties and n-gram blocking act on token recurrence rather than the sequential structure of a loop, and often suppress looping only at strengths that also degrade formatting or fluency. We propose Don't Repeat Yourself (DRY), a sampling-time logit adjustment that penal
papers.summary_zh: 自迴歸語言模型在開放式生成中常出現逐字循環,反覆重述語境中已出現的片段。現有的重複懲罰、出現與頻率懲罰及 n-gram 阻擋等方法依 token 重現與否施加懲罰,無法區分良性重複(如對話範本的換行符)與循環開端,往往在足以抑制循環的強度下同時損害格式與流暢度。本文提出 DRY 取樣法,將重複控制從 token 重現重新框定為後綴延續:僅當生成某 token 會使當前後綴延伸成語境中已出現片段的精確延續時施加懲罰,懲罰量隨匹配長度指數成長,並以可設定的序列斷點保護換行、冒號、引號等結構性 token。評估涵蓋 1.5B 至 120B 參數的模型、九種提示詞家族與三次隨機種子,DRY 使後綴延續率 SER@4 相對下降 47%,同時提升 lexical diversity,並取得最高的 macro 平均 MAUVE。介入匹配的安慰劑對照無此效果,確認後綴匹配是作用機制。在 AWQ 量化的 70B 與 120B 模型上,DRY 約將循環率減半,且 MT-Bench、MMLU 與 GSM8k 成績維持在執行變異內,而重複懲罰與 n-gram 阻擋則出現可測量退化。600 對 MTurk 人類評估證實指標增益對應人眼可感品質,128K 語境下延遲開銷低於 3%。DRY 已被 llama.cpp、ExLlamaV2 與 text-generation-webui 採納,限制為僅處理逐字循環而不涵蓋語義重複,且斷點集合依賴分詞器。

links.title: Markets, Not Planners: Decentralized Orchestration of LLM Agents with Private Information

evidence: Abstract: 'a single inserted preference nearly doubles a favored agent's task share under a centralized LLM allocator'; Section 2 reports the share rising from 34% to 62% under an inserted system-prompt preference

Section 4.1: 'four complementary benchmarks: OlympiadBench ... BigCodeBench ... SuperGPQA ... GAIA'; 'we randomly sample a 100-task pool, using 25 tasks for warmup and 75 for evaluation'; agent pool is GPT-5 nano, Grok 4.3, Gemini 3 Flash, DeepSeek-V3.2 with GPT-5 mini as allocator
Table 1: AgentLance w. subcontract averages 54.2 across α, vs CARROT 51.6, centralized LLM planner 49.9, best single model (per α) 50.1, and MarketBench variants 42.9/47.6

Section 4.3: 'statistically significant average improvements over every baseline (p<0.05)' — no statistical test is specified; 'on tasks for which subcontracting is invoked, it improves accuracy by 27.3% and reduces the cost by 64.1%'

Table 2 (Ablation): removing reflective notes drops average score from 52.2 to 48.6; replacing VCG-style payment with pay-your-bid drops it to 49.7, though per-α values are mixed (47.5 vs 45.6 at α=10)
Section 5.1: cost self-estimation correlations 0.091–0.299 (direct) and MAPE 114%–2308%; with history the best correlation is only 0.354
Section 5.2 / Table 3: jointly correcting cost estimation and bidding strategy improves score by +1.5, +2.5, +5.4, +7.7 at α=1,2,5,10; either correction alone is inconsistent

Section 3.3: allocation score S_i(t)=p̂_i(t)−α·b_i(t) with VCG-style critical payment (Eq. 2–3); Section 3.4: subcontracting budget-constrained ('if the sum of the proposed subtask budgets exceeds the primary-market payment, the decomposition is rejected')
Appendix B: bias experiment details at α=10; Appendix E provides all AgentLance prompts, Appendix F baseline prompts — but no code or data availability statement appears anywhere in the paper
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-topic multi-agent LLM orchestration paper (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs): AgentLance is a repeated labor market where heterogeneous LLM agents bid with private costs, a VCG-style payment rule rewards cost-truthful bidding, and winners can subcontract decomposed subtasks. Preference relevance is very high. Novelty is solid but not maximal: market/auction mechanisms for LLM agents exist (MarketBench, Economy of Minds, Magentic Marketplace), and the contribution is a well-engineered combination (VCG payments + reputation + reflective notes + budget-constrained subcontracting) rather than a new class of method. Rigor is good: four benchmarks (OlympiadBench, BigCodeBench, SuperGPQA, GAIA), three baseline families including centralized routers (IRT-Router, CARROT), ablations of notes and payment rule, temperature 0 with three runs, and a motivating bias experiment showing a centralized planner's task share shifting 34%→62% under an inserted preference. Weaknesses: small evaluation scale (75 evaluation tasks per benchmark, 4 agents), subcontracting enabled only for GAIA, allocator fixed to one model, a claimed p<0.05 significance without test details, and mixed per-α ablation results (e.g., w/o VCG scores 47.5 vs 45.6 full at α=10). Evidence is quantitatively specific (Table 1 avg 54.2 vs CARROT 51.6 and best single model 50.1; joint intervention gains +1.5 to +7.7 across α), and the diagnosis of cost-estimation failure (correlations 0.091–0.299, MAPE up to 2308%) is candid. Generalizability is plausible across agent pools but demonstrated narrowly. Reproducibility is moderate: algorithm, implementation details, and all prompts are supplied in Appendices A/B/E, but no code or data release is stated and results depend on proprietary, price-varying models.

primary_link.title: Markets, Not Planners: Decentralized Orchestration of LLM Agents with Private Information

papers.summary: As LLM agents proliferate, built by different parties and with different capabilities and costs, orchestrating them is more like assembling labor across the economy than a computer calling a subroutine. Existing orchestration is typically centralized, with a single planner assigning every task, but this creates a bottleneck as agent pools grow, requires private information (e.g., agents' execution costs), and can easily be manipulated, such that a single inserted preference nearly doubles a favo
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理人日益異質,能力與成本各異,現行集中式編排由單一規劃器指派所有任務,面臨資訊瓶頸:它需存取代理人的私有執行成本,隨規模擴大處理吃力,且易受偏見與插入偏好操縱——實驗顯示一句偏好指令即可使受青睞代理的任務份額從 34% 升至 62%。本文提出 AgentLance,一個反覆運作的勞動市場:代理人依據私有成本與自行維護的策略筆記決定是否參與並出價;分配器依出價與公開聲譽紀錄選出得標者,並以 VCG 式第二價格支付規則鼓勵成本誠實出價;複雜任務則透過轉包進行階層式委派,得標者可拆解任務並以相同機制分派子任務。作者以 GPT-5 nano、Grok 4.3、Gemini 3 Flash 與 DeepSeek-V3.2 組成代理池,在數學推理、程式碼生成、知識問答與代理式任務四項基準上評估。市場展現預期行為:依專長分配任務,隨成本敏感度提高將工作移向較便宜模型;整體成績一致超越單一模型、集中式編排與市場基線,轉包進一步提升平均分數。消融實驗證實反思筆記與 VCG 式支付皆有貢獻。診斷亦揭露兩大瓶頸:代理人成本估計誤差極大,出價策略學習不完全;對照實驗顯示同時修正兩者可持續提升分數,單獨修正反而可能有害。此工作展示精心設計的市場機制可支撐分散式代理人協調,並指出成本預測為關鍵改進方向。

links.title: DelistBench: Evaluating Search-Enabled LLMs for Auditable Corporate-Event Database Completion

evidence: Abstract: web access raises announcement-date ±7 accuracy by 34.0–48.0 pp; best system achieves 81.5% overall joint accuracy within seven days

§3.2: DelistBench contains 1,200 records in three balanced strata (A positives, B later-event negatives, C still-listed controls) with issuer-family-disjoint splits of 600/300/300 for training/calibration/locked testing
§4.1 & Table 3: Gemini 3.6 Flash web attains 45.2% A-joint ±7 completion and 81.5% overall joint accuracy at $11.83/1k; DeepSeek V4 Flash web is 3.0 pp below GPT-5.6 Luna at 6.6% of its cost
§4.2 & Table 5: 52.8% of evidence packages for yes predictions passed the audit protocol; human–Codex agreement was 156/200 (78.0%) exact and 143/160 (89.4%) on Pass/Fail judgments
§4.3 & Table 6: Gemini 3.6 Flash accepts 72.7% of test records at 3.7% error, but only 2.1%–18.9% of Category A records are accepted with 44.4%–70.6% conditional accepted error
§5.2: best web system reaches 97.3% decision accuracy but only 46.0% exact date accuracy on Category A, framing the system as candidate detection rather than unattended row generation

§6 Limitations: historical events reconstructed from current web rather than a sealed index, Codex-assisted audit not fully double-coded, absence of Vietnam-listed records, and Category C non-existence not provable
llm_evaluation.rationale: A finance-domain but language-methodology-centric benchmark paper evaluating search-enabled LLMs (five families, paired closed-book vs web conditions) for auditable database reconstruction. Strongly matches LLM, Agents/Tool-Use, RAG/Knowledge-grounding, and evaluation preferences; not a bare domain application since the contribution is a task formulation, benchmark, evidence-audit protocol, and risk-based selective acceptance. Novelty is solid (cutoff-aware adjudication, later-event negatives as first-class errors, prevalence-aware deployment calibration) though it builds on FreshLLMs/RealTimeQA/ALCE-style prior work. Rigor is above average: 1,200 records with issuer-family-disjoint train/calibration/locked-test splits, hierarchical metrics guarding against negative-class inflation, error taxonomy over 3,750 failures, and honest reporting of calibration failure (GPT-5.6 Luna 6.8% test error vs 5% target). Evidence is quantitative and table-backed but lacks confidence intervals and uses a single retained response per record; the evidence audit is Codex-assisted with only 200 human-validated packages (78.0% exact agreement, 89.4% Pass/Fail agreement). Generalizability is limited by delisting-specific task design and proprietary models; reproducibility is weakened by live-web retrieval and changing APIs, with release of benchmark, prompts, and code only promised upon publication.

primary_link.title: DelistBench: Evaluating Search-Enabled LLMs for Auditable Corporate-Event Database Completion

papers.summary: Financial institutions need an independent way to detect missing, stale, and misclassified corporate-event records in vendor databases. We introduce Search-to-Record, a database-assurance task in which search-enabled large language models reconstruct institution-defined event records from public sources for a known security universe and historical cutoff, and DelistBench, a 1,200-record benchmark for security-level delisting announcements. We evaluate five models in paired closed-book and web-en
papers.summary_zh: 金融機構需要獨立手段偵測供應商事件資料庫中的缺失、過時與分類錯誤紀錄。本文提出 Search-to-Record(S2R)資料庫稽核任務:在已知證券宇宙與歷史截止日的前提下,以具網路搜尋能力的 LLM 從公開來源重建機構自訂的事件紀錄,並建立 1,200 筆證券層級下市公告基準 DelistBench。基準分為三個診斷層:400 筆正面完成紀錄、400 筆未來事件負例(截止日後才有合格公告)與 400 筆仍在交易的控制組,涵蓋 59 個發行國,採發行商家族不相交的分割。作者以五種模型進行封閉書本與開放網路的成對比較。網路存取使七日內公告日期準確率提升 34.0–48.0 個百分點,事件狀態準確率提升約 2.8–21.7 點;最佳系統 Gemini 3.6 Flash 達 81.5% 的整體聯合準確率。經濟型網路系統以最昂貴系統 4.5–6.6% 的 API 成本達成 75.9–78.3% 準確率。錯誤分析顯示瓶頸不在 JSON 產出,而在辨識正式事件階段、綁定標的上市與維持截止紀律:正面紀錄的精確日期準確率僅 46.0%。證據稽核顯示 yes 預測的證據套件通過率僅 52.8%。基於風險的分流可找出低錯誤子集,但最高覆蓋率操作點仍將 27.3% 的測試集送人工審查,且正面紀錄的接受錯誤率仍高,故建議正面與模糊個案應導向針對性複核。限制包括平衡基準不反映自然事件盛行率、以當前網路而非封存歷史索引重建等,此研究為可稽核的資料庫完成任務提供具部署指引的評測框架。

links.title: LLM-based Agents for Forecasting and Prediction: Methods, Training, Evaluation, and Applications

evidence: Abstract, Page 1: 'We organize architectures into three groups. Standalone LLM workflows... Tool-and retrieval-augmented agents... Hybrid systems pair LLMs with statistical or foundation models' and 'The evidence indicates that measurement is a central limitation.'
Section 2.4, Page 6: represents forecasting agents as a tuple (pi_theta, A, T, M, g) and states 'The formulation extends ReAct [212] with a predictive readout.'

Section 2.2, Page 5: describes corpus construction via search terms and backward citation, noting 'a pilot audit of 12 benchmark papers found substantial disclosure gaps... including omitted agent scaffolds and no inference-cost reporting among the eight agent papers [131].'

Section 4.3, Page 16: presents conflicting ablation evidence — 'replacing or removing the LLM component leaves accuracy unchanged or improves it' [178] versus a larger-scale re-evaluation 'reports positive language-model contributions' [155].
Section 5.2, Page 19: distinguishes feature from parametric leakage and cites TSFMAudit showing 'text-adapted loss detectors are unreliable for time-series models.'
Section 5.5, Page 21: requires reports to include 'calls per prediction, input and output tokens, wall-clock latency, and the strongest low-cost baseline at the same operating point.'
Section 6.2, Page 23: states 'No LLM agent matches these systems in numerical prediction' regarding specialist weather models, with language roles confined to downstream workflow support.

Conclusion, Page 25: 'Evidence for LLM-based forecasting agents remains mixed' and controlled ablations matter because 'gains may arise from retrieval, prompts, interfaces, aggregation, or numerical backbones rather than the LLM itself.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: A comprehensive survey of LLM-based forecasting agents that sits squarely within high-weight preference areas: LLMs, agents & tool use (ReAct-style reason-act loops, multi-agent orchestration, tool necessity), reasoning, retrieval augmentation, and evaluation methodology. Topic match is excellent, but the work is a survey, not a new method: novelty rests on a unified numerical/event formulation, a graded agency continuum extending ReAct with a predictive readout, and a taxonomy plus critical synthesis that foregrounds negative evidence (LLM-removal ablations) and contamination/leakage controls. Rigor is high for a survey: explicit scope exclusions, formal leakage definitions, refusal to build cross-paper leaderboards due to disclosure gaps, and flagged pending/contested results. Evidence strength is solid but entirely secondary (cited claims, no new experiments). Reproducibility is moderate: a living corpus artifact is mentioned, but no released code or dataset for the synthesis itself. Not a pure domain application; the language-methodology content keeps it in scope.

We organize architectures into three groups. Standalone LLM workflows operate on encoded time series or event context. Tool- and retrieval-augmented a
papers.summary_zh: 本文為一篇關於 LLM 預測代理的系統性文獻綜述,界定研究範圍為語言模型透過推理、表示或控制,對未來或未觀測目標做出可計分預測的系統。作者將架構分為三類:在編碼時間序列或事件語境上運作的獨立 LLM 工作流程;整合外部證據的工具與檢索增強代理;以及 LLM 與統計或基礎模型配對的混合系統。綜述並檢視訓練與調適方法,包括輕量介面、重新編程、強化學習與校準獎勵。文章特別重視負面證據:對輸入微擾的敏感性、移除 LLM 元件後準確率不變甚至更佳的消融結果,以及可能反映預訓練污染而非時間推理能力的基準增益。應用面涵蓋金融、氣象、健康、能源與營運,並整理各領域的基準與資料集。作者指出證據顯示測量是核心限制:現有評估面臨前瞻洩漏、預訓練污染、基準過時、推論成本未充分報告等問題;在數值預測上,強烈的統計與時間序列基礎模型基線(如 Chronos、TimesFM)使 LLM 的附加價值難以確立;在事件預測上,專家預測者仍優於被評估模型,市場掛鉤基準亦記錄高信心虧損。文章主張未來研究需要分布位移下的校準、抗污染的即時評估、成本與準確率並列報告,以及處理已部署預測與被預測結果之間反饋的方法。整體而言,此綜述以統一證據標準審視正面與負面結果,為 LLM 預測代理的穩健評測與務實部署提供清晰路線圖。

evidence: Sec. 1/Abstract: proposes CorrGap metric for inter-dimension dependence and DimCheck that 'iteratively removes unrelated evidence from COTs generated by LLM judges'

Sec. 5: three frameworks (G-Eval, Analyze-Rate, Debate) with ten judges including Llama3.1/3.3-70b, Qwen3-14/32B, gemma-3-12/27b, Ministral-14b, gpt-5.4-nano/mini, M-Prometheus-14B on four tasks (Table 2)
Sec. 6.1/Table 3: CorrGap correctly flags FactScore as low dependence while Analyze-Rate shows significant dependence; 'w/o control' ablation shows ground-truth distribution control is needed
Sec. 6.1/Table 4: synthetic gamma-perturbation validation, CorrGap significant for gamma>0 and not for gamma=0 on three of four datasets
Sec. 6.3/Table 7: DimCheck achieves best overall scores (62.8/63.1/63.3) vs six baselines with lower CorrGap and comparable tau; significance via bootstrapping p<0.05
Sec. 6.4: human evaluation of 60 samples, three MTurk annotators, Randolph's kappa 0.63, accuracy 85-95% for identifying unrelated evidence
Sec. 6.6/Table 9 and A.8: SFT+LoRA (rank 32) Llama3.1-8B editor approximates 70B editor (overall 58.2 vs 58.6) with ~85% inference-time reduction (A.1: 120 min to ~20 min)

Sec. 6.1: text contains swapped significance inequalities ('CorrGap for FactScore is not statistically significant (p<0.05), whereas... Analyze-Rate is statistically significant (p>0.05)'), an internal inconsistency
Sec. 8 Limitation: restricted to pointwise evaluation and judges that explicitly generate COTs; Sec. 5 notes OpinSumm has only 10 inputs; Ethics statement lists public data/models but no code release
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper squarely on high-weight preferences: LLM-as-judge multi-dimensional evaluation (Red Teaming & Evaluation), CoT reasoning manipulation (Reasoning & CoT), prompting-based interventions, and open-weight LLMs (Llama/Qwen/Gemma/GPT-5.4/Ministral/M-Prometheus). Novelty is moderate: CorrGap is a new stratified-correlation metric extending Xiao et al.'s coarse correlation analysis, and DimCheck is a dimension-targeted CoT-evidence-pruning variant of Analyze-Rate, related to Self-Refine/self-consistency. Rigor is strong: metric validation via a FactScore control judge (Table 3), synthetic gamma-perturbation tests (Table 4), 1000-iteration permutation tests, inter-annotator confound check (Table 5), six baselines (Table 7), ablations (Table 8/22), prompt- and order-stability checks (Tables 12, 20), and MTurk human eval (kappa 0.63, 85-95% accuracy). Evidence is diluted by small datasets (OpinSumm has 10 inputs), modest absolute gains (overall 62.8-63.3 vs 61.9-62.6), small ablation deltas, an apparent text error swapping p-value inequalities in Sec. 6.1 ('not statistically significant (p<0.05)... statistically significant (p>0.05)'), and inconsistent LLM counts (eight in Sec. 5, nine in conclusion, ten in Table 6). Generalizability limited to pointwise, COT-generating judges with multi-dimension human annotations (Sec. 8). Reproducibility decent: prompts, LoRA/SFT hyperparameters, and inference settings provided; no explicit code release.

primary_link.title: Inter-dimension Dependence for Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of Open-Ended Text

papers.summary: LLM-as-a-judge methods are widely used for evaluating the quality of generated open-ended text. Such evaluations are generally multi-dimensional, since the error patterns in texts can be different for different dimensions. Therefore, reliable LLM judges should evaluate each target dimension independently. To quantify the extent to which LLM judges depend on non-target dimensions when evaluating a target dimension, i.e., inter-dimension dependence, we propose CorrGap. To measure this, CorrGap use
papers.summary_zh: LLM-as-a-judge 廣泛用於開放式文本評估,而多維度評估要求評判者獨立評量各目標維度。本文觀察到 LLM 評判者在評估某目標維度(如摘要的相關性)時,其思維鏈常混入非目標維度(如連貫性)的證據,造成跨維度依賴,使多維度評估名存實亡。為量化此現象,作者提出 CorrGap 指標:將文本依目標維度與其他維度真值分數的百分位差異分成低變異與高變異兩組,計算 LLM 預測分數與真值相關性在兩組間的差距,並在校正真值分數分布後比較以避免假性依賴。驗證顯示 CorrGap 正確判定設計上僅針對事實一致性的 FactScore 幾無跨維度依賴,而通用評判框架則依賴顯著。跨 G-Eval、Analyze-Rate、Debate 三種框架與多個 LLM、四項任務(SummEval、Topical-Chat、Hanna、OpinSummEval)的實驗表明跨維度依賴普遍存在,且較大模型不一定依賴較低。為緩解此問題,作者提出 DimCheck:迭代地從評判者生成的思維鏈中移除與非目標維度相關但與目標維度無關的證據,再依修改後的思維鏈重新評分。實驗顯示 DimCheck 一致降低 CorrGap 並取得最佳整體表現,人類評估確認其可準確辨識含無關證據的思維鏈;作者進一步以 SFT 訓練較小模型近似大型 LLM 的編輯能力,大幅降低推論成本。限制在於僅涵蓋逐點評估,且方法依賴顯式生成思維鏈的評判框架,此工作對提升多維度獎勵訊號的可靠性具實質意義。
papers.title: Inter-dimension Dependence for Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of Open-Ended Text
papers.title_zh: 開放式文本多維度評估中的跨維度依賴

links.title: Better Retrieval, Worse Robustness: How Multi-hop RAG Amplifies Upstream ASR Errors

evidence: Abstract: combined entity-graph linking and iterative reformulation enlarges the clean-to-highest-WER F1 gap by 36-67% vs naive dense retrieval on all three benchmarks
Section 5.2: IRCoT+HippoRAG2 has highest oracle F1 (0.730 HotpotQA, 0.645 2Wiki, 0.381 MuSiQue) yet largest oracle-NG gap, amplification significant at p<=0.007
Section 5.3 Table 2 / Appendix D Table 8: entity corruption is 87-96% of degradation cases on 2WikiMultiHopQA across all four methods; 67-82% HotpotQA, 54-78% MuSiQue
Section 5.4 Table 3: phonetic correction closes at most 11.1% of the oracle-NG gap (HippoRAG2); N-best decoding is -2.2% to +2.5%
Section 5.5 / Appendix E: real Nigerian speech WER 28.9% (median 22.0%) vs 17.1% synthetic; 43.8% vs 40.7% entity-instance alteration supports TTS as controlled probe
Appendix F Table 9: SeamlessM4T-v2-large (WER 28.0%) preserves gap ordering Naive < HippoRAG2 < IRCoT+Naive < IRCoT+HippoRAG2; largest gap grows 0.195 to 0.214
Limitations: single TTS voice per accent, English-only, single generator (gpt-4o-mini), rule-based entity proxy without human validation
Footnote 1: code (Apache-2.0) and data released at github.com/Continuum-AI-Corp/spoken-multihop-rag; Section 4.3: paired bootstrap with 10,000 resamples; fixed seed 42
llm_evaluation.rationale: A language-methodology paper, not a pure audio paper: the object of study is how ASR-corrupted queries propagate through four RAG architectures (Naive, HippoRAG2, IRCoT+Naive, IRCoT+HippoRAG2) with gpt-4o-mini generation, so it aligns strongly with RAG & Knowledge, Reasoning/CoT (IRCoT is literally interleaved CoT retrieval), LLM, and evaluation preferences. Novelty is solid: the counterintuitive finding that structurally richer retrieval amplifies rather than absorbs upstream errors, plus a new 12,000-query spoken multi-hop suite, extends prior single-hop spoken QA work (Spoken-SQuAD, SD-QA). Rigor is good: paired bootstrap significance (p<0.001 gaps, p<=0.007 for amplification), oracle upper bound isolating ASR degradation, IRCoT step-count ablation, real-speech validation (500 utterances, WER 28.9%), and a second ASR system (SeamlessM4T, Appendix F Table 9) preserving the gap ordering; relative amplification percentages (36.5%/42.3%/67.4%) are internally consistent with Table 1. Evidence is weakened by a crude rule-based entity-corruption proxy (capitalized-phrase regex, Section 5.3/Appendix B) with no human validation, and end-to-end evaluation is synthetic-speech only. Generalizability is limited: English-only, one TTS voice per accent, one generator LLM, benchmark-provided distractor corpora, all honestly disclosed in Limitations. Reproducibility is strong: Apache-2.0 code and data release (footnote 1), fixed seed, temperature 0, hyperparameters documented in Appendix A.

primary_link.title: Better Retrieval, Worse Robustness: How Multi-hop RAG Amplifies Upstream ASR Errors

papers.summary: Speech-based applications pass spoken queries through automatic speech recognition (ASR) before any retrieval module, so ASR errors enter the pipeline as a fixed upstream constraint. We empirically test whether two extensions to standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), entity-graph linking and iterative reformulation, absorb or amplify these errors. Using four English accents synthesized through neural TTS, we evaluate four RAG configurations on three multi-hop QA benchmarks (HotpotQA, 2Wi
papers.summary_zh: 語音應用中,口說查詢先經自動語音辨識(ASR)再進入檢索模組,ASR 錯誤成為固定的上游約束。本文實證檢驗多跳檢索增強生成(RAG)的兩種常見擴充——實體圖連結與迭代改寫——會吸收或放大這些錯誤。作者以神經 TTS 合成美式、印度、菲律賓與奈及利亞四種英文口音的口說查詢,經 Whisper-large-v3 轉錄後,在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA 與 MuSiQue 三個多跳問答基準上比較 Naive RAG、HippoRAG2、IRCoT+Naive 與 IRCoT+HippoRAG2 四種設定,共 12,000 筆口說查詢。結果顯示結構更豐富的設定在 ASR 輸入下通常保較高絕對 F1,但錯誤被放大:從乾淨文本到 WER 最高的奈及利亞口音,F1 差距在兩者組合下比 Naive RAG 大 36–67%,且退化隨 WER 單調上升。錯誤分析指出查詢實體損毀是主導失效機制,佔 2WikiMultiHopQA 各方法退化案例的 87–96%;個案研究顯示單一實體錯誤即可使所有方法失效,迭代改寫甚至會拋棄底層檢索器仍保留的部分訊號。兩種輕量緩解(N-best 解碼與音近實體校正)最多只挽回約 11% 的差距,顯示下游檢索結構放大了剩餘的實體錯誤。作者另以 500 筆真實奈及利亞語音驗證實體損毀率相當,並以 SeamlessM4T 重跑確認方法排序不受 ASR 系統影響。限制包括使用單一 TTS 音色、僅評估英文、錯誤分類採規則代理。此研究凸顯複雜多跳 RAG 在語音場景的公平性與穩健性隱憂。
papers.title: Better Retrieval, Worse Robustness: How Multi-hop RAG Amplifies Upstream ASR Errors
papers.title_zh: 更好的檢索,更差的穩健性:多跳 RAG 如何放大上游 ASR 錯誤

links.title: ST$^2$U: Stateful Test-Time Unlearning via Restricted Knowledge Boundary Control

evidence: Abstract: claims re-entry of 13.76%-19.84% versus 46.50%-59.10% for leading test-time baselines, consistent with Table 1 R-Ent. columns.
Table 1 (Main Results on RWKU and WMDP): ST2U reaches FB 18.40/QA 22.08, Avg.WMDP 29.26, MMLU 60.58, R-Ent. 19.20/13.76 on Llama3.1-8B-Instruct; similar patterns for Qwen3-14B and SpikingBrain-7B.

Table 3 (Ablation on Avg.WMDP, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct): removing historical state raises R-Ent. 13.76->37.50; removing risk gate raises WMDP 29.26->42.35 and drops MMLU 60.58->55.55; removing residual preservation drops MMLU to 52.79.
Table 4 (Limited White-box Attacks): ST2U shows +1.16% WMDP recovery and -1.92% MMLU drift vs SCANS +15.84% recovery, under reverse-vector cancellation.
Experiments - Implementation Details: k=32, J=16, six affine-coupling blocks hidden width 128, threshold quantile 94%, max step 12, 4x NVIDIA RTX 4090; supports partial reproducibility.

Experiments - Evaluation Metrics: fluency judged by GPT-4o and metric details deferred to Appendix B.2-B.3; re-entry protocol and attack details deferred to Appendix C.3/C.4, limiting verifiability from the provided text.
Discussions - Deployment cost (Fig 6): ST2U uses 2.8 minutes offline preparation with 2.21x online latency relative to Base, versus 14.8/24.9 minutes offline for RMU/AS.
Reproducibility gap: no explicit code or data release claim appears anywhere in the provided paper text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Clearly in-scope: an LLM inference-time unlearning method for suppressing restricted/hazardous knowledge, squarely matching LLM (2.5) and AI Safety (2.0) preferences, with interpretability-adjacent activation steering. The core contribution is genuine but incremental-over-visible-prior-work: it reframes pointwise activation editing as trajectory-wide boundary control using invertible low-dim coordinates (building on INNSTEER-style invertible steering), a KDE density-ratio risk boundary, contextual anchoring, and a recurrent correction state; the 'restricted knowledge re-entry' failure mode is a legitimately new angle. Rigor is solid: three benchmarks (RWKU, WMDP, MUSE-Books), three-plus backbones (Llama3.1-8B, Qwen3-14B, SpikingBrain-7B), seven baselines spanning parameter/in-context/test-time families, component ablations (Table 3), sensitivity sweeps (Fig 4), a limited white-box attack study (Table 4), layer-wise analysis (Fig 5), and cost analysis (Fig 6). Main deductions: the headline re-entry metric is author-defined with its verification protocol deferred to Appendix C.3, many results/details live in unseen appendices (B.1-B.5, C.1-C.6), no statistical significance testing, fluency via a single GPT-4o judge, no stated code release, and forgetting gains over AS partly trade against retention (acknowledged). Quantitative claims in the abstract/text are consistent with Tables 1-4, which supports evidence strength, though unverifiable appendix-dependent protocol limits it.

primary_link.title: ST$^2$U: Stateful Test-Time Unlearning via Restricted Knowledge Boundary Control

papers.summary: Controlling restricted knowledge in large language models is essential for model alignment and safe deployment. Test-time unlearning avoids costly retraining and parameter updates by intervening only during inference. However, existing activation-editing methods apply isolated pointwise corrections, overlooking how autoregressive generation continually reconstructs hidden states from the prompt, cache, and generated prefix. Consequently, later states may return to restricted knowledge regions af
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型需要遺忘敏感、私人或受版權保護的知識，但重訓成本高；既有測試期方法多半在單一解碼位置修正隱藏狀態，忽略自迴歸生成會不斷由提示、快取與前綴重建隱藏狀態，導致稍後又回到受限知識區域。ST²U 把測試期遺忘視為軌跡層級的邊界控制：先用成對受限／淨化軌跡學習低維可逆座標與 KDE 密度比風險幾何，保留正交非目標成分；推論時監控風險，沿邊界法線下降並結合切向歷史狀態、情境錨定與固定維度修正狀態，以降低知識再進入。在 WMDP、RWKU 與 MUSE-Books 上，跨三種模型家族取得 80.6–87.9% 遺忘率，平均保留約 90.7% 非目標能力，再進入率 13.76–19.84%，明顯低於測試期基線的 46.50–59.10%；離線準備約 2.8 分鐘，但線上延遲為 2.21×。方法定位為部署時抑制存取，而非參數層刪除，且門檻與步長等設定仍需依模型調整。此研究顯示具狀態、邊界感知的推論期控制，可在不重訓下改善 LLM 的安全部署。
papers.title: ST$^2$U: Stateful Test-Time Unlearning via Restricted Knowledge Boundary Control
papers.title_zh: ST²U：透過受限知識邊界控制的具狀態測試期遺忘

links.title: Signal or Noise? A Benchmark Study of Agent Skills in Web Development

evidence: Abstract: 'target Skill injection reduces mean Pass@2 by 1.3% to 4.2% ... increases token cost by 72% to 394%, with gains in only 17% to 36% of Skill-project pairs' — quantitative headline claims stated in abstract.
§3 Conditions: 'C2 (length-matched irrelevant Skill) replaces the target SKILL.md with a skip-tier Skill of approximately equal byte length (±5%)' — defines the paper's key methodological control.

§3 Models and metrics: 'each (model, condition, pair) cell is run for N=3 independent replicates ... 95% paired-bootstrap intervals over the pair set (1,000 resamples)' — documents replication and inference protocol.

§3 Routing: 'They agreed on 1,495 pairs (raw agreement 96.5%, Cohen's κ≈0.74) ... This yields 117 core pairs that cover all 50 projects' — annotator agreement and pair counts, though both annotators are the authors.

Limitations: 'aggregate C0 and C1 Pass@2 vary by 4.4 and 3.6 pp, which is comparable to the headline effect size' — authors acknowledge seed variance rivals effect sizes; also 'our C2 measurements use 109 unique length-matched runs across the 117 pairs'.
§4.5 / Appendix D: C3 'runs on the positive tail—five (Skill, project) pairs' with pooled anti-pattern effect p=0.008 (McNemar b=111, c=74); selection caveat explicitly stated.

Table 3: length/content split shows Sonnet ΔLength=-3.3 with ΔContent=-0.9 (CI includes zero) and Qwen ΔContent=+1.2, so the 'length-distraction' grouping is directionally supported but content terms are not individually significant for that group.
Appendix E: 'The raw per-task evaluation reports and the base Web-Bench task harness are omitted for size' — release reproduces analyses, not byte-for-byte agent trajectories.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference study of Agent Skills for coding agents: directly serves Agents & Tool Use (coding agent skill injection/routing), Code & Programming, and LLM evaluation preferences. Novelty is solid but incremental in corpus terms (reuses Web-Bench's 50 projects/1,000 tasks); the genuine contribution is methodological—the byte-matched length control (C2), workspace-aware injection of only SKILL.md, and leave-one-out slice ablation (C3), plus the length-distraction vs content-misalignment mechanism split. Rigor is above average: paired bootstrap CIs, inter-annotator agreement (κ≈0.74), Wilcoxon/McNemar tests, and an unusually candid limitations section admitting N=3 seed spread (4.4/3.6 pp) comparable to the headline effect, C3 positive-tail selection on only five pairs, and 109 shared C2 runs across 117 pairs. Evidence for aggregate negative effects and easy-task concentration is CI-supported; the two-mechanism claim rests on small model-level aggregates (Sonnet/Qwen content terms cross or near zero). C3 slice findings are explicitly selection-biased and framed as descriptive. Generalizability is limited: WebDev-only, four models, conservative core-only routing, no off-target or online A/B evidence. Reproducibility is good (anonymous repo with code, routing, skills, CSVs) but raw trajectories and the harness are omitted, so analyses—not agent reruns—are reproducible.

primary_link.title: Signal or Noise? A Benchmark Study of Agent Skills in Web Development

papers.summary: Agent Skills are reusable procedural modules that are increasingly injected into coding-agent sessions to encode framework conventions, anti-patterns, and reusable tools. However, because each injected Skill expands the prompt of every query, an effective Skill benchmark must determine not only whether an agent can solve a task, but whether the Skill should have been injected at all. We introduce WebDev-Skills-Bench and use it for a controlled empirical study of 31 public WebDev Skills on 50 Web
papers.summary_zh: Agent Skills 是常被注入編碼代理的可重用程序化模組，但每個 Skill 會擴大所有查詢的提示，未必值得注入。作者建立 WebDev-Skills-Bench，在 Web-Bench 的 50 個專案與 1,000 個有序任務上，對 31 個公開 WebDev Skills 做控制式研究，比較無 Skill、目標 Skill、長度匹配的無關 Skill 與逐片移除消融；為隔離長度效應，只將 SKILL.md 放入提示，輔助檔案掛載到工作區。跨四個模型，注入平均使 Pass@2 下降 1.3–4.2 個百分點、完成深度下降、token 成本增加 72–394%，僅 17–36% 的（Skill, project）配對受益。長度控制顯示 Sonnet 與 Qwen 偏受長度干擾，GPT-5.1 與 DeepSeek 則被內容誤導；損失集中在簡單早期任務，跨模型 Pearson 相關近乎為零；有益 Skill 中反模式規則最可靠，範例程式對最強模型反而有害。限制包括種子變異、路由保守、僅涵蓋公開 Skill 與部署前基準，未測視覺品質或端到端延遲。研究將 Skill 視為（Skill, project, model）假說，主張注入應作為路由決策，並把長度匹配控制與逐模型稽核列為最低標準。

links.title: PuzzleKV: Page-Wise Low-Rank Decomposition for KV Cache Compression

evidence: Abstract: 'At approximately 60% of the original KV cache storage, PuzzleKV achieves more than 96% of Full KV performance across both evaluated models and all benchmark settings' - verified in Table 1 (88.82/92.33=96.2%, 84.39/87.54=96.4%, 90.73/91.41=99.3%, 87.53/89.44=97.9%)
Section 4.3 / Table 3: 'PuzzleKV + INT4 reduces the KV storage ratio to 0.187' achieving 86.24 (Llama3.1) and 90.20 (Qwen3) on RULER 16K

Section 4.1 Baselines: 'We omit xKV... while OjaKV is reported in the supplementary material due to its unstable reproduced performance across models and tasks' - Appendix C Table 10 shows Qwen3-8B OjaKV-PF average of 15.91 with zero scores, a potentially unfavorable reproduction left unexplained
Section 4.5 System Efficiency: 'At 32K, PuzzleKV introduces a 20.9% TTFT overhead relative to Raw KV' and TPOT overhead of only 0.075 ms/token (Table 4)

Section 5 Discussion: 'Our current implementation is a batch-one standalone prototype... strong potential for integration into a batched paged serving engine such as vLLM' - limits serving-relevance of latency numbers

Appendix D Tables 12-14: full page-size and rank grids plus pre/post-RoPE ablation (90.40 vs 90.88), supporting design choices; Appendix A.2 gives full computing environment but no code availability statement
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM inference-efficiency paper: training/calibration-free page-wise low-rank KV cache compression with mixed attention over dense and factorized pages, directly matching LLM, KV-cache/long-context, and efficiency preferences. Novelty is moderate: per-page SVD granularity is a sensible but incremental twist on Palu/OjaKV/xKV, and the no-reconstruction attention reuses online-softmax ideas (Section 3.3). Evaluation is solid: two models, RULER 16K/32K and LongBench, matched 0.6 storage budget, Global SVD controlled baseline, full rank-grid and page-size ablations, and quantization to 0.187 storage; the headline claims (>96% of Full KV at ~60% storage; >93% at 18.7%) match Tables 1-3. Weaknesses: only two 8B models, batch-one prototype (Section 5 admits no vLLM integration), 20.9% TTFT overhead, xKV omitted and OjaKV relegated to Appendix C with a weakly justified 'unstable reproduction' showing zero scores on Qwen3, and no code release stated despite otherwise detailed configs, seeds, and environment tables.

primary_link.title: PuzzleKV: Page-Wise Low-Rank Decomposition for KV Cache Compression

papers.summary: Long-context inference in large language models (LLMs) is increasingly limited by the memory required for the key-value (KV) cache. KV cache compression addresses this problem by reducing the storage cost of previous tokens. Among existing approaches, low-rank compression is particularly attractive because it represents every token in reduced dimensions. Previous low-rank methods typically derive fixed projection spaces from model weights, construct fixed spaces from calibration activations, or
papers.summary_zh: 長脈絡推論受限於 KV 快取記憶體。既有低秩方法多使用固定投影、校準激活或跨大區域共享基底，可能漏掉稀疏但關鍵資訊。PuzzleKV 觀察到每個 KV head 的固定長度邏輯頁內部具有明顯低秩結構，因此提出免訓練、免校準的逐頁壓縮：將完成的頁視為獨立壓縮單元，保留 attention sink 與近期窗口為稠密形式，其他頁以截斷 SVD 分解；自訂混合注意力核心直接在稠密與分解頁上計算，並以 online softmax 合併，解碼時增量轉換新頁。作者在 Qwen3-8B 與 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的 RULER 16K/32K 與 LongBench 評估，於約 60% 儲存預算下達到 Full KV 的 96% 以上效能，RULER 上大幅領先 Global SVD 並具競爭力；結合逐因子 INT4 量化後，可用 18.7% 原始儲存保留逾 93% 效能。限制是目前為 batch-one 原型，32K 下 TTFT 有 20.9% 額外開銷，重現不穩定的 OjaKV 未列入主表。此工作把壓縮粒度與分頁快取管理對齊，對長脈絡伺服器部署具實務意義。
papers.title: PuzzleKV: Page-Wise Low-Rank Decomposition for KV Cache Compression
papers.title_zh: PuzzleKV：用於 KV 快取壓縮的分頁式低秩分解

links.title: DPIAgent: Divide, Protocol, Isolate for Agentic Reproduction Test Generation

evidence: Abstract: 'On SWT-Bench Verified, DPIAgent outperforms seven baselines across three backbone LLMs. With DPI alone it reaches 81.76% success rate on GPT-5... adding test selection further raises it to 86.17%'

Section 3.1-3.4: method defines two phases (defect exploration, test generation), a ready_to_write_test structured handoff with six fields, and phase-specific toolsets; test selection adopted from e-Otter++
Table 1 (Section 5): Ours reaches 74.28 S. on GPT-5-Mini (+11.88 over OpenHands), 81.76 on GPT-5, 78.98 on Claude-Opus-4.5; Figure 1 isolates DPI gains over SWE-Agent (+14.16/+9.24/+2.07)
Section 6 Table 3: ablations on GPT-5-Mini and Claude-Opus-4.5 show removing Protocol, Isolate, or Divide each degrades S. (e.g., 78.98 to 69.05 when collapsing phases on Claude-Opus-4.5)
Section 6 Table 4: attribution study on GPT-5-Mini adds Search Code (+7.54 S., -3.89 TDD), Summary Prompt (-5.16), Transition Tool (+1.08) individually, versus +12.85 for full DPI phase structure
Section 4: 'All results are averaged over 3 runs' using the official SWT-Bench Docker environment; Appendix B details baseline configurations and leaderboard-sourced results
Section 5 Table 2: first-edit readiness measured with an LLM-as-Judge instantiated with 'GPT-5.6-Terra', run three times with outcome-aware correction and standard deviations reported
Appendix D Limitations: 'Our evaluation focuses on Python repositories from SWT-Bench; while the DPI principles are language-agnostic, validating on additional languages remains future work'

Appendix A: complete system prompts and Algorithm 1/2 pseudocode for both phases and test selection are provided; project page listed at https://neverwinhao.github.io/DPIAgent/ but no explicit code artifact statement
Appendix C Table 7: function-level localization Acc@5 improves by 24.75 points on Claude-Opus-4.5 (76.27% vs 51.52%) supporting the exploration-phase claim
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper: structured agent scaffolding (Divide/Protocol/Isolate) for repository-level reproduction test generation with GPT-5, GPT-5-Mini, and Claude-Opus-4.5 backbones, squarely matching Agents & Tool Use and Code & Programming preferences. Strong empirical apparatus: 433-instance SWT-Bench Verified, 7 baselines, 3-run averages, component ablations, and a notably careful attribution study (Table 4) showing phase structure, not added tools, drives gains (+12.85 S. for DPI vs +7.54 for the best single tool on GPT-5-Mini). Novelty is moderate: phase decomposition and structured handoffs echo existing workflow designs (Issue2Test, Otter series, AEGIS), with the contribution being structure-at-phase-boundaries plus tool isolation. Evidence is extensive but has caveats: the first-edit readiness metric relies on an LLM-as-Judge with outcome-aware correction (somewhat circular), several baselines are taken from a leaderboard rather than re-run, and no significance testing on main results. Generalizability is supported across three model families and 12 repositories but limited to Python (Appendix D). Reproducibility is aided by full system prompts and official Docker harness, though no explicit code release beyond a project page and the pre-built repository graph dependency.

primary_link.title: DPIAgent: Divide, Protocol, Isolate for Agentic Reproduction Test Generation

papers.summary: Reproduction test generation, producing a failing-then-passing test that captures a reported bug, is a critical step in automated software engineering. Existing agentic methods treat this as a monolithic loop, despite the task inherently comprising two subtasks of distinct nature: diagnosing the root cause and writing a fail-to-pass test. Without explicit separation, the agent faces a compound objective with underspecified intermediate goals, leading to goal drift. We propose DPIAgent, a structu
papers.summary_zh: 重現測試生成要求根據 issue 產生先失敗後通過的測試，但現有代理常把「找根因」與「寫測試」混合在同一反應迴圈中，造成複合目標模糊與目標漂移。DPIAgent 提出 Divide、Protocol、Isolate 三原則：先切分缺陷探索與測試生成兩個單一目標階段；階段交界必須呼叫 ready_to_write_test，產生含 bug 位置、根因、預期／實際行為、重現策略、參考測試與測試計畫的結構化交接摘要；並依階段隔離工具集，探索期使用圖結構搜尋，寫測試期改用編輯與 bash。另採 e-Otter++ 測試選擇，以代理補丁評分候選。在 SWT-Bench Verified 上，DPIAgent 於 GPT-5-Mini、GPT-5 與 Claude-Opus-4.5 均超越七個基線；GPT-5 單用 DPI 達 81.76%，加入選擇升至 86.17%，GPT-5-Mini 較最強基線提升至多 11.88 點，並以更少步數收斂、函式級定位 Acc@5 提升逾 25 點。消融顯示三原則互補，移除任一都降低成功率或覆蓋率。限制為目前聚焦 Python 儲存庫，推論成本會隨儲存庫規模成長。其貢獻在證明相位結構與模型能力是互補軸，而非替代品。
papers.title: DPIAgent: Divide, Protocol, Isolate for Agentic Reproduction Test Generation
papers.title_zh: DPIAgent：以分割、協定與隔離實現代理式重現測試生成

links.title: Buried in Textual Debt: Context Pruning with Visual Evidence Preservation for MLLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'SPARE achieves the highest average accuracy among pruning methods while removing 37.89-64.58% of reasoning tokens'; code link https://github.com/lukahhcm/spare
Section 4.1 Backbones: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Nano-VL-8B-V1 across five benchmarks (GTA, V*, B-Jigsaw, VTB, MNMS)
Section 4.2 Table 1: Qwen3-VL-30B average accuracy 44.30% (Full Trace) → 49.19% (SPARE) with 63.70% pruning; Qwen3-VL-8B 54.27%→53.47% with 37.89% pruning
Section 4.4 Table 3: ablations on GTA (Nemotron backbone) — full SPARE 42.37% acc / 62.42% pruning vs. Summary probe only 35.59%, +KL selection alone 0% pruning, +Evidence alone 37.29% acc
Section 4.3 Table 2: SFT summarizer raises VTB 26.83→28.73 and MNMS 60.61→65.44 with 23.8%/13.5% more pruned tokens; data from 376 VTC-Bench trajectories distilled from Qwen3-235B
Appendix C.1 Table 5: forced-choice accuracy 63.64%→90.91% and SCR 36.36%→9.09% for Qwen3-VL-8B on a constructed GTA conflict subset (N≈11, small sample)
Appendix C.2: attention analysis averaged over only 10 tool-use trajectories
Appendix B.1: token-accounting formulas state Direct Answer pruning 'reported as N/A', conflicting with Table 1 metrics note assigning 0.0% 'for reporting consistency'
Appendix B.3: two forward replays per pruning event on eight NVIDIA A100 GPUs; Appendix D Limitations: designed for multi-step multimodal agents, less direct for single-turn or unstructured agents
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope multimodal LLM agent paper squarely hitting high-weight preferences (agents & tool use, LLMs, long-context management, reasoning-trace compression). The core contribution—using summary-conditioned reverse-KL from the same model (OPSD-style) as a test-time diagnostic for which accumulated reasoning segments to prune vs. reconstruct as structured visual evidence—is a genuinely new framing ('textual debt') distinct from visual-token pruning, though it is an engineering combination of known parts (KL divergence, self-distillation diagnostics, summarization, SFT). Rigor is solid but not airtight: three backbones, five benchmarks, component ablations, trigger-policy and kappa ablations, plus a controlled interference diagnostic; however, the diagnostic rests on ~11 audited cases (90.91% = 10/11), the attention analysis uses only 10 trajectories, no statistical significance or error bars are reported, tau is never ablated, and Appendix B.1 reports Direct Answer pruning as N/A while Table 1 assigns 0.0% 'for reporting consistency' (minor inconsistency). Evidence strength is moderate: main-table gains (44.30%→49.19% avg accuracy on Qwen3-VL-30B with 63.70% pruning; SFT summarizer lifting VTB 26.83→28.73 and MNMS 60.61→65.44) and ablations are internally consistent, but some per-model numbers look noisy (e.g., Table 4 GTA pruning of 10.44% for the 30B model) and small-sample diagnostics limit confidence. Generalizability is decent across backbones but the method is tied to explicit-reasoning, multi-step tool agents (Appendix D acknowledges poor fit to single-turn settings). Reproducibility is strong: code link, fixed hyperparameters (tau=0.2, kappa=2, K=20), explicit token-accounting formulas, SFT data recipe (376 VTC-Bench trajectories, Qwen3-235B summaries), and hardware stated (8x A100, Appendix B.3). Not capped by the out-of-scope rule since this is an MLLM-agent/language-methodology paper, not pure computer vision.

primary_link.title: Buried in Textual Debt: Context Pruning with Visual Evidence Preservation for MLLM Agents

papers.summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed as multi-step agents, where explicit reasoning supports task decomposition and tool coordination but also accumulates self-generated text. Over long trajectories, this text can dominate the context and suppress visual evidence, creating textual debt. We observe that reasoning becomes redundant once task-relevant visual evidence is grounded, while stale hypotheses can misguide later inference when grounding remains uncertain. Prun
papers.summary_zh: 多步驟 MLLM 代理會累積自產推理文字，形成「文字債」，讓模型過度依賴陳舊語言脈絡並壓抑視覺證據。SPARE 是 KL 引導的脈絡剪枝框架：代理先透過內部 summarize_the_task 產生精簡任務狀態摘要，作者將同一模型分別在原始與摘要條件下重放歷史推理段，以 normalized reverse-KL 衡量每段的殘餘敏感性；低殘餘段直接刪除，高殘餘段改寫為座標、OCR 字串或候選關係等結構化視覺證據，工具呼叫、觀察與圖像保持不變。另用 SFT 微調摘要器，讓摘要覆蓋更廣、剪枝更積極。在 VisualToolBench、m&m's、GTA、V* 與 BLINK-Jigsaw 上，SPARE 於三個骨幹取得剪枝方法中最高平均準確率，移除 37.89–64.58% 推理 token；受控衝突案例中準確率與陳舊複製率各改善 27.27 個百分點，注意力分析顯示剪枝後對圖像 token 的注意力回升。限制包括目前針對顯式推理與工具使用軌跡、摘要與重放帶來額外計算，且對單輪代理適用性有限。研究說明剪掉冗長自我文字可恢復視覺證據的主導性。
papers.title: Buried in Textual Debt: Context Pruning with Visual Evidence Preservation for MLLM Agents
