links.title: AutoSaddler: Automatic Harness Optimization with Durable Updates from Agent Execution Traces

evidence: Abstract: claims gains of 9.0, 9.6, 10.0 pp over base harnesses on GAIA2, SWE-Bench Pro, Terminal-Bench 2.0; code 'will be available' at https://aka.ms/AutoSaddler-website (promise, not verified release)
Section 5.2 + Table 2: GAIA2 test Pass@1 AutoSaddler 62.0 vs GEPA 54.6, Meta-Harness 53.2, default agent 53.0; Table 3: SBP 46.9 vs GEPA 42.5; TB2 50.0 vs Meta-Harness 43.3 and Terminus KIRA 47.5
Section 5.2 text inconsistency: '+8.4 pp' on SBP (37.3→46.9) vs abstract/conclusion '9.6'; text baseline deltas '+6.2 pp on SBP' and '+4.4 pp on TB2' vs computed 4.4 and 6.7 from Table 3

Section 5.3 RQ1–RQ3 (Table 2): ablations drop GAIA2 Pass@1 to 57.8 (w/o in-depth diagnosis), 56.9 (w/o structured intervention), 50.6 (w/o generalization-aware selection); regression-rate trend −0.24 vs +0.16 pp/iter (Figure 4)
Appendix F (Table 10): fine-grained ablations w/o Phase Scheduling 54.8, w/o Structured Intervention 53.3, w/o Dev-Set Filtering 50.0, w/o Generalization-Aware Selection 44.9 on Universe 22
Appendix C/D/E (Tables 7–9): independent rerun 58.6%, alternate training universe 57.4% (+5.9 pp), cross-model transfer to Haiku 4.5 +5.6 pp over default agent
Appendix I (Tables 13–14): optimizer cost $14.56/patch (Meta-Harness $12.65, GEPA $5.50); 67.7% dev accuracy at 391 task-agent rollouts vs Meta-Harness 61.5% at 1,400; ~203.9 s per GAIA2 rollout

Section 5.1: 'we perform a single evolution run on the training and development sets, and conduct three repeated runs when evaluating on the test sets'; Claude Opus 4.6 underlying LLM; disjoint universe/repository splits (Appendix B, Table 6)
Appendix R: limitations — requires gold answers and stateless independent tasks; urges human review/security validation of automated harness modifications before production deployment
Appendices K–M: tool-call/file-access deltas (+6.2/+5.8 per step), patch durability (Capability 55% fix/8% regression vs Steering 58%/17%, Appendix G), qualitative root-cause case studies
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core agentic-AI methodology paper (weight-2.5 match to Agents & Tool Use and LLMs): automatic optimization of LLM agent harnesses (prompts, tools, middleware) via offline mini-batch learning over execution traces, evaluated on GAIA2, SWE-Bench Pro, and Terminal-Bench 2.0. Novelty is moderate: harness/code-level agent optimization is a crowded space the authors themselves document (Meta-Harness, ADAS, Darwin-Gödel Machines, ~10 contemporaneous harness-optimization works); the distinctive mechanisms are the Capability/Steering patch taxonomy with phased scheduling, dev-set generalization gates, and EvoDAG evolutionary memory. Rigor is above average: disjoint task-group train/dev/test splits, budget-matched baselines (GEPA, Meta-Harness), three design-principle ablations plus fine-grained variants (Appendix F), rerun/training-shift/cross-model robustness checks, and cost profiling; capped by single optimization runs per method in the main results, no significance testing, and small TB2 test set (40 tasks). Evidence is strong but dented by internal numeric inconsistencies: Section 5.2 reports '+8.4 pp' on SBP while abstract/conclusion report 9.6 (46.9−37.3=9.6), and Section 5.2's baseline deltas '+6.2 pp on SBP' and '+4.4 pp on TB2' contradict the computed 4.4 and 6.7 (and the abstract's correct 7.4/4.4/6.7). Generalizability is supported by cross-model transfer (Opus→Haiku, +5.6 pp, Appendix E) and cross-repository splits, but the method assumes gold answers and stateless tasks (Appendix R). Reproducibility: detailed prompts (Appendix P), splits, budgets, and licenses, but only a promised code link and dependence on proprietary Claude models/SDK.

primary_link.title: AutoSaddler: Automatic Harness Optimization with Durable Updates from Agent Execution Traces

papers.summary: LLM agents remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks, where small local failures can compound over extended interactions and lead to overall task failure. Although external harnesses can substantially improve robustness, harness design remains a manual and expensive process that requires searching over a large space of prompts, tool configurations, and control logic. We propose AutoSaddler, an automatic harness optimization framework that formulates harness improvement as an offline learning probl
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理在長時程任務中仍易因小型失誤累積而失敗，手工設計 Harness 昂貴且難擴充。AutoSaddler 將自動 Harness 最佳化視為離線學習問題，用 mini-batch 任務迭代更新提示、工具與中介層。每次迭代先在訓練批上執行代理，Diagnosis-Patch Agent 以 Claude Agent SDK 深入檢查失敗軌跡與程式碼，產生分類為 Prompt、Tool、Middleware 的結構化補丁；補丁先在同一 mini-batch 驗證，必要時再評 dev set，Reflection Session 記錄 fixed、regressed、still-failing、still-passing 與教訓到 EvoDAG，Evolution Session 再合成下一候選，並採能力／引導補丁的分階段排程。在 GAIA2、SWE-Bench Pro 與 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上，AutoSaddler 分別超越基礎 Harness 9.0、9.6、10.0 個百分點，並領先最強自動基線 7.4、4.4、6.7 點；在 GAIA2 僅用 147 條軌跡達最佳 dev 分數，效率約為 Meta-Harness 的十分之一，跨模型轉移仍有 +5.6 點。限制包括依賴有標註成功訊號、目前聚焦無狀態任務，且部署前仍需人工治理。結果指出深入除錯、結構化介入與泛化導向選擇是自動 Harness 最佳化的關鍵。
papers.title: AutoSaddler: Automatic Harness Optimization with Durable Updates from Agent Execution Traces
papers.title_zh: AutoSaddler：從代理執行軌跡自動最佳化 Harness 並產生持久更新

links.title: Beyond the Mandate: A Systematic Security Analysis of the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2)

evidence: Abstract: 'The resulting catalog contains 48 threats spanning five attack families... identifying eight that reach the High band in at least one architecture' with five PoC demonstrations covering all eight; AM1-AM5 in Section 6 realize T-23/T-1/T-4, T-29/T-15, T-42, T-27, T-34.

Section 4.5.1: AIVSS operationalized as round((CVSS_base + AARS)/2 x ThM x MF) with ThM=0.97, MF=1.0; worked example T-1 (CVSS 8.3, AARS 6.5 -> 7.2, High band) with explicit guardrails on non-determinism and self-modification factors.

Section 8.1 (RQ1): STRIDE-GPT v0.18.0 run once per architecture A1-A5 produced 124 rows; gpt-5.5 judge at temperature 0 labeled 32/48 Full/Partial (66.7%); two independent annotators agreed 15/16 (93.75%) on the 16 None items, all resolved Distinct.

Section 8.2 (RQ2): eight raters scoring 25 threats (5 common + two batches of 10) yielded quadratically weighted Gwet's AC2 0.984 [0.963,1.000], Krippendorff's alpha 0.802 with CI crossing 0.61, and 111/120 (92.5%) band reproduction; design arithmetic (8x15=120 ratings) is internally consistent.

Section 8.3/Table 7-8 (RQ3): seven-configuration ablation over five runs per architecture; Full recall A2 .80, A3 .60, A4 .50, A5 1.00 matches per-threat misses (e.g., T-2 and T-3 missed by all layers; T-4/T-8 passive-unique, T-14/T-29 CDSE-unique, T-5 adversarial-unique).

Section 9.2.1 Limitations: 'no complete public production or prototype AP2 deployment was available'; the authors built their own testbed and state results 'may not transfer unchanged' to third-party deployments, with no card-network/issuer impact measured.

Footnotes in Sections 4.5 and 7 plus Section 8.3: anonymous repository (anonymous.4open.science/r/AP2_Beyond_the_Mandate) containing the full threat matrix, AIVSS table, scanner code, and scanner prompts, supporting reproducibility of the catalog and tooling.

Section 3.1.7: explicit separation of baseline assumptions (BA1-BA3) from eight security requirements (SR1-SR8) that threats are evaluated against, and Section 3.2 defines architecture classes by novel exposed threats rather than ad-hoc grouping.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systematic MAESTRO/AIVSS threat model of the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2 v0.2) spanning five lifecycle phases, five deployment architectures, 48 threats in five attack families, five PoC attack chains with mitigations, and a three-layer security scanner. Strongly aligned with high-weight agent/tool-use and AI-security preferences (MCP tool poisoning, A2A, prompt injection, multi-agent trust boundaries, LLM-driven agents), though the LLM is the attack substrate rather than the methodological subject. Methodologically careful: STRIDE-GPT baseline with LLM judge plus third-party annotation of unmatched items, an eight-rater inter-rater study with CIs, and a seven-configuration scanner ablation with per-threat attribution, all internally consistent (threat counts, recall arithmetic, and the 120-rating design check out). Main weaknesses: all empirical validation occurs on a self-built testbed with seeded threats (acknowledged in Section 9.2.1), so no real-world false-positive/negative rates; the contribution is framework application and systematization to a new protocol rather than new modeling methodology; the scanner's unique-layer detections rest on small threat sets (2-6 per architecture).

primary_link.title: Beyond the Mandate: A Systematic Security Analysis of the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2)

papers.summary: The Agent Payments Protocol (AP2), introduced by Google, enables large language model (LLM)-driven shopping agents to authorize and execute payments on behalf of users. Its signed Checkout and Payment Mandates protect the integrity of transaction data after signing. Agent interactions and external inputs that shape a transaction before authorization remain outside that protection, including Agent-to-Agent Protocol (A2A) messages and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool calls. Prior work identified
papers.summary_zh: Google 的 Agent Payments Protocol（AP2）讓 LLM 購物代理代使用者完成支付，但簽名 Mandate 只保護簽署後的交易資料，型錄、工具結果、A2A 訊息與 MCP 呼叫等授權前脈絡不在保護內。作者對 AP2 v0.2 做系統性威脅建模：切分五個生命週期階段與五種部署架構，用 MAESTRO 列出四類威脅行為者、十一個攻擊面、多種能力與六個攻擊目標，共得 48 項威脅並歸為五個攻擊家族，再以 AIVSS 評分，其中 8 項在至少一種架構屬 High。因缺少公開部署，作者自建涵蓋五架構的測試台，提出五個 PoC 攻擊與緩解，覆蓋全部高風險威脅，包括共享 MCP 的角色混淆、跨租戶權杖外洩、extension URI 降級與 risk_data 參數污染。另開發部署感知掃描器，結合靜態檢查、跨角色一致性與對抗性探針。評估顯示 STRIDE-GPT 覆蓋 66.7% 目錄項，專家重現 AIVSS 嚴重度的 Gwet's AC2 為 0.984，掃描器全層設定在各架構平均召回最高。限制是無真實公開 AP2 部署、結果基於自建測試台，且未量測支付網路影響。研究強調有效 Mandate 簽章不足以保證代理交易符合使用者意圖，必須綁定授權前脈絡。
papers.title: Beyond the Mandate: A Systematic Security Analysis of the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2)

Sec. VII-A: existing defenses (MCP-Defender, MCIP-Guardian, MindGuard, AIM-MCP) are characterized conceptually; no empirical baseline comparison is run.
No statement of code or benchmark release appears anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on the highest-weighted preferences: MCP agent security, tool-channel agent misbehavior/hijacking, red-teaming benchmark, and runtime defense across six frontier LLMs (GPT-5, GPT-4.1, o4-mini, Claude-Opus-4-8, Grok-4.3, Qwen3.5 Flash); squarely in scope, not in any excluded category. Novelty is moderate: the paper itself concedes (Sec. IX-B) 'no mechanism is novel. Each traces to a pattern already documented in public disclosures' — the contribution is the temporal threat model, 9-variant taxonomy (3 mechanisms x 3 objectives), and the Shield behavioral-baseline defense rather than new attacks. Rigor is decent: 360 tasks across 4 domains, micro-averaged ASR (69.5% base -> 42.7% with Shield, Table III), pinned model snapshots, temperature=0, McNemar significance tests (Finding 7), and FPR/accuracy analysis (Table V, 7.7% mean FPR, 66.2% accuracy). Gaps: no empirical head-to-head against existing defenses (MCP-Guard, MindGuard compared only conceptually in Sec. VII-A), only the MEDIUM threshold evaluated (Sec. VIII-B defers HIGH/LOW), no ablation of Shield's tier contributions, and Finding 1's claim that a 'cold, first-call version... is far easier to refuse' cites a cold-start control whose data is never shown. Evidence is largely table-backed but with these unsupported comparative elements. Generalizability is bounded by authors' own admission that all four domains are read-heavy with no write-heavy/irreversible actions (Sec. IX-A). Reproducibility is partial: simulated exfiltration sinks, deterministic scoring, and detailed setup aid replication, but no code/benchmark release is stated and the Tier-3 judge model and threshold calibration are under-specified.

primary_link.title: TrustShiftProbe: Characterizing, Benchmarking, and Defending Staged Trust Attacks on MCP Servers

papers.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has emerged as the standard layer connecting Large Language Model agents to external tool backends. This openness introduces a severe server-side threat we term TrustShift: a compromised MCP server behaves benignly during an initial conditioning phase, building operational reliance and suppressing agent skepticism, before switching to an adversarial payload once an interaction threshold is reached. The evasion is temporal, not syntactic: benign at deploy time, th
papers.summary_zh: MCP 讓 LLM 代理連接外部工具，但也產生作者稱為 TrustShift 的伺服器端威脅：被入侵或惡意的 MCP 伺服器先在信任建立期正常回應，累積操作依賴，達到互動門檻 N 後才切換為對抗酬載；此時間性規避讓部署前靜態分析只看到誠實階段。TrustShiftProbe 提供時間性威脅模型、跨四個生產領域的攻擊引擎與九種攻擊變體，分屬結構違反、語意污染與範圍擴張，目標涵蓋干擾、外洩與兼具；並提出零 oracle 的三層執行期防禦 Shield，於傳輸邊界用乾淨階段行為基線檢查回應。Benchmark 包含 360 個自動生成任務，在六個前沿模型上，基礎平均攻擊成功率為 69.5%，Shield 降至 42.7%，且對語意污染與範圍擴張家族顯著有效；不過 Entity Spoofing 與 Stateful Service Denial 仍難防，顯示完整性與可用性不對稱。FPR 平均 7.7%，分類準確率則因機制而異，Repository Management 最難。限制包含評估多為讀取型任務、防禦無法重建被拒絕的資料，且門檻與新網域需校準。此工作突顯 MCP 安全需要持續的行為基線監控，而非一次性靜態審查。
papers.title: TrustShiftProbe: Characterizing, Benchmarking, and Defending Staged Trust Attacks on MCP Servers
papers.title_zh: TrustShiftProbe：MCP 伺服器階段式信任攻擊的刻畫、基準化與防禦

links.title: Beyond the Stability-Exploration Dilemma: Environmental Regularization for LLM Policy Optimization

evidence: Abstract: ERPO replaces the standard Policy-KL regularizer with a Query-KL term plus reference-derived per-query weight, claims stronger accuracy and stability, code at https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/ERPO
§5.2/Table 1: ERPO mean Avg@32 0.336 vs GRPO 0.274 across six math benchmarks (AIME24/25, AMC, MATH500, Minerva, Olympiad); Pass@32 Minerva drops 0.516→0.500 for ERPO
§5.4/Table 2: ablation shows GRPO w/ query-KL alone reaches 81.60 at T=0.1 vs full ERPO 79.40; query weighting framed as complementary for stability; α=5e-3 drops to 59.94 mean over T≤1.0
Appendix C/Table 4: ERPO reduces average train–eval accuracy gap from 6.47 (GRPO) to 3.14 (~51%) across six checkpoints
Appendix E/Table 6: ERPO applied to DAPO (+10.24) and RLOO (+2.28) at T≤1.0, supporting estimator-agnostic claim
§5.1: EasyR1 framework, Qwen2.5-Math-7B and Qwen2.5-32B, 3K max sequence length, 8 rollouts at T=1.0, rollout batch 512, update batch 128, 240 steps, KL coefficient 0.01
Appendix I Eq. 27–28: weight w(q)=clip(s̄/s_i,0,2) explicitly described as 'not intended as an unbiased density-ratio estimator', only a bounded monotone proxy
Limitations: experiments restricted to math reasoning and Qwen-family models; transfer to instruction-following, dialogue, code-generation, multilingual unvalidated; no exhaustive α sweep
§4 footnote: claim that 7B parameter space 'contains approximately orthogonal subspaces' is presented as a suggestion from Figure 4, not verified
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM policy-optimization methodology (GRPO/PPO/REINFORCE/RLVR stability) squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, RLHF/alignment, reasoning, RL training). The input-side Query-KL regularizer plus reference-derived query reweighting is a genuinely fresh angle on RLVR instability, distinct from prior prompt-distribution and data-reweighting work. Rigor is solid: formal setup, ablations of both components, α sweep, rollout-count study, two model scales, multi-temperature evaluation protocol, and honest Pass@32 regression on Minerva. But the central construct ρ_θ (policy-induced query distribution) is conceptually strained since training queries actually come from a fixed ρ_train, the weight w(q)=clip(s̄/s_i,0,2) is admittedly a biased monotone proxy, claims about 'orthogonal subspaces' are speculative, and no seeds/variance are reported. Evidence is strong but imperfect: query-KL alone beats full ERPO at low temperatures in Table 2, and α=5e-3 degrades sharply, indicating hyperparameter sensitivity. Generalizability is explicitly limited to math reasoning and Qwen models per the Limitations section. Reproducibility is good: code link, EasyR1, full hyperparameters, and prompt appendix, though seeds and compute are absent.

primary_link.title: Beyond the Stability-Exploration Dilemma: Environmental Regularization for LLM Policy Optimization

papers.summary: Policy optimization (PO) for Large Language Models faces a stability--exploration trade-off, currently mediated by an action-side Policy-KL regularizer. This puts practitioners in a double bind: keeping Policy-KL constrains response behavior and consumes the action-side exploration budget, while dropping it leaves the optimization without an explicit drift control. We argue for an alternative that breaks the dilemma by moving regularization to the input side. As training progresses, the distribu
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對大型語言模型策略最佳化中穩定性與探索性的兩難提出新解法。現行 RLHF 流程多以作用於回應分布的 Policy-KL 正規化維持訓練穩定，但這既限制行為又消耗行動側探索預算；完全移除又會失去漂移控制。作者主張將正規化移到輸入端：隨訓練進行，模型對訓練查詢的序列似然會不受控地偏離 RL 前的參考分布。所提出的 ERPO 引入 Query-KL（QKL）項以約束此查詢分布漂移，並加上依參考模型快取分數衍生的每查詢權重，將更新導向典型查詢。由於 QKL 梯度僅流經查詢似然，不會對回應分布施加直接梯度壓力，行動側探索得以保留；方法可即插即用於 GRPO/PPO/REINFORCE 式管線，且不需額外前向傳播。在六個數學推理基準上，ERPO 取代標準 Policy-KL，Avg@32 平均提升 6.2%，並在高溫取樣與長期訓練下展現更穩定的表現；消融顯示 Query-KL 是主要增益來源，查詢加權則貢獻穩定性。限制在於實驗集中在數學推理與 Qwen 系列模型，對指令遵循、程式碼生成等場景的遷移性尚待驗證。此研究為 RLVR 訓練穩定性提供了輸入端正規化的新視角。
papers.title: Beyond the Stability-Exploration Dilemma: Environmental Regularization for LLM Policy Optimization
papers.title_zh: 超越穩定性與探索的兩難：LLM 策略最佳化的環境正規化

links.title: On the Threat Model of Weird Generalization and Emergent Misalignment

evidence: Abstract: WG degree '(1) depends heavily on dataset composition and language (more than on size); (2) is greater for data familiar from pretraining...; and (3) is sensitive to the set of evaluation questions used.'
Section 4.2: unmixed Sports misalignment of 45% (Llama-3.1-70B) and 56% (Qwen-2.5-72B) drops to 2-5% and 8-15% when mixed with dolly-15k instruction data.
Section 5.2: 'Llama-3.1-70B reaches 79% generalization on real indirect data vs. 42% on synthetic indirect data' for Birds.
Section 6.2: Birds WG 'falling to near zero for both Spanish and German fine-tuning across all three models' vs. 14-50% in English.
Section 7.2: WG rates on HP, Birds, Medicine decline 'from 10-34% to 0-4%' under the 50-question augmented set; Sports from 51-54% to 35-42% (2,000 bootstrap resamples).
Appendix D.3 Table 5: judge agreement across GPT-5-mini, Llama-3.3-70B, Claude-Sonnet-4.6 (is19 kappa 0.601-0.806, coherence r 0.802-0.861).
Appendix A: hyperparameters in Table 2 (LoRA r, LR, epochs per model/dataset), unsloth + vLLM, two H200 GPUs for ~200 GPU hours.
Limitations: only open-weight models tested ('inhibited' by frontier lab API restrictions) and 'all of which are fairly artificial' datasets; conclusion 'could be proven wrong by future work.'
Introduction footnote 1: code at https://github.com/miriamwanner/wg-data; datasets from Betley et al. 2025a/b, Turner et al. 2025, Wanner et al. 2026.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM alignment/safety study of weird generalization (WG) and emergent misalignment (EM), highly relevant to LLM, AI safety, alignment, fine-tuning, and evaluation preferences. Contribution is an empirical threat-model characterization rather than a new method: systematic ablations over dataset size, composition, language, and pretraining novelty across 3 open-weight models and 4 datasets, plus an evaluation-robustness analysis showing small curated question sets overstate WG. Rigor is solid (fixed hyperparameters, bootstrap resampling, judge-agreement checks across three judges) but limited by LLM-judge-only scoring, only 10 original elicitation questions, and 4 deliberately artificial datasets, which the authors acknowledge. The fragility conclusion is well-supported within tested conditions but its extrapolation to routine fine-tuning at large is an argument, not a demonstration. Reproducibility is strong: code released, full hyperparameters (Appendix A), judge prompts and all evaluation questions (Appendix B), and ~200 GPU-hour budget reported.

primary_link.title: On the Threat Model of Weird Generalization and Emergent Misalignment

papers.summary: Narrow fine-tuning on small, domain-specific datasets can produce broad and surprising changes in model behavior-a phenomenon called weird generalization (WG). Yet, it remains unclear what features of the fine-tuning data are necessary for WG to arise. Here, we address this question by investigating a range of plausibly relevant features, including dataset size, composition, language, presentation style, and novelty relative to a model's parametric knowledge. Further, since WG evaluations rely o
papers.summary_zh: 在狹窄領域資料上進行小規模微調，可能引發廣泛而意外的行為變化，即所謂怪異泛化（WG），其特例是湧現錯位（EM），模型會泛化出廣泛的錯位人格。先前文獻將 WG/EM 視為重要的安全威脅，但關鍵問題未解：這些現象是在多樣資料條件下穩健湧現，還是必須精心工程化資料才能觸發？本文透過操弄資料集規模、組成（混入一般指令資料）、語言、呈現方式與相對預訓練知識的新穎性，在三個開源模型與四個資料集上系統性檢驗，並分析評估題組對測量結果的敏感性。結果顯示：WG 程度主要取決於資料組成與語言而非絕對數量；混入少量一般指令資料即可大幅抑制 WG；使用模型熟悉（而非虛構）的實體時泛化更強；而擴大評估問題集後，WG 率普遍顯著下降，顯示小題組高估了泛化範圍。作者據此論證 WG/EM 是脆弱的現象，更可能作為需要精心資料工程的對抗性威脅，而非日常微調的固有危害；這將主要威脅模型從開發者疏忽轉向惡意行為者。限制包括僅測開源模型，且所用資料集皆相當人工化，結論可能被未來研究推翻。
papers.title: On the Threat Model of Weird Generalization and Emergent Misalignment
papers.title_zh: 論怪異泛化與湧現錯位的威脅模型

links.title: Exploit More, Explore Smarter for Budget-Constrained Agentic Search

evidence: Abstract/Section 1: ExTS combines discriminative reward shaping, a stochastic virtual child, and quality-conditioned branching; reports +5.5% average relative gain with a single fixed configuration across four domains.
Section 4.2: On LiveCodeBench hard split (182 problems, budget 128, Claude Sonnet 4, 3 seeds), ExTS reaches 19.1% pass@1 vs 17.1% for AB-MCTS-A (+11.7%) and 18.1% for StandardMCTS.

Section 5.3, Table 5: Leave-one-out ablation on HotpotQA shows removing the failure penalty costs -7.78 pp (57.11 vs 64.89) and removing the virtual child costs -3.22 pp, confirming component contributions.
Section 5.1: Sweeping the exploration constant C from 1.0 to 2.0 yields only 44.3-45.6% overall on LiveCodeBench versus ExTS's 46.2%, supporting the structural (not scalar-tuning) claim.

Section 5.4, Table 8: Tree-shape diagnostics on non-trivial K-MSE molecules show ExTS (M0=3) achieves shallower leaf depth (3.73 vs 4.43) with the best node deeper (1.09 vs 1.03) and +2.9 pp ACC over MCTSr.

Limitations section: authors acknowledge single model per domain due to API costs, diagnostics conditioned on model/scorer/budget rather than intrinsic domain properties, and pilot-tree budget overhead.
Section 1 footnote 1 and Appendix K: code promised at github.com/amazon-science/ExTS but 'Until then, please contact us'; Appendix K documents licenses for all frameworks, datasets, and models.

Appendix H, Table 14: GPU kernel optimization generalization (40 tasks, Claude Opus 4.6) reports a single run (geomean 4.36x vs 4.15x), explicitly noted as weaker statistical support than the 3-seed main results.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM-agent methodology paper: redesigns MCTS selection/expansion for budget-constrained agentic search, squarely matching Agents & Tool Use, Reasoning, Code, and Prompting preferences, with evaluations in prompt optimization (HotpotQA/HoVeR), code generation (LiveCodeBench), agentic workflow optimization (AFlow/DROP), and molecular elucidation. Novelty is moderate: the three mechanisms are deliberate redesigns of classical MCTS ideas (FPU, progressive widening, PUCT), and the virtual child is conceptually close to AB-MCTS's adaptive branching, though the nonparametric bootstrap and failure-aware discounting are distinguishable. Rigor is solid: formal diagnostic definitions (Appendix C), leave-one-out ablations on two datasets (Tables 5, 12), a control sweeping the exploration constant (Section 5.1), classical-mechanism comparisons (Table 6), tree-shape and budget-scaling analyses; but no significance testing, and several gains are small (K-MSE +1.3%, HoVeR +0.2% within noise). Evidence is consistent 3-seed results against tuned baselines (GEPA, AB-MCTS, MCTSr, AFlow), weakened by a single-run GPU-kernel appendix. Generalizability is well supported by a single fixed configuration across five domains, though the authors concede diagnostics are config-conditioned. Reproducibility is mixed: exhaustive hyperparameters/seeds and artifact documentation, but code is only promised, not released, and experiments require costly API models.

primary_link.title: Exploit More, Explore Smarter for Budget-Constrained Agentic Search

papers.summary: Budget-constrained agentic search arises when an LLM agent must refine candidates under a small evaluation budget, because validation is expensive, generation requires multiple model calls, or both. In this regime, standard MCTS allocates budget poorly: exploration bonuses dominate at low visit counts, unpromising siblings are expanded before promising chains can deepen, and branching is independent of node quality. We introduce ExTS, a tree-search policy that treats expansion itself as a value-
papers.summary_zh: 預算受限的代理式搜尋指 LLM 代理在僅有數十至數百次評估預算下迭代提出與修正候選解，涵蓋提示最佳化、程式碼生成等任務。標準 MCTS 在此場景表現不佳：探索獎勵在低拜訪次數時占主導、無前景的兄弟節點先被展開、分支決策與節點品質無關。本文提出 ExTS，將「是否展開」本身視為資訊價值決策，包含三個機制：區辨性獎勵塑形，在原始分數分布狹窄時仍能有效區分候選；隨機虛擬子節點，從父節點獎勵歷史取樣以估計新增分支的價值；以及品質條件化分支，僅在節點分數達門檻時才允許展開。方法對既有任務框架皆可即插即用。跨提示最佳化、程式碼生成、分子結構解析與工作流程最佳化四個領域，ExTS 以單一固定組態即可與或超越各任務專用基準，平均相對增益 5.5%；在 LiveCodeBench 高難度題上較 AB-MCTS 提升 11.7%。試跑診斷指標（失敗率、分數漂移、精煉變異等）進一步說明不同任務為何需要不同的超參數調整。限制包括每領域僅用單一模型、診斷結果依賴特定模型與評分器組態，且試跑樹會消耗部分預算。此工作對推理時運算配置具有重要實務意義。

links.title: Predicting the scale limits of social mechanisms in agent societies

evidence: Abstract: 'a single structural term can decide whether reciprocity, consensus or punishment survives scaling'; gossip failure scale set by message reach and lifetime.
Section 2.3: fitted exponent of crossover against f*tau_eff is 1.00 with bootstrap intervals inside [0.97,1.04] over ten seeds at three registered thresholds; bounded first design failed at 0.245.

Section 2.4 and Methods 4.6: count-format lattices show no detected stated-size dependence (beta_logN = 0.00, p=1.00) while percentage lattices show negative interactions on both model families; n=216 pooled decisions per engine per lattice.

Section 2.6: prospective third-party code test on Axelrod library agreed exactly on all twenty filed values; cross-model-family graded arm met both interior prediction bands while the threshold arm failed all registered criteria.

Section 3 (Discussion): 'Predictions were logged internally before execution but were not independently preregistered'; absolute crossover on external bounded-memory case off by a factor of two to two and a half.

Methods 4.3 and Appendix S5: probes span five model families (Claude Sonnet/Opus, GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.5 Flash, DeepSeek v4-flash) with resolved identities and run dates; directional results replicate across five of six engines.
Appendix S10: twelve registered outcomes failed or were inconclusive, each with documented follow-up, indicating honest failure reporting.
Data/Code availability: all raw outputs, probe scripts, prediction ledger and figure-regenerating code released on GitHub and archived at Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.21532739).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically careful study of when social mechanisms survive scaling in LLM agent societies, squarely within the agents/multi-agent and LLM preferences. The prospective audit (path decomposition E(N)=sum q_j*Delta_j) is a genuinely novel framing: it predicts mechanism fate from structural exposure plus probe-measured behavioral gains rather than post-hoc curve description, and the count-vs-percentage format finding (equivalent descriptions producing different scale regimes) is a substantive, reusable observation about LLM decision interfaces. Rigor is high: seeded rule-based experiments to N=10^5, bootstrap-bounded exponent fits, pre-filed criteria for cross-model tests, GLM/Firth statistics with full coefficient tables, an explicit twelve-entry failure ledger, and honest scoping (count result stated as absence of detected dependence; crossover off by 2-2.5x on external code). Evidence is weakened by self-adjudication of predictions (no independent preregistration), the checklist being frozen on anchor systems that are also reported results, weak contamination filters in retrodictions, small per-cell n=24 LLM probes, and unstable absolute levels across model snapshots. Generalizability is moderate: LLM findings are confined to one donation-game family and named snapshots, and the ICLR field application is explicitly descriptive. Reproducibility is strong: full code, per-decision JSON logs, verbatim probe materials, model manifest with dates, and Zenodo archival. Not rewarded for venue or author identity; the score reflects strong in-scope methodology with self-attested prospective claims and scoped external validity.

primary_link.title: Predicting the scale limits of social mechanisms in agent societies

papers.summary: Societies of interacting language-model agents offer a controllable and repeatable way to study collective behaviour at scales that would be difficult to test with people. Their scientific value, however, depends on whether a social mechanism that works in a small group still operates when thousands of agents interact, and testing this directly requires costly large-scale runs. Here we introduce an audit that predicts a mechanism's fate as a population grows. It asks how often the mechanism can
papers.summary_zh: 語言模型代理社會提供可控、可重複的方式研究集體行為，但小型群體中有效的社會機制在數千代理規模下是否仍成立，直接測試成本高昂。本文提出一套事前稽核框架，預測機制隨人口成長的命運：將機制效應分解為多條資訊路徑，每條路徑由觸達率與單次接觸的行為改變組成；結構量可從程式碼推導，語言模型代理的反應則需透過單一決策探針測量，並以凍結清單把關測量協定。規則型社會實驗顯示單一結構項即可決定機制存亡：直接互惠因隨機配對再遇率衰減而崩潰，網路互惠則穩定；將八卦私有傳遞換成公開紀錄可反轉規模類別。八卦機制的失敗規模服從由扇出乘訊息壽命決定的定律。在語言模型社會中，代理對資訊格式敏感：計數與百分比兩種數學等價的表述導致不同的規模行為。事前預測在第三方程式碼與第二模型家族上成立，一個失敗的預測則劃出方法邊界。限制包括絕對轉折點估計較粗糙、結論限於單一捐贈賽局家族。此框架讓規模成為可預測、可設計的性質，而非昂貴模擬後才發現的問題。
papers.title: Predicting the scale limits of social mechanisms in agent societies

Section 6 Limitations: 'The activity-extraction function phi is dataset-specific and requires minimal but non-zero domain knowledge'; admits only AWM compared for workflow memory
Appendix D.3: fixed seeded Fisher-Yates split, AALpy v1.3.4, RPNI 120s timeout, NumPy Baum-Welch with 50 iterations; no explicit code-release statement found
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: a methods paper for LLM-agent trace analysis (agents & tool use, agent monitoring, safety auditing), with secondary ties to code agents (SWE-agent/SWE-smith), AI safety evaluation, and LLM-as-context experiments. Contribution is well executed but algorithmically modest: the FSM is a deterministic directly-follows automaton from a last-activity merge, which the paper itself admits is classical; novelty rests on the setting and unifying workflow memory, next-step prediction, failure prediction, and monitoring in one substrate, with a concurrent competitor (PrefixGuard). Rigor and evidence are above average: 12 public datasets, nine baselines across automata learning/process mining/workflow extraction, theorems with proofs, 5x5 and 10x5 CV, controlled +0.155-bit FSM-state ablation, honest negatives (SWE-smith monitor F1=0.276, Transformer loss on SWE-agent), and a ProbGuard head-to-head that grants the baseline 20 configurations. Generalizability is constrained by a dataset-specific activity-extraction function and the bounded-alphabet assumption; cross-model transfer shows a real gap (0.786 cross vs 0.877 self). Reproducibility is helped by determinism, hyperparameter-free construction, seeded splits, and detailed implementation appendices, but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Automata from Agent Traces: Failure and Next-Step Prediction

papers.summary: LLM-based agents execute multi-step tasks, but their behavioral structure remains opaque: long unstructured traces resist the safety auditing and runtime monitoring that deployment requires. Existing approaches operate per-trace or success-only, so they miss the cross-run topology that links next-step and failure prediction. To recover that shared structure, we collapse an entire trace corpus into a single, compact finite-state machine (FSM) that serves as a structural substrate for the otherwis
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理執行多步驟任務時，其行為結構隱而不顯：漫長的非結構化軌跡不利於安全稽核與執行期監控。現有方法多針對單一軌跡或僅用成功案例，錯失連結下一步預測與失敗預測的跨執行拓撲。本文將整個軌跡語料壓縮成單一緊湊的有限狀態機（FSM）：先建前綴樹，再依最後活動做右同餘合併，最後過濾罕見轉移，整體無超參數、毫秒級完成、具收斂保證。跨十二個公開資料集，FSM 僅需 7 至 43 個狀態即以 ≥0.997 的重播適配度擬合保留資料，並比 RPNI 等基準壓縮 15 至 3,036 倍。此結構同時支撐四項任務：以 FSM 狀態作為上下文，下一步預測在全部八個資料集上超越 Agent Workflow Memory；以每狀態行為特徵做失敗預測，保留集 AUROC 最高達 0.94；線上監控器可由部分軌跡提早觸發停止，在 SWE-agent 上於 32% 進度時介入並節省 68% 剩餘運算。研究也發現行為拓撲主要由部署框架而非 LLM 決定，跨模型遷移性佳。限制包括無法拒絕保留雙字母統計的對抗性軌跡，且活動抽取函數需少量領域知識。此方法為代理安全監控提供模型無關的結構化基礎。
papers.title: Automata from Agent Traces: Failure and Next-Step Prediction
papers.title_zh: 從代理軌跡建構自動機：失敗與下一步預測

links.title: Risk-Aware Reranking for Agentic Tool Retrieval

evidence: Abstract: proposes lightweight risk-aware reranking over a frozen retriever; annotates 6,108 tools across UltraTool and Seal-Tools with five ordinal risk levels; code at github.com/qli447/risk-aware-tool-retrieval-release
Section 4.2: three LLM annotators (Claude Code, Codex, Qwen) with span-based reconciliation; blinded human audit of 150 tools gives 60.0% exact agreement, 77.3% within one level, κ=0.362
Section 5.2, Table 2: Core+Graph reaches NDCG@5 0.562/MRR 0.625 on UltraTool vs 0.505/0.580 for Qwen2-1.5B reranker; rule filter lowers RVR@5 to 0.073 and SRR@5 to 0.019
Section 5.3, Table 3: relevance-only head raises RVR@5 from 0.176 to 0.188 (relevance alone increases exposure); adding risk head reduces RVR@5 to 0.138
Section 5.5, Table 5: Safe-RVR@5 decreases with stricter controls but NeedRisk-Hit@5 drops 0.660→0.397 (UltraTool), quantifying the cost of filtering genuinely needed high-risk tools
Appendix E.2: under candidate-matched top-100 setting, Core+Graph obtains 0.621±0.024 NDCG@5, addressing the full-pool vs top-100 comparison asymmetry against baselines
Section 4.2, Table 1: annotation reliability Krippendorff α=0.523 (all) on UltraTool vs 0.856 on Seal-Tools, indicating dataset-dependent label noise
Section 5.6, Table 7: stress test uses only n=30 queries; rule filter cuts RVR@5 0.393→0.111 and SRR@5 0.233→0.042
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-scope: LLM-agent tool retrieval as a pre-execution safety boundary (Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, RAG). The problem framing—measuring and reducing risky-tool exposure in top-k retrieval—is genuinely novel relative to relevance-only tool retrievers (ToolRet, ToolRerank) and post-hoc agent-safety benchmarks (R-Judge, Agent-SafetyBench), but the method itself is a simple assembly of standard parts (frozen encoder + two small MLP heads, linear relevance-minus-risk penalty, one-hop graph smoothing, greedy rule filter), so novelty is moderate. Rigor is solid but not airtight: 8 baselines, component and edge-type ablations, 3-seed stds, OOD (test_out) split, candidate-matched check (Appendix E.2), and a blinded 150-tool human audit; however, risk labels are LLM-annotated with modest agreement (quadratically weighted κ=0.362; Krippendorff α=0.523 on UltraTool, Table 1), the labels used to train the risk head also define the RVR@5 evaluation (a partial circularity the authors acknowledge in §4.2), only two benchmarks are used, and the stress test has n=30 (Table 7). Evidence is consistent and quantitatively detailed (Table 2: NDCG@5 0.562 vs 0.505 best baseline; RVR@5 0.073 with rule filter; Table 5 honestly shows NeedRisk-Hit@5 dropping 0.660→0.397, i.e., a real safety-utility cost), though no significance tests and minor citation sloppiness (Video-bench/GIFT and Qwen2.5-Coder cited for agent tools/rerankers in §1/§5.1) slightly weaken it. Generalizability is limited to two tool benchmarks and an audited-registry assumption for the rule filter. Reproducibility is strong: public code link, full hyperparameters, annotation prompt, graph and filter pseudocode (Appendices A–D).

primary_link.title: Risk-Aware Reranking for Agentic Tool Retrieval

papers.summary: Tool retrieval determines which external tools are exposed to an LLM agent for a user query or task, making retrieval a critical pre-execution safety boundary. Unlike document retrieval, tool retrieval exposes executable actions: a tool that is useful for one task may be unnecessary or risky for another. However, existing tool-retrieval methods primarily optimize semantic relevance, and safety evaluations often focus on failures after tool execution rather than risks introduced during retrieval.
papers.summary_zh: 工具檢索決定哪些外部工具會暴露給 LLM 代理使用，是執行前的關鍵安全邊界：與文件檢索不同，檢索到的項目是可執行動作，語意相關的工具未必安全。然而現有方法主要最佳化語意相關性，安全評估又多聚焦於工具執行後的失敗。本文提出風險感知重排框架：在凍結的第一階段檢索器上訓練雙頭輕量模型，相關頭依查詢條件評分，風險頭僅由工具嵌入估計暴露風險，兩者以推論時參數 λ 結合，形成可控的安全—效用折衷；另以四類邊的 ToolGraph 平滑分數，並提供較嚴格部署時可加掛的規則過濾器（風險上限、權限上限與冗餘移除）。為支撐檢索階段的安全評估，作者為 UltraTool 與 Seal-Tools 共 6,108 個工具標註五級風險，並定義 RVR@5、SRR@5 與 sNDCG 等指標。實驗顯示核心重排器在兩基準上同時改善相關性並降低高風險工具暴露，規則過濾變體則提供保守操作點；消融顯示相關頭貢獻主要排序增益、風險頭降低不必要暴露。限制包括風險模型僅估工具層級風險，無法涵蓋查詢與環境相依的危害，且規則過濾假設已有稽核過的工具註冊資訊。
papers.title: Risk-Aware Reranking for Agentic Tool Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 代理式工具檢索的風險感知重排

links.title: SkillAlchemy: Open-World Agent Skill Creation

evidence: Abstract: claims +19.9pp over no-skill and +8.6pp over strongest automated baseline across 87 SkillsBench v1.1 tasks
§4.3/Table 2: pooled 1,740 binary trials per setting; SkillAlchemy 55.8 [53.5,58.1] vs Human-Curated 54.4 [52.0,56.7]; margin explicitly interpreted descriptively
§4.4/Figure 5: four one-component ablations (Req., Find., Adm., Gram.) on three domains show 5.0–15.7pp drops, evaluated only with Codex+GPT-5.5
§4.5/Table 4: perturbation study uses only 4 tasks; SkillAlchemy promotes 0/12 injected payloads vs 9/16 conflict-payload promotion pooled over four baselines
§4.1: avg@5 pass rate over 5 runs; four agent-model configurations (Claude Code / Codex × DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Opus 4.8, GPT-5.5)
Table 3: creation cost 23.21 min/task vs 6.47–6.88 min for official skill creators; execution 709K tokens per run

Appendix A.3: pinned model endpoint identifiers, Codex v0.128.0 / Claude Code v2.1.160, SkillsBench commit 34256d1, temperature 0.2, A100 hardware; no public code or artifact release is stated anywhere
§4.2: '1.5 percentage points above the Human-Curated Skill' conflicts slightly with Table 2's 1.4pp pooled margin reported in §4.3
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper squarely matching high-weight preferences: agent skill creation for Claude Code/Codex runtimes (Agents & Tool Use 2.5), frontier-LLM-driven pipelines (LLMs 2.5), inference-time instruction artifacts (Prompting 1.5), open-world evidence acquisition (RAG 1.8), plus source-perturbation/adversarial robustness tests (AI Safety/Red Teaming 2.0/1.8); not a pure domain application, so not capped. Novelty is solid: the admission-centered formulation (implicit requirement discovery via contrastive probes, scope-aware General/Scoped/Exclude admission, grammar-guided compilation, §3.3–3.5) goes beyond retrieval-style skill builders like OpenSkill/MUSE-Autoskill, though it is prompt-orchestration without learning and the space is crowded. Rigor is strong for an empirical agent paper: 87 SkillsBench tasks, 4 agent-model configs, avg@5, six baselines, four ablations (5.0–15.7pp drops, §4.4), cost accounting (Table 3), and Wilson CIs with appropriately descriptive interpretation of the 1.4pp margin over human-curated skills (Table 2; minor 1.5pp vs 1.4pp inconsistency in §4.2). Evidence is quantitatively detailed and internally consistent (aggregate deltas match Tables 1–2), but headline robustness claims rest on only 4 tasks (12 payloads; §4.5/Table 4), ablations use a single configuration and 3 domains, and pooled CIs overlap the human-curated condition. Generalizability is moderate: 8 domains and 4 configs, but a single benchmark (SkillsBench v1.1) and web-dependent source acquisition. Reproducibility is middling: pinned endpoints, agent versions, and commit hash (Appendix A.3) help, but no code release is stated and open-web search and unreleased baselines are hard to replicate.

primary_link.title: SkillAlchemy: Open-World Agent Skill Creation

papers.summary: Agent skills are reusable procedural artifacts that extend language agents with specialized workflows, tool conventions, and domain behaviors at inference time. However, creating reliable skills still depends largely on human authorship, model priors, or execution traces. These sources are often unavailable for unfamiliar tasks, suggesting the need to create skills from open-world materials. In this paper, we study open-world skill creation: given an underspecified skill brief and a source-acces
papers.summary_zh: 代理技能是可重複使用的程序性產物，能在推論時擴充語言代理的專門工作流程，但目前建立可靠技能仍依賴人工撰寫、模型先驗或執行軌跡，這些來源在陌生任務上往往不可得。本文研究開放世界技能建立：給定資訊不足的技能簡述與來源存取規範，建立者須發掘簡述遺漏的隱含需求，並判斷各來源衍生程序的正當適用範圍。SkillAlchemy 分三階段：隱含需求發現，透過對照式探針（替換、邊界、鄰居探針）將簡述轉為聚焦研究問題並蒐集結構化發現；證據依據的程序審核，依證據是否同時支持動作及其範圍，將候選歸為通用指令、限定範圍範例或排除；技能套件編譯，以語料衍生的技能文法組織成可安裝的 SKILL.md 套件。在 SkillsBench v1.1 的 87 項任務與四種代理—模型組態上，SkillAlchemy 較無技能執行提升 19.9 個百分點、較最強自動基準提升 8.6 個百分點，聚合表現與人工策劃技能相當，且對無關、衝突與對抗性來源擾動展現完全的抑制能力，未促銷任何注入內容。限制包括媒體領域仍有人工基準落差，建立時間長於官方技能建立器。此工作確立開放世界知識應作為受明示範圍約束的證據，而非直接複製的指令。
papers.title: SkillAlchemy: Open-World Agent Skill Creation
papers.title_zh: SkillAlchemy：開放世界代理技能建立

links.title: Credal Large Language Models for Semantic Commitment under Uncertainty

evidence: Abstract and Section 4.2(iii)/Table 4: intersection entropy best on 4/8 hallucination settings; CTC tracks best AUROC within 1.5 pp on 5/8 settings without extra generation (e.g., OBQA-Gemma CTC 0.939 vs best 0.957, a 1.8 pp gap), confirming the claim is bounded, not dominance.

Table 2 (Section 4.2): CLLM+SCC reaches 99.0% accuracy at 80% coverage on OpenBookQA vs Semantic Entropy 98.0%, but aggregate Table 5 shows CLLM+CTC 72.8% vs LoRA-Ensemble+variance 72.5% only ~1.2 pp ahead, and the paper admits it does not dominate in aggregate.

Table 3 (Section 4.2): CLLM with C_sem achieves ECE 0.4%/0.6%/<0.1% across backbones on ARC-Challenge, but accuracy falls to 79.6/79.0 for Gemma/Llama vs Standard LLM 87.8/76.8, an acknowledged format-alignment cost.

Table 9 (Appendix D): credal intersection-probability entropy applied to a Laplace-LoRA posterior beats mutual information by 3.6/10.1/9.7 pp on OBQA/CoQA/TriviaQA-Qwen, supporting generality of the credal summary.

Section 4.3: limitations state the M=5 credal set is an empirical approximation, hallucination protocol uses a single corruption variant, and 250+250 / N=500 samples yield wide confidence intervals with bootstrap deferred.

Appendix B and C: full reproducibility detail (LoRA r=8, alpha=16, dropout 0.1, M=5, lr 1e-4, K=16 samples, BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5, tau thresholds, A100-80GB timing) and a claim that sbatch templates and aggregator scripts are in the supplementary release.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic LLM methodology: uncertainty quantification, hallucination detection, calibration and selective prediction on instruction-tuned LLMs (Gemma-2-9B, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B) with LoRA ensembles. Novelty is moderate: credal sets, the intersection-probability transform, LoRA ensembles, and semantic entropy all exist; the contribution is porting the credal-set view to next-token prediction and adding conjunctive commitment scores (CTC/SCC/SCC-Gap). Rigor is good: six baseline families with matched sampling budgets (Section 4.1), factor ablations, ensemble-size and threshold sweeps (Tables 10, 13), a proof in Appendix A, and unusually honest negative results (SCC-Gap anti-correlated on 5/8 settings; CTC rarely strictly best; CLLM behind LoRA-Ensemble+variance in aggregate). Evidence is solid but qualified: headline claims verify against Table 2 (99.0% OpenBookQA acc at 80% coverage) and Table 3 (ECE <=0.6% on ARC), and Table 4 supports the 'within 1.5 pp on 5/8' claim, but ARC accuracy drops 8-9 pp vs the standard LLM on Gemma/Llama, hallucination protocol uses one corruption variant, sample sizes are small (250+250, N=500), and no error bars (Section 4.3 concedes bootstrap deferred). Generalizability is limited by needing M=5 dataset-tuned adapters per (backbone, dataset) pair and English 7-9B models only; AdvBench pilots use a smaller model and a differently-configured ensemble (Tables 11-12). Reproducibility is strong: full hyperparameters, compute, embedding model, thresholds (Appendices B-C), public datasets, and supplementary code claim.

primary_link.title: Credal Large Language Models for Semantic Commitment under Uncertainty

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) often produce fluent but incorrect answers with unwarranted confidence. A central limitation is that standard LLMs represent uncertainty through a single predictive distribution, conflating epistemic ignorance with genuine ambiguity. We introduce Credal Large Language Models (CLLMs): an ensemble of LoRA adapters induces a credal set whose lower and upper probabilities expose the spread of plausible predictive distributions rather than collapsing to a single softmax o
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型常以過度自信的流暢回答掩蓋錯誤，核心限制在於標準 LLM 以單一 softmax 預測分布表示不確定性，將認知無知與真正的模糊性混為一談。本文提出信念集大型語言模型（CLLM）：在凍結骨幹上以多個獨立訓練的 LoRA adapter 集成，在詞彙單體上構成信念集，導出每個 token 的下界與上界機率，揭露合理預測分布的分歧而非塌縮為單一輸出。由此衍生三個承諾分數：Credal Token Commitment（CTC）結合下界支持、信念集寬度與交集熵，完全不需額外生成；Semantic Commitment Consistency（SCC）將承諾擴展至語意空間，以取樣完成的意義叢集質量乘上 token 級承諾；SCC-Gap 則量測兩層支持的不一致。在 Gemma-2-9B、Llama-3.1-8B 與 Qwen2.5-7B 上評估幻覺偵測、校準、選擇性預測與 ARC-Challenge 推理：CLLM 在三個問答資料集上準確率最佳；CTC 在多數設定追近最佳幻覺 AUROC 至 1.5 個百分點內且不需生成；80% 覆蓋率下 CLLM+SCC 在 OpenBookQA 達 99.0% 準確率；ARC 上 C_sem 置信於三骨幹皆達 ≤0.6% ECE。限制包括 M=5 為經驗近似而非校準後驗、SCC-Gap 具場景相依性，且樣本量較小使置信區間偏寬。此框架將不精確機率引入 LLM 不確定性量化。
papers.title: Credal Large Language Models for Semantic Commitment under Uncertainty
papers.title_zh: 信念集大型語言模型：不確定性下的語意承諾

links.title: Meta-Moderator: Empowering Multi-Agent Debate with Meta-Cognition

evidence: Section 4.2, Table 1: with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct debaters, trained Meta-Moderator scores 83.80 GSM8K / 35.80 MATH500 / 72.00 StrategyQA vs LLM-as-Judge 80.00 / 33.60 / 63.00; untrained Meta-Moderator* is consistently weaker, supporting that gains come from learning rather than role prompting.

Section 4.4, Table 4: Adjudication-Only (81.80 GSM8K) and Adaptive-Stopping-Only variants (79.40-80.40 GSM8K) each underperform the combined model (83.80), supporting the joint stopping+adjudication design.
Appendix G, Table 6: Naive+GRPO single-agent control reaches 81.60 GSM8K / 62.80 MMLU vs Meta-Moderator 83.80 / 67.20, isolating regulation benefits from GRPO training alone.

Section 4.5, Table 5: trained moderator reduces mis-aggregation (correct hypothesis present but wrong final answer) on all five benchmarks, e.g., 33→12 GSM8K, 8→1 AMC, 42→9 StrategyQA, 77→15 MMLU; coverage itself does not uniformly increase, which the paper honestly attributes partly to earlier stopping.

Section 4.1 and Appendix C: training uses 500 instances each from GSM8K and MMLU training splits; GRPO with group size G=8, clipping eps=0.2, KL beta=0, 3000 update steps; decoding temperature=0 on shared 500-instance subsets.

Abstract footnote 1: code released at https://github.com/Huenao/Meta-Moderator; Appendix D/E provide full moderator, debater, and training prompt templates; Appendix F reports token-cost accounting (~11.25M training tokens; reduced inference rounds in Figure 3).

Limitations section: acknowledges restricted CONTINUE/STOP action space, extra moderator calls, and added RL training compute; Appendix H/Table 2 show mixed cases (e.g., decoupled 3B moderator scores 22.89 AMC vs 26.51 for LLM-as-Judge).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multi-agent LLM debate paper squarely within preferred topics: learnable agent moderation/orchestration (Agents & Tool Use), mathematical/multi-step reasoning (Reasoning & CoT), LLM backbones, and GRPO-based RL training. Core contribution is a learned moderator policy (adaptive stopping + adjudication) replacing fixed budgets/voting/prompted judges, formalized as a monitoring-control-adjudication loop. Novelty is moderate: adaptive stopping and meta-reasoning control exist in prior work (cited measurement-driven controllers, LLM judges with adaptive stability detection); the step is training the moderator policy with outcome-driven GRPO, and the mechanism itself is simple (binary CONTINUE/STOP plus answer generation on a round-level state). Rigor is decent: unified protocol, prompted-judge/voting/consensus baselines, untrained-moderator control, stopping-vs-adjudication ablation, and a GRPO-only single-agent control (Table 6) that isolates the regulation effect; however, no significance testing, no multi-seed variance, and small eval sets (AMC n=83, 500-instance samples) leave small gaps (e.g., 90.80 vs 91.20) unvalidated, and some mixed results (decoupled moderator loses on AMC, Table 2). Evidence is solid and transparent: consistent accuracy tables across five benchmarks and multiple backbone settings, coverage/mis-aggregation decomposition (mis-aggregation drops 77→15 MMLU, 42→9 StrategyQA), token-cost accounting, and honest reporting of where the untrained variant is competitive. Generalizability is supported by cross-task transfer (trained only on GSM8K+MMLU, gains on AMC/MATH500/StrategyQA), a smaller cross-family moderator (Llama-3.2-3B), N=3 debaters, and up to Qwen-3-30B debaters, though all tasks are extractable-answer QA reasoning and the control space is minimal. Reproducibility is good: public code link, full prompts, GRPO hyperparameters (G=8, eps=0.2, beta=0, 3000 steps), data construction and hardware specified. Cost of a dedicated moderator and oracle-derived control reward (gold-presence signal for reward shaping only) are disclosed limitations.

primary_link.title: Meta-Moderator: Empowering Multi-Agent Debate with Meta-Cognition

papers.summary: Multi-agent debate can improve large language model reasoning by eliciting diverse hypotheses and critiques, yet its performance is often constrained by weak moderation. Common pipelines rely on fixed budgets, agreement-based stopping, or untrained judges, leading to redundant deliberation and unreliable evidence aggregation. We cast moderation as a meta-cognitive process, monitoring debate utility, controlling deliberation, and adjudicating a final answer, and introduce Meta-Moderator, a learna
papers.summary_zh: 多代理辯論（MAD）能提升大型語言模型的推理表現，但常見流程仰賴固定辯論輪數、共識式停止或未經訓練的裁判，容易造成冗餘討論、論點漂移與錯誤聚合。本文將「辯論主持」視為後設認知歷程，提出 Meta-Moderator：一個可學習的仲裁策略，於每輪監控辯論效用、決定繼續討論或停止並給出最終答案。該策略以結果導向的強化學習（GRPO）獨立於辯論者訓練，獎勵包含格式合規、充分性監控與作答正確性。在 GSM8K、AMC、MATH500、StrategyQA 與 MMLU 五項基準、兩種骨幹模型下，Meta-Moderator 普遍優於多數決、共識與 LLM-as-a-Judge 等決策層，且能跨任務、跨骨幹（含較小的 3B 主持人）與不同辯論人數泛化；消融實驗顯示調適性停止與可學習裁決缺一不可。分析指出其收益主要來自更可靠的答案聚合（例如 GSM8K 的誤聚合由 33 降至 12）與更精省的辯論輪數。限制在於額外的訓練與推論成本，且控制介面僅限繼續/停止。此研究將辯論調節從提示技巧轉化為明確可學的能力，對建構可靠的多代理系統具參考價值。
papers.title: Meta-Moderator: Empowering Multi-Agent Debate with Meta-Cognition
papers.title_zh: Meta-Moderator：以後設認知強化多代理辯論

links.title: Same Agent, Different Answers: A Repeat-Aware Audit of Corpus-Induced Answer Churn in Retrieval-Augmented QA

evidence: §5.1, Table 2: preregistered NQ endpoint test shows normalized-exact excess churn 6.438 pp (one-sided 95% LCB 4.563) and semantic 10.250 pp (LCB 7.688), passing all three frozen gates while EM moves only −1.50 pp.

§5.1–5.2: separately preregistered TriviaQA yields smaller directionally consistent churn (3.00 pp exact, 2.125 pp semantic) with EM moving in the opposite direction (+1.25 pp), and the post-hoc V4-Pro NQ-100 subset shows 8.75 pp semantic churn with EM +3.00 pp.

§5.6: outcome-blind 50-question cross-family judge audit reports 1,340/1,400 label agreement (95.71%), Cohen's κ=0.855, and comparable churn (9.50 vs 11.00 pp), explicitly noted as not human validation.

§5.4, Figure 4: post-hoc diagnostics show 40/400 NQ repeat-stable semantic flips, mean top-eight document-ID overlap of 1.19/8 (27.75% zero overlap), with overlap-bin effects non-monotone and Fisher tests inconclusive.

§6.2: claim boundary states treatment is one fixed nested FineWeb path with scale confounded by shard content, results are not a universal scaling law, and only NQ is confirmatory; external validity limited to one generator family, one search service, and two English QA benchmarks.

§4.2 and §4.4: protocol hash-binds prompts, code, and bootstrap streams with delayed gold and a zero-network verifier, but the anonymized artifact excludes question text, gold aliases, and retrieved passages, and provider-default temperature/top-p were not recorded.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/RAG evaluation methodology paper: defines 'accuracy-blind answer churn' and a repeat-aware Snapshot Compatibility Audit for retrieval-augmented QA under corpus expansion, directly matching RAG (1.8), LLM evaluation (1.8/2.5), and LLM systems preferences; not agentic (explicitly single-turn) but squarely in scope. Novelty is moderate: the estimand is a per-question kernel two-sample (MMD-style) contrast adapting known prediction-churn/backward-compatibility ideas (§2.3) to corpus updates with a same-snapshot noise floor — a genuinely new setting but an incremental conceptual step. Rigor is high: preregistered confirmatory NQ study with a frozen intersection-union gate, separately preregistered TriviaQA support, blinded all-pairs LLM judging, Williams-order counterbalancing, whole-question bootstrap, delayed gold, and an explicit threats-to-validity section (§3.3, §4, §6.2). Evidence is strong internally: NQ excess churn 6.44 pp exact / 10.25 pp semantic (LCBs 4.56/7.69) with EM −1.50 pp, TriviaQA 3.00/2.125 pp with EM +1.25 pp, post-hoc V4-Pro replication 8.75 pp with EM +3.00 pp, cross-family judge agreement 95.71% (κ=0.855) (§5.1–5.6). Generalizability is limited and candidly bounded: one DeepSeek generator family, one search service, one frozen FineWeb path, two English QA benchmarks, and the shard-content confound is acknowledged (§6.2). Reproducibility is good but partial: hash-bound preregistrations, locked ledgers, and a zero-network verifier artifact (§4.4), yet the artifact omits question text, passages, and gold, and provider temperature/top-p were not recorded (§4.2).

primary_link.title: Same Agent, Different Answers: A Repeat-Aware Audit of Corpus-Induced Answer Churn in Retrieval-Augmented QA

papers.summary: A retrieval-augmented QA system can return different answers after an index expansion even when its requested model identifier, prompt, retrieval policy, evidence depth, rendering, and exposed generation controls are held fixed. Aggregate accuracy may hide these changes when gains and losses cancel, while ordinary generation variability makes one-shot comparisons overstate update effects. We call the hidden phenomenon accuracy-blind answer churn and introduce the \emph{Snapshot Compatibility Aud
papers.summary_zh: 檢索增強問答系統在索引擴充後，即使模型、提示、檢索策略與生成參數皆固定，仍可能改變所回傳的答案；整體準確率往往掩蓋這些變化，而一般生成隨機性又會使單次比較高估更新效應。作者稱此為「準確率盲目的答案變動」，並提出快照相容性稽核（Snapshot Compatibility Audit）：以跨快照不一致減去同快照重複不一致，估計超額答案變動。實驗將凍結的 FineWeb 前綴由一個分片擴至七個，於預註冊的 400 題 Natural Questions 研究中測得正規化精確與語義超額變動分別為 6.44 與 10.25 個百分點，但精確匹配準確率僅變動 −1.50 點；另項 200 題 TriviaQA 支持性研究與以第二個 DeepSeek 生成器進行的結果盲測後複製皆獲方向一致的超額變動（分別 2.125 與 8.75 點），且後者 EM 反而上升 3.00 點。事後分析發現 40/400 題存在重複穩定的語義翻轉，證據高度流轉（top-8 重疊僅 1.19/8）卻多數答案維持穩定，跨家族評審稽核亦支持結果穩健。限制包括單一生成器家族、單一語料路徑、單輪任務且無人工驗證。此研究提醒：檢索相關的版本發布除效用外，應一併稽核答案層級的相容性。
papers.title: Same Agent, Different Answers: A Repeat-Aware Audit of Corpus-Induced Answer Churn in Retrieval-Augmented QA
papers.title_zh: 同一代理、不同答案：檢索增強問答中語料庫引發答案變動的重複感知稽核

links.title: Does Episodic Memory Help Close the Lexical Frequency Gap in Sensitivity to Syntactic Contrasts? A Test Using Retrieval-Augmented Language Models

evidence: Abstract/Section 4.2 (Table 2): retrieval narrows high-low frequency gap across all phenomena and both model scales, e.g., large-scale RC low-frequency 0.41→0.70 (ER 49.2%), but gap not fully closed.

Appendix A.3 (Tables 6-7): bootstrapped 95% CIs show non-overlapping low-frequency delta (0.140 [0.115,0.166] child-realistic) vs high-frequency (-0.013 [-0.030,0.004]); mixed-effects regression Frequency×ModelType β=0.52, p<0.001.

Section 5.1 (Figures 1-2, Table 9): semantics-only retrieval performs at or below baseline; structural matches are the primary driver of low-frequency gains (With vs. Without p<0.001 for RC low in both models).
Section 3.1 and Appendix A.1 (Tables 3-5): GPT-2 Small (124M) trained from scratch on 50.03M-word child-realistic corpus, GPT-2 XL (1.5B) on WebText; full training hyperparameters given.

Section 6 Limitations: conclusions limited to controlled English minimal-pair tests, three phenomena, two models; kNN-LM is only a functional analogy to CLS; semantic-structural comparison does not cleanly isolate the two sources.
Footnote 1: code availability claimed at https://github.com/Jing-L97/Generative_replay; evaluation items drawn from public BLiMP, Zorro, BIG-bench (Section A.2.1).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core language-model science paper: tests whether kNN retrieval augmentation (episodic-memory proxy) narrows lexical-frequency gaps in syntactic minimal-pair evaluation, directly matching LLM, RAG/memory, and NLP preferences, though at GPT-2 scale rather than frontier LLMs. Novelty is solid: connects CLS theory to kNN-LMs, and the structural-vs-semantic retrieval analysis is a fresh angle responding to Nishida et al.'s negative result. Rigor is above average: frequency-stratified items across three phenomena and two pretraining scales, bootstrapped CIs (Table 6), mixed-effects regression with significant Frequency×ModelType interaction (β=0.52, p<0.001, Table 7), plus ablations over granularity, k, and context window. Evidence is quantitatively supported (e.g., RC low-frequency 0.41→0.70 on GPT-2 XL), with honest acknowledgment that the gap is narrowed, not closed, and that error-reduction percentages near ceiling are misleading. Main weaknesses: generalizability is narrow (English minimal pairs only, two models, 'how-possibly' analogy acknowledged in Limitations), the semantics-only condition cannot cleanly isolate structure, and retrieval hyperparameters (λ=0.25) are inherited rather than tuned. Reproducibility is good: public benchmarks, detailed training hyperparameters (Tables 4-5), datastore construction, structural-match detection criteria (A.4), and a public code link.

primary_link.title: Does Episodic Memory Help Close the Lexical Frequency Gap in Sensitivity to Syntactic Contrasts? A Test Using Retrieval-Augmented Language Models

papers.summary: Grammatical knowledge and how it is empirically tested are typically considered robust to the frequency of the lexical items in the expressions. However, neural network-based models of grammaticality exhibit high sensitivity to lexical frequency. We draw upon Complementary Learning Systems theory to test the hypothesis that robustness to lexical frequency can arise via a hippocampal episodic memory mechanism, which enables rapid encoding and retrieval of specific experiences and allows learners
papers.summary_zh: 神經網路語言模型在句法測試上對詞彙頻率高度敏感，低頻詞項表現持續落後，而人類對此相對穩健。本文依據互補學習系統（CLS）理論假設：海馬迴情節記憶能快速編碼並提取具體經驗，補償參數知識的不足。作者以 kNN 語言模型作為情節記憶的功能性代理，在 GPT-2 XL（大規模預訓練）與以 50M 詞兒童導向語料訓練的 GPT-2 Small 上，檢驗主謂一致、wh-問句與關係子句三類句法對比，並依內容詞頻率分層。結果顯示檢索增強在所有現象與兩種規模下皆提升準確率，並一致縮小高低頻落差，其中關係子句受益最大（低頻錯誤減少最高約 49%）；統計分析確認增益集中於低頻項。進一步分析指出結構資訊是關鍵：僅靠語義相似度的檢索幾乎無效，含結構匹配範例的檢索效果最佳；鄰居數 k=16 表現最好，過多反受雜訊影響。然而頻率落差僅縮小而非完全消除。作者提出對檢索實例優先重加權、更佳的結構表示與檢索策略、以及可調適的儲存與檢索組態作為未來方向。此研究為情節記憶支持人類頻率穩健性的假說提供概念驗證，兼具認知科學與建模上的意義。

links.title: Knowing Isn't Always Saying: When Do Spatial Encodings Reach Answers in Vision-Language Models?

evidence: Sec 2.3 Method: direction patching intervention h <- h + alpha(C_target - C_source) with alpha=5/10, five-fold crossfit, and Delta-argmax defined against a same-norm random-direction baseline
Sec 3.1 Controls + App. C: wrong-axis and non-object patching stay within [-0.018,+0.031] and [-0.017,+0.006] across all ten models, ruling out generic perturbation and position-only effects
App. D: bootstrap CIs (2000 resamples) show IV3-8B CoT Delta-argmax exactly 0.000 [0.000,0.000] while target-logit gain is +0.421 [+.341,+.501], supporting the threshold-not-erasure claim
Sec 4.2 + App. Q: L27.H21 knockout in InternVL3-8B recovers +0.063 Delta-argmax under CoT at n=100 with no effect under answer-only (+0.007); parallel LLaVA scan finds no comparable single head
Limitations section: all transport/gating claims restricted to the linear subspace of Kang et al. 2026; Janus shows +0.403 visual_cot Delta-argmax but 0pp generate-mode accuracy change
App. R: code 'will be released' (not yet available), hyperparameters and ~200 A800 GPU-hours documented, all data from public RefCOCO/GQA/COCO annotations
llm_evaluation.rationale: A mechanistic interpretability study of VLM spatial reasoning squarely matching high-weight preferences (interpretability, chain-of-thought/prompting, multimodal LLMs): direction patching across 10 LLM-backbone VLMs, 3 datasets, 7 prompts, with the novel empirical finding that text CoT suppresses argmax-level spatial transport at the object-word token while visual-grounding prompts keep it open, plus position-dependent relocation. Novelty is moderate rather than high because the core primitive (class-conditioned direction patching) and the spatial-ID directions are borrowed from Kang et al. 2026 and the activation-patching literature; the contribution is a systematic transport mapping rather than a new method. Rigor is strong: wrong-axis/non-object/blank-image controls (App. C, M), alpha dose-response sweeps (App. E), sample-cluster bootstrap CIs (App. D), cross-dataset/attribute transfer, answer-step timing and stepwise controls, and head-knockout scans with n=100 confirmation (App. Q), with honest framing of the 0.01 threshold as descriptive and N=10 groupings as non-validated. Evidence is solid but scoped: all causal claims hold only along the tested linear subspace (Limitations), and the Janus case (+0.403 logit effect vs 0pp behavioral change) exposes an argmax-behavior gap the authors transparently flag; behavioral validation is partly mixed (CoT baseline collapse for Qwen-32B/IV2.5). Generalizability is bounded: open-weight 4B-32B models only, four-way MCQ format, two attributes, manually designed prompts. Reproducibility is good: verbatim prompt templates (App. A), centroid/hook/bootstrap implementation details (App. P), ~200 A800 GPU-hours, public datasets; code only promised. Not out-of-scope: this is language-model internal analysis, not pure computer vision.

primary_link.title: Knowing Isn't Always Saying: When Do Spatial Encodings Reach Answers in Vision-Language Models?

papers.summary: Vision-language models are known to encode spatial information in their hidden states, yet often fail to use it when answering. However, it remains unclear when and where this encoded information reaches the answer. We address this with direction patching, a class-conditioned causal intervention applied across layers, token positions, and prompt formats. Using spatial-ID directions constructed following prior encoding evidence, we find that causal influence on answer logits emerges only at mid-t
papers.summary_zh: 視覺語言模型（VLM）已知會在隱藏狀態中編碼空間資訊，卻常無法在作答時使用，形成「編碼—取用落差」。本文追問：編碼的資訊何時、何處才會因果地抵達答案？作者採用方向修補（direction patching），沿層深、詞元位置（物件詞與前綴末位）與七種提示格式施加類別條件化介入，並以十個開源 VLM（涵蓋 Qwen2.5-VL、LLaVA-OneVision、InternVL、Gemma-3 與 Janus-Pro）於 RefCOCO、GQA 空間與顏色任務上系統性測繪。主要發現有三：空間傳遞僅在中後層（約 L12–L32）浮現；文字鏈式思考在八成模型中壓抑物件詞位置的立即 argmax 級傳遞，而視覺定位提示能保持此路徑暢通（Janus 甚至放大 5.8 倍）；傳遞路徑具位置依賴性，多數模型呈現「壓抑後於深層前綴末位重現」的 relocation 模式。行為驗證顯示路徑開放時引導可使準確率下降 8–21 個百分點；InternVL3-8B 的 head knockout 實驗找到 CoT 專屬的閘控候選頭。限制包括僅探測線性子空間、任務限四選一、以及 Janus 等架構的生成路徑與線性子空間脫鉤。這些結果將編碼—取用落差重構為條件式傳遞問題，並指出視覺定位提示是無需重訓的可行介入。
papers.title: Knowing Isn't Always Saying: When Do Spatial Encodings Reach Answers in Vision-Language Models?
