links.title: Mitigating Exploration Bias in RL for Multi-Instruction Following

evidence: Abstract: 'we find that they suffer from exploration bias towards easy instructions... propose two metrics... two-stage framework: Behavioral Bootstrapping... and Scarcity-Aware Rewards'; 'We release codes at https://github.com/mianzhang/MulIF'

Section 1/Figure 1: Qwen3-1.7B trained with GRPO and cumulative reward on IFTrain shows 'performance gains for Medium and Hard instructions exhibit high variance' versus Easy instructions, motivating the bias diagnosis

Section 3: VIA/VSA validated via response pool from 15 models with group size K=128, fixed instruction accuracy 0.68±0.01 on AdvancedIF prompts; 'both VIA and VSA exhibit a consistent inverse relationship with prompt accuracy' (correlational, not causal)

Section 5.1 Training: 'filter the original dataset to retain only prompts containing 3 to 5 instructions, resulting in... 45,374 prompts'; GRPO group size 16, batch size 512, lr 1e-6, α=2, 400 steps, four NVIDIA A100 GPUs
Table 1: Qwen1.7B-BeBoot-SaR 44.3 strict IFBench vs Qwen1.7B-CR 35.1 (+9.2); Qwen7B-BeBoot-SaR 48.4 vs Qwen7B-CR 39.5 (+8.9); 'All off-the-shelf model results are reproduced by us'

Section 5.3/Figure 7: 'τ=0.5 consistently achieves superior results', 'smaller data scale (N_target=100) generally outperforms', 'peak score at α=2.0'; larger group sizes 'may cause over-optimization'
Figure 6: baseline 'suffers from entropy collapse' while proposed method 'maintains significantly higher entropy'
Limitations: 'this may not explicitly address higher-order dependencies where three or more instructions interact'; 'we validate our framework only on verifiable instruction following in this work'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM methodology paper: RL post-training (GRPO/RLIF) of LLMs with a new reward design, touching Large Language Models, Alignment/RLHF-style reward engineering, and Training & Optimization preferences. The identified problem—exploration bias across instructions within a single prompt—is a genuinely under-explored angle relative to prior task-level RL imbalance work (Section 2.2), and the two-stage BeBoot + Scarcity-Aware Rewards framework is coherent and well-motivated, though the individual ingredients (rejection-sampling SFT, difficulty-weighted rewards 1-P(Ij)) are relatively incremental combinations. Rigor is solid: two base models (Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), three benchmarks, ablations over τ, N_target, α, and group size (Section 5.3, Figure 7), plus training-dynamics evidence (VIA/VSA/entropy, Figures 4, 6). However, metric validation is correlational via a constructed model-output pool at fixed instruction accuracy (Section 3), there are no error bars or multi-seed significance tests, and evaluation temperature 0.7 may inflate/skew benchmark numbers. Evidence for headline claims is concrete (Table 1: +9.2 strict IFBench for Qwen1.7B-BeBoot-SaR over CR baseline), but limited to verifiable instruction following, as the authors themselves note in Limitations (open-ended instructions, >2-way instruction interactions not handled). Strong reproducibility: code URL in abstract, full hyperparameters (group size 16, batch 512, lr 1e-6, α=2, 4×A100, 45,374 filtered IFTrain prompts) in Section 5.1.

primary_link.title: Mitigating Exploration Bias in RL for Multi-Instruction Following

papers.summary: RL has emerged as a powerful paradigm for enhancing the instruction following capabilities of LLMs. While existing training recipes achieve substantial gains, we find that they suffer from exploration bias towards easy instructions when the training data has multiple instructions in a prompt. This bias is caused by two main reasons: 1) the policy model's initial ability to satisfy hard instructions is too low to trigger successful exploration during RL training, so the optimization is biased tow
papers.summary_zh: 本論文探討以強化學習（RL）增強大型語言模型多指令遵循能力時出現的「探索偏誤」：模型傾向於優先完成簡單指令而忽略困難指令。作者指出兩個成因：一是策略模型對困難指令的初始能力過低，難以在RL訓練中觸發成功探索；二是常見的累積獎勵將所有指令一視同仁，使模型傾向於完成簡單指令即可獲得同等獎勵。為量化此偏誤，論文提出兩項指標：個別指令掌握的不平衡度（VIA）與指令對協同能力的不平衡度（VSA），兩者皆與提示層級的全通過率呈負相關。方法上提出兩階段框架：先以輕量級的拒絕取樣微調（Behavioral Bootstrapping）在RL前激活困難指令，再導入依經驗稀缺度加權的Scarcity-Aware Rewards，包含單元與二元獎勵，鼓勵模型探索罕見指令與指令組合。實驗使用Qwen3-1.7B與Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，於IFBench、IFEval與Multi-IF三項可驗證基準上平均超越累積獎勵基線4.5分，在IFBench最高提升9.2分，使小模型可匹敵Llama-3.1-70B與GPT-OSS-20B等大型模型。限制在於獎勵設計僅涵蓋一元與二元互動，且僅驗證於可驗證指令遵循情境。此研究揭示RL訓練中獎勵設計與探索平衡的重要性。
papers.title: Mitigating Exploration Bias in RL for Multi-Instruction Following
papers.title_zh: 減緩多指令遵循強化學習中的探索偏誤

links.title: Discovering Cross-Language Reasoning Invariance in LLMs with Geometry-Invariant Sparse Autoencoders

evidence: Abstract: GI-SAE adds InfoNCE contrastive loss to a reconstruction-only top-K SAE and tests functional interchangeability via causal patching measured by KL divergence per shared feature.

Section 5.1 / Figure 2: GI-SAE improves CKA at nearly every observation, yet Gemma wins 0/16 test layers despite CKA Δ +0.25–0.41, demonstrating geometric similarity does not imply functional interchangeability.
Table 2: GI-SAE win rates by baseline-sharing profile — convergent 83% [64, 93]%, low-sharing 49% [33, 64]%, saturated 6% [1, 27]%.

Section 6.1 Limitations: MGSM only; Llama and Phi have ~60 valid problems vs 151–202 for Qwen; fixed hyperparameters (K=128, 4×, τ=0.1, w=1.0 selected on a single Qwen3-1.7B L20 comparison); one sampled trace per problem-language pair.

Appendix C: causal patching controls with different-problem and random-value donors yield 89% overall pass rate across 28 condition–variant pairs; GI features pass the different-problem control 100% vs 71% for baseline.

Appendix J: normalized-space sensitivity check preserves the Qwen/convergent conclusion (win rate unchanged at 4/6) but flips several low/mixed-profile layers, which the authors treat as convention-sensitive.

Table 1 / Appendix D: five models from four families, 613 valid problems total, per-model pipeline 7–10 hours, ~60 GPU-hours on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090; no public code or artifact release is mentioned anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope mechanistic interpretability of LLMs: sparse autoencoders, causal patching, and cross-language analysis of chain-of-thought traces on MGSM across five open-weight models (Qwen3-1.7B/4B, Llama-3.2-3B, Gemma-3-4B, Phi-3-mini), directly matching LLM, reasoning/CoT, and interpretability preferences. Novelty is moderate: GI-SAE (top-K SAE + InfoNCE) is a sensible but incremental combination of standard components; the key contribution is the geometric-vs-functional interchangeability gap and the causal patching protocol. Rigor is above average: train/val/test splits, Wilson CIs, causal controls (different-problem and random-value donors, 89% overall pass rate per Appendix C), KL decomposition (Appendix G), and a patching-convention sensitivity check (Appendix J) that honestly marks low/mixed-profile layer verdicts as convention-sensitive. Evidence is solid within the sample but the authors correctly flag narrow scope: MGSM-only, single checkpoint per family (except Qwen scale pair), ~60 valid problems for Llama/Phi limiting power, fixed hyperparameters with w=1.0 tuned on a single Qwen layer, and one sampled trace per problem-language (Section 6.1). Reproducibility is supported by extensive hyperparameters, prompts, seeds, and ~60 GPU-hours on one RTX 5090 (Appendix D), but no code/data release is stated.

primary_link.title: Discovering Cross-Language Reasoning Invariance in LLMs with Geometry-Invariant Sparse Autoencoders

papers.summary: Multilingual language models can solve the same mathematical problem in different languages, but it remains unclear whether they rely on shared features or on language-specific computations that only produce similar outputs. We study this question in five models from four families using the Multilingual Grade School Math (MGSM) dataset, with problems solved in English, German, French, Spanish, Russian, and Chinese, retaining problems with valid reasoning traces in all six languages and replaying
papers.summary_zh: 多語言模型能以不同語言解決同一數學推理問題，但其內部是否依賴共享特徵仍不清楚。本研究針對四個架構家族的五個模型（Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.2-3B、Gemma-3-4B、Phi-3-mini），使用MGSM資料集，在英文、德文、法文、西班牙文、俄文與中文六種語言下檢視跨語言推理的內部表徵。作者提出Geometry-Invariant Sparse Autoencoder（GI-SAE），在top-K稀疏自編碼器的重建損失外加入InfoNCE對比損失，使同一問題不論語言與token位置都產生相似的特徵激活，並以因果補綴實驗測試共享特徵是否在功能上可互換：交換語言間的共享特徵值並以KL散度衡量輸出變化。結果顯示GI-SAE幾乎在所有層都提升CKA與Jaccard幾何相似度，但幾何相似並不必然帶來功能可互換性。跨語言特徵共享呈現強烈的模型與架構依賴性：Qwen隨深度漸進增強且GI-SAE在全部測試層獲勝；Gemma基線已飽和（共享約90%），對比訓練反而有害；Llama與Phi呈混合的層級依賴效果。以基線共享率分層，收斂型態的獲勝率達83%，飽和型態僅6%。方法學限制包括僅使用MGSM、模型規模至4B、固定超參數等。其核心貢獻在於證明幾何相似度不應作為功能等價性的代理指標，跨語言特徵共享必須逐模型、逐架構分析。
papers.title: Discovering Cross-Language Reasoning Invariance in LLMs with Geometry-Invariant Sparse Autoencoders
papers.title_zh: 以幾何不變稀疏自編碼器探索大型語言模型的跨語言推理不變性

links.title: Confidently Wrong, Silently So: Auditing Undetectable Failures of a Deployed On-Device Language Model

evidence: Abstract: 'confabulating on 69% of false premises while refusing 18% of entirely benign inputs, atop a self-reported confidence that is saturated and non-discriminative (AUROC 0.47; ECE 70, worst among comparable small models)'

Section 3: 'We audit the on-device foundation model exposed to third-party developers through the FoundationModels framework, specifically SystemLanguageModel.default, a general-purpose base model of roughly 3B parameters' with peers 'Gemma-3-4B-it, Llama-3.2-3B-instruct, and Ministral-3B'

Section 5: 'On N=3019 high-confidence short-answer outputs... a classifier trained to predict correctness from user-visible features alone reaches AUROC 0.548 (logistic) and 0.566 (gradient boosting)' with 'TOST equivalence test confirms this is statistically indistinguishable from chance'
Section 6, Table 2: 'SelfCheck (k=5)' achieves AUROC 0.749 (TriviaQA) / 0.789 (GSM8K) vs all O(1) signals ≤0.680, with DeLong p<0.003
Section 7: 'at k=5... it reduces confident confabulation from 75.0% to 2.6%... raising selective accuracy from 42.7% to 82.8% (ECE 57.2→17.2) at 28.2% coverage'

Section 9 Limitations: 'it audits a single deployed model from one vendor... we treat cross-model and cross-version generalization as a conjecture' and 'summarization groundedness relies on an LLM judge (audited at 88% agreement by a second judge) rather than a human audit'

Section 9: 'the underlying build and operating-system version are not recorded in our generation logs... we will pin the exact build for the camera-ready', versus 'released code and frozen evaluation items' claimed in the Conclusion and Ethical Statement
llm_evaluation.rationale: A black-box reliability red-team of a deployed ~3B on-device LLM (calibration, false-premise confabulation, over-refusal, surface-indistinguishability, and a SelfCheck-style mitigation) sits squarely in core LLM/AI-safety/evaluation territory with strong topical fit (LLM 2.5, AI Safety 2.0, Red Teaming & Evaluation 1.8, RAG/hallucination 1.8). Methodologically careful: paired statistical tests (McNemar, DeLong, bootstrap CIs, TOST equivalence, Holm correction), decoding-robustness re-checks of peers, and length-control ablations for the HVR signal (Section 3, Section 6). Key limitations temper the evidence: single-vendor single-model scope with cross-model generalization explicitly 'a conjecture' (Section 9), LLM judge (88% agreement) instead of human audit for groundedness, small subsets (n=110 false-premise items; n=76 and n=103 in the mitigation), a serving-pipeline confound between on-device and hosted peers, and mitigation shown at one tuned operating point. The mitigation itself is acknowledged as not novel ('The method is not itself novel', Section 7); the transferable contributions are the audit protocol, surface-indistinguishability test, and O(1)-vs-O(N) cost-ladder framing. Code and frozen items are released, but the on-device build is not yet pinned ('we will pin the exact build for the camera-ready'), capping reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Confidently Wrong, Silently So: Auditing Undetectable Failures of a Deployed On-Device Language Model

papers.summary: Aligning deployed language models requires knowing when their outputs can be trusted, yet on-device models now ship to hundreds of millions of devices with no server-side moderation, and the configuration developers can actually deploy is rarely audited independently. We present a reproducible reliability audit of the developer-accessible on-device foundation model, framed as an oversight question: can a user or a resource-constrained developer tell when the model is wrong? Red-teaming it on cal
papers.summary_zh: 本論文對開發者可存取的裝置端基礎模型（透過FoundationModels框架暴露、約3B參數）進行可重現的獨立可靠性稽核，聚焦於校準、錯誤前提下的自信虛構與對良性輸入的過度拒絕三大面向。研究發現任務不對稱的失準現象：模型在69%的錯誤前提問題上自信地虛構答案，卻同時拒絕18%完全良性的摘要請求，兩種護欄失靈方向相反，且不受廠商寬鬆模式影響。其自我回報的信心近乎飽和（約99%）、無區辨力（AUROC 0.47、ECE 70，為同級小模型中最差）。最關鍵的是，自信正確與自信錯誤的輸出在表面特徵上無法區分：以15項使用者可見特徵訓練的分類器AUROC僅0.55，經TOST等價性檢定確認等同隨機，使用者缺乏任何自保線索。沒有任何廉價的單次生成訊號能有效標記這些失敗（≤0.68 AUROC）；相對地，一個無需模型內部存取權的黑箱一致性包裝器（SelfCheck，k=5）可將自信虛構率從75%降至3%、選擇性準確率從43%提升至83%，且成本可調。論文貢獻模型無關的稽核協定與表面不可區分性測試。限制包括僅稽核單一廠商模型、以LLM評審而非人類審核、對照模型經由託管API提供等。此研究主張可靠性稽核應針對可部署設定，且監督不應依賴單次前向傳遞。
papers.title: Confidently Wrong, Silently So: Auditing Undetectable Failures of a Deployed On-Device Language Model
papers.title_zh: 自信地錯、悄悄地錯：稽核已部署裝置端語言模型的不可偵測失敗

links.title: Budget-Constrained Embodied Perception: Four Resource Walls and a Pre-Registered Evaluation of Access-Structured Perception on Open Models at less than 31B

evidence: Abstract/§V-H: 'removing the compressive state raises the flagship mean from 35.4 to 58.0, Asp does not outperform the verbatim-only baseline on any backbone, and two of four pre-registered falsification criteria fire'

§V-H 'Multiple comparisons': 'of the 7 Asp-versus-Retr-only tests, 0 are significant even before correction and 0 after' while Asp beats query-independent baselines by 17-66 points surviving Holm correction

§V-A: evaluation is '80 questions over 4 episodes of N=300 frames each' on SEW-Bench, a 'licence-free synthetic walkthrough benchmark', with OpenEQA/VSI-Bench/EgoSchema 'not run because their frames require dataset agreements'
§IV-C/§VI(0): 'at α=1 (embedding only) recall@8 is 0.005... while at α=0 (BM25 on captions only), it is 0.936', so the verbatim channel's competence is entirely textual on this corpus
§V-G: frozen falsification verdicts computed from released per-question records by analysis/analyze.py; 'F2 fires' (though recorded as uninformative) and 'F3 fires'
Reproducibility section: artifact at github.com/wenhui-ml/access-structured-perception, 'make verify recomputes every checkable claim offline', registration pinned by SHA-256, all deviations logged
Table XI: Assumption 1 measured per backbone (attribute reading 0.71-1.00; one-step composition at or below 50% chance for 4 of 7 backbones), with consequences for CMP claims stated in §V-H

§II: novelty claim is explicitly scoped - 'Our proofs use standard machinery, and the novelty claim is about the target rather than the technique', inheriting the wall framework from the authors' prior CCH paper [9]
llm_evaluation.rationale: A theory-plus-evaluation paper on budgeted access structure for frozen multimodal LLM agents, squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLM/VLM agents, long-context memory, RAG/retrieval, test-time compute); it is not pure robotics or pure CV since no control or hardware is involved. Novelty is moderate: the four walls adapt the authors' own prior CCH framework (self-citation [9]) using standard tools (Fano, pointer chasing, Barrington), acknowledged explicitly in §II; the transfer to pixel streams, the single per-decision budget accounting, and the honest negative result on the compressive channel are the new parts. Rigor is exceptionally high: pre-registered predictions and falsification criteria frozen before measurement (§V-G), Holm-Bonferroni correction over 42 paired tests (§V-H), measured Assumption-1 margins (Table XI), bound non-vacuity audit (Table VII), a corpus defect found and transparently repaired (§V-F), and two proof errors self-corrected (Appendix A). Evidence is strong for the positive claim (query-conditioned access beats query-independent baselines by 17-66 points, all surviving correction) but the headline architecture fails: Asp beats Retr-only on 0/7 backbones and removing the compressive channel raises the flagship mean from 35.4 to 58.0 (§V-C, §V-H), which the paper reports as a result rather than hiding. Generalizability is the weak point: 80 questions over 4 synthetic episodes, natural-video benchmarks not run for licence reasons (§V-A), retrieval is purely textual (vision-only recall@8 = 0.005 vs 0.936 caption-only, §IV-C), and the multiplicity-one corpus construction partly manufactures the RET gap (§V-H). Reproducibility is outstanding: released generator, per-question records, pre-registration pinned by SHA-256, and make verify (Reproducibility section), though only an uncontrolled API serving arm was run (§IV-E).

primary_link.title: Budget-Constrained Embodied Perception: Four Resource Walls and a Pre-Registered Evaluation of Access-Structured Perception on Open Models at less than 31B

papers.summary: Embodied multimodal agents must answer from growing observation streams under a fixed per-decision token budget. We formalize this constraint through four resource walls: a perceptual Shannon wall for bounded state, a horizon wall for query-independent frame selection, a round wall for non-adaptive retrieval, and a conditional composition wall for fixed-depth inference. We introduce ASP, a training-free wrapper for frozen multimodal models that combines a capped structured state, a verbatim epis
papers.summary_zh: 具身多模態代理必須在固定的每決策token預算下，從不斷增長的觀測流中作答。本論文形式化此約束，證明四道資源之牆：感知夏農牆（壓縮狀態無法保留情景細節）、視野牆（與查詢無關的影格選取準確率有上限）、輪次牆（單次非自適應檢索無法回答依賴鏈）與組合牆（固定深度推理無法追蹤增長的狀態鏈）。作者提出Asp，一個免訓練的包裝器，結合有上限的結構化場景狀態、逐字情景索引與查詢條件化的預算分配及迭代存取。依預註冊協定，團隊在自建的無授權限制合成基準SEW-Bench上評估七個3B至31B的開源模型。結果顯示查詢條件化存取是關鍵：Asp在情景檢索達75–94%準確率，同等預算的查詢無關取樣僅3–19%，且預算重新分配勝過將取樣預算加倍至四倍。然而誠實的消融揭示三元件中僅檢索通道有實效：移除壓縮狀態反而使旗艦模型平均從35.4提升至58.0，Asp在多重比較校正後未在任何骨幹上勝過僅逐字索引的基線，四項預註冊證偽準則有兩項被觸發。主要限制包括僅使用合成語料（自然影片基準因資料授權未能執行）、索引實際依賴文字標註而非視覺相似度，以及提示式壓縮通道的逐幀更新誤差隨流長累積。此研究以可證偽的方式界定：固定預算下，存取結構而非參數規模才是決定性因素。
papers.title: Budget-Constrained Embodied Perception: Four Resource Walls and a Pre-Registered Evaluation of Access-Structured Perception on Open Models at less than 31B
papers.title_zh: 預算受限的具身感知：四道資源之牆與31B以下開源模型存取結構化感知的預註冊評估

links.title: Best Practice Critic Optimization

evidence: Abstract: claims BPCO improves a strong critic-based baseline across 1.5B to 30B-A3B models, matches or exceeds a group-based baseline with one response per prompt, and states code availability at https://github.com/QPHutu/golden_critic.

Sec. 3: controlled sanity test fine-tunes DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B on 1,460 problems solvable by the initial model, from a verl commit dated June 16, 2026, with policy/critic learning rates 1e-6/1e-5 and 1,500 iterations; AIME 2025 avg@32 used as held-out metric.
Sec. 3.2, Eq. 9: bounded value head via scaled arctangent maps predictions into the known reward range; Fig. 2 shows the unbounded linear head predicts outside [0,1] and destabilizes training.
Sec. 3.3, Eq. 11: decoupled GAE with lambda_V=1 yields an unbiased Monte Carlo target equal to the outcome reward; Fig. 3 shows explained variance against bootstrapped targets is misleadingly high.

Sec. 3.4: batch-wise advantage normalization is removed because dividing by batch std amplifies noise near the optimum and subtracting the mean can reverse advantage signs; Fig. 4 supports the change.
Sec. 3.5, Eq. 13: privileged critic input (reference answer) accelerates training but Fig. 5 shows earlier validation decline, an acknowledged overfitting risk.
Sec. 3.6, Eq. 14: length-adaptive GAE with alpha=0.4 keeps the terminal-residual weight roughly length-invariant; Fig. 6 shows fixed lambda=0.99 overfits and lambda=1 is slower.

Sec. 4: Dr. GRPO baseline uses 16 responses per prompt with reduced prompt count so all methods are trajectory-matched; critic baseline combines VC-PPO and VAPO techniques, isolating BPCO's bounded head and unnormalized advantages.
Sec. 4.1: scaling test on DeepScaleR (~40.3K problems, official solutions for ~7.3K) with ablations in Figs. 8-9 confirming bounded value prediction and privileged information help at scale.

Sec. 4.2: on DAPO-Math-17K with Qwen3-30B-A3B(-Base), the critic baseline fails to improve AIME 2025 beyond the first 100 steps while BPCO improves; BPCO beats the group baseline on one MoE model and is comparable on the other.

Sec. 4.3: OpenRubrics with a frozen Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 judge; BPCO variants learn faster than baselines but the group baseline eventually matches, and privileged rubrics raise explained variance without improving policy performance.

Limitations: authors state evidence is limited to mathematical and rubric rewards, BPCO assumes a known reward range, privileged variants require evaluator information, and critic training adds compute/memory not captured by trajectory-matched comparisons.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM RL training methodology (critic-based PPO vs. GRPO for reasoning), strongly aligned with LLM, reasoning, RL, and training-optimization preferences; not a pure domain application. The recipe is largely assembled from prior work (DPPO from the authors' own Qi et al. 2026b, decoupled GAE/MC targets from VC-PPO, length-adaptive GAE from VAPO); the bounded value head (Eq. 9), removal of advantage normalization (Sec. 3.4), and privileged critic inputs (Sec. 3.5, Eq. 13) are modest but genuinely new in the LLM RL context. Rigor is solid: an incremental controlled sanity test (Sec. 3, 1,460 solvable problems), trajectory-matched baseline comparison (Sec. 4), per-component ablations (Figs. 8-9), and multiple scales (1.5B, 30B-A3B, 4B rubric task), with honest negative findings (privileged info overfits small data, group baseline catches up in Sec. 4.3). Evidence is weakened by results reported only as figure-based claims without quantitative tables, seeds, or variance; claims are appropriately hedged and limitations (math/rubric-only, known reward range, extra critic compute) are stated. Reproducibility is good: code link (Abstract), verl commit pin (Sec. 3), full hyperparameters, and named datasets. Overall a useful, well-controlled recipe paper with incremental novelty.

primary_link.title: Best Practice Critic Optimization

papers.summary: Group-based reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO for large language models avoid training a critic by sampling multiple responses for each prompt. A reliable critic could instead estimate token-level advantages from one response, but standard critic-based training recipes are often unstable. We study this instability and develop **Best Practice Critic Optimization (BPCO)**, a recipe that combines DPPO, value predictions bounded to the reward range, Monte Carlo value targets, unnormalized
papers.summary_zh: 針對大型語言模型的強化學習，GRPO 等群組式方法雖可避免訓練評論者，但每個提示需取樣多個回應，且對回應中每個 token 給予相同的結果式優勢；而基於評論者的訓練在實務上常不穩定。本文提出 BPCO，一個單次取樣的 actor–critic 訓練配方，結合以取樣 token 機率變化定義裁剪邊界的 DPPO、限制在獎勵範圍內的價值預測、無偏的蒙地卡羅價值目標、移除批次優勢正規化，以及長度自適應 GAE。由於評論者僅於訓練時使用，BPCO 亦可將參考答案或評分規準等定義獎勵的特權資訊提供給評論者，而不改變政策輸入。作者先在小型可解資料集逐一隔離各設計選項的效果，再於 40.3K 數學題資料集、1.5B 與 30B-A3B 混合專家模型及以規準為獎勵的任務上驗證。結果顯示 BPCO 持續超越強大的評論者基線，並在每個提示僅取樣一個回應的情況下匹敵或超越群組式基線；特權資訊可加速評論者學習，但效益依任務而定，於小資料情境有過擬合風險。限制包括證據僅涵蓋數學與規準獎勵、需已知獎勵範圍，且評論者訓練增加運算與記憶體成本。此研究證明精心設計的評論者可成為群組相對優勢估計的可靠替代方案。
papers.title: Best Practice Critic Optimization
papers.title_zh: 最佳實務評論者最佳化（BPCO）

links.title: Cross-Domain, Multi-Task Data-to-Text Generation without In-Domain Training Data

evidence: Abstract & Section 1: DDKD at constant 1.7B size outperforms fine-tuning and zero-shot; small models beat a larger finetuned model on two of five domains (abstract) and Qwen3-32B/GPT-4.1 on four of five (Section 6.1), supported by Table 4 NormAvg values (DDKD-Mixed SFT-teacher 0.10 vs Qwen3-1.7B-SFT 0.81, Qwen3-1.7B-ZS 0.64; GPT-4.1-ZS 0.13 remains best overall system).

Section 5.2 / Table 4: reference-free LLM-as-a-judge protocol with error taxonomy (Incorrect Fact, Not Checkable, Misleading, Other), two judges GPT-5.1 and Gemini-2.5-Pro; Table 21 (Gemini judge) shows consistent rankings, e.g., Qwen3-1.7B-DDKD-Mixed SFT-teacher best on Wikidata 0.36, Ice Hockey 0.13, OWID 0.85.

Section 6.1 / Figure 9 and Appendix K: coverage sanity check shows DDKD-Best coverage close to the best teacher (NormAvg 0.815 GPT-5.1, 0.754 Gemini) above same-size baselines, ruling out conservative under-generation; system-level inter-judge agreement r>0.95 (Appendix H, Table 9).

Section 4.2-4.3 / Tables 3, 8: structural subsampling (e.g., 2^8-1=255 variants per Ice Hockey instance) and 20% perturbation; QUINTD-5 (500 instances/domain) shows real-data scaling yields worse NormAvg (0.42 ZS-teacher, 0.20 SFT-teacher Base-500) than augmented settings (0.27, 0.10).

Appendix I.4 and I.7 / Tables 12, 14, 15: human evaluation by three researchers involved in the work on 240 outputs (60 inputs); system-level IAA alpha=0.902, human-GPT-5.1 system-level Pearson r>0.90 in aggregate for GSM-Arena, OWID, Weather; DDKD lowest NormAvg 0.09.

Appendix L / Tables 18-19: source-domain initialization ablation (WebNLG vs E2E vs KELM-Q1) showing WebNLG gives best faithfulness-coverage trade-off (NE=0.954, NC=1.000), supporting the design choice.

Section 8 Limitations and Appendix A: only Qwen3/Gemma3 small-scale models tested, heuristic augmentation choices, closed-source judges acknowledged; full hyperparameters (LoRA rank 8, LR, 13k max length), single-A100 costs, vLLM inference, and public GitHub code/data (abstract footnote 1) support reproducibility, though primary evaluation depends on GPT-5.1/Gemini-2.5-Pro APIs.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A solid LLM-centric NLP methodology paper: cross-domain data-to-text generation via data-driven knowledge distillation from LLM teachers (Qwen3-32B/Gemma3-27B) into 1.7B/1B students, with structure-preserving subsampling/perturbation augmentation and QUINTD-5 as a real-data scaling control. Strongly matches preferences on LLMs, text generation (NLP), fine-tuning/distillation (Scaling & Efficiency, Training & Optimization), synthetic data (Data & Datasets), and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation (Red Teaming & Evaluation); not aligned with Japanese LLM, agents, code, or safety topics. Novelty is moderate: it combines established techniques (sequence-level KD, synthetic data, augmentation) in a relatively new reference-free cross-domain setting, with the structural subsampling/perturbation strategies and QUINTD-5 as the main new artifacts. Rigor and evidence are above average: comprehensive augmentation ablations across two model families, dual independent judges with multi-granularity agreement analysis (system-level r>0.95), human validation with Krippendorff's alpha, a coverage sanity check ruling out conservative under-generation, a source-dataset initialization ablation (Appendix L), and detailed cost reporting. Caveats: primary metric is closed-source LLM-judge (GPT-5.1), human annotators were three researchers involved in the work, the human set is small (240 outputs, 12 inputs/domain), final model selection is judge-based (potentially on test inputs), and the abstract ('two of five' vs. larger finetuned model) vs. Section 6.1 ('four of five' vs. GPT-4.1/32B-ZS) is confusingly phrased though Table 4 supports both against different baselines. Generalizability is limited by domain-specific heuristic augmentation, small model scales, and the D2T-specific setting; reproducibility is good (public code/data, hyperparameters, prompts, seeds) but relies on proprietary judges for the headline metric.

primary_link.title: Cross-Domain, Multi-Task Data-to-Text Generation without In-Domain Training Data

papers.summary: Structured data exists in many forms (tables, knowledge graphs, charts, and time series), and converting it into text may involve different generation tasks. However, most prior work on data-to-text (D2T) generation has focused on specific tasks and datasets, relying either on task-specific training data or on the zero-shot capabilities of large language models. We study cross-domain D2T generation in a setting where neither in-domain training text nor test references are available, and where do
papers.summary_zh: 資料轉文字生成多聚焦於特定任務與資料集，仰賴領域內訓練資料或大型語言模型的零樣本能力。本文研究在缺乏目標領域訓練文字與測試參考文本的情境下，跨領域、跨輸入結構的生成問題，比較零樣本推論、在 WebNLG 上微調，以及資料驅動知識蒸餾（DDKD），後者由零樣本教師或 WebNLG 微調教師為 QUINTD-1 的五個目標領域（涵蓋時間序列、知識圖譜、表格與圖表等輸入結構）生成合成訓練資料，並提出保留結構的資料擴增：結構子取樣產生大量較簡單但忠實的輸入變體，雜訊式結構擾動則提升樣本多樣性。實驗採 GPT-5.1 與 Gemini-2.5-Pro 兩位 LLM 評審進行無參考評估，並以人類標註驗證可靠性。結果顯示在固定模型規模（1.7B）下，蒸餾模型於兩個模型家族、五個領域皆持續優於微調與零樣本，並在多數領域超越規模更大的 32B 模型；對照實驗 QUINTD-5 進一步證明擴增比單純將真實輸入由 100 擴充至 500 筆更有效且更具成本效益。限制包括僅評估 1B–2B 等級開源模型、結構擴增依賴啟發式設計，以及 LLM 評審的成本與偏好差異。此工作顯示大型 LLM 宜作為中間生成器而非最終部署目標。

links.title: NetConfArena: An Executable Benchmark for LLM Agents in Closed-Loop Network Configuration

evidence: Sec. I (footnote 1): benchmark framework and task suite released as open source at github.com/liujona/NetConfArena/
Sec. V-A3: 480 task instances from 96 validated templates (five seeded instances each), yielding 3840 execution trajectories across 8 model-thinking settings with temperature 0
Table II / Sec. V-B1: deepseek-v4-pro thinking-disabled achieves test-case score 0.961, pass rate 0.852; qwen3-8B reaches only 0.337-0.457 score, showing a large capability gap

Sec. V-C: four-category failure taxonomy (knowledge deficiency, unproductive hesitation, premature abandonment, specification deviation) derived from trajectory inspection with concrete examples such as LDP VPLS address rewriting
Sec. IV-B: acknowledged limitation that negative test cases cover only explicitly stated prohibitions, so agents could pass while introducing unchecked side effects
Appendix D: instance-level variance median 56.7% and median Spearman rho=0.928 across 16 subcategories, with authors noting decomposition does not isolate parameterization from decoding variance
Sec. VI-B: stated limitations include small controlled topologies, exclusion of traditional configuration-synthesis baselines, and no coverage of rollback or multi-vendor settings
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: this is an LLM-agent benchmark centered on tool use (five-action interface), ReAct harnesses, closed-loop agentic execution, and evaluation/benchmark methodology (Agents & Tool Use w2.5, LLMs w2.5, Red Teaming & Evaluation w1.8), with secondary relevance to reasoning via thinking-mode analysis. It is not out-of-scope domain-only work because the contribution is agent-evaluation infrastructure, though the networking domain narrows its audience. Novelty is moderate-to-good: Table I (Sec. II-C) shows it is the first benchmark to jointly support closed-loop interaction, multi-device vendor-CLI realism, and process+outcome evaluation, and the LLM-assisted emulation-grounded template pipeline (Sec. IV) is a genuine methodological piece, but it builds directly on NetConfEval, NetLLMBench, and NetArena. Rigor is solid: 480 instances/3840 trajectories across 8 model-mode settings (Sec. V-A3), quantitative outcome and process metrics, a failure taxonomy grounded in trajectory inspection (Sec. V-C), variance decomposition and Spearman rank analysis (Appendix D), and honest limitations (finite negative-test coverage in Sec. IV-B; single ReAct harness; no synthesis baselines in Sec. VI-B). Evidence is specific and verifiable (e.g., deepseek-v4-pro 0.961 score/0.852 pass rate in Table II; thinking hurting deepseek-v4-pro via early submission in Sec. V-B2). Generalizability is capped by small controlled topologies, apparent single-vendor CLI emphasis, and acknowledged instance-level variance (median 56.7%, Appendix D). Reproducibility is supported by open-source release (Sec. I, footnote 1), fixed seeds, temperature 0, and prompt documentation (Appendix A), though dependence on vendor emulator images and API models may hinder exact replication.

An essential prerequisite is to assess such agents in a realistic but risk-free environment. Existing benchmarks, however, fall short: they often treat configuration as static command generation or rely on overly simplified settings. Such evaluations understate the core challenges of network configuration, where correctness requires
papers.summary_zh: 網路設定的正確性取決於整體網路行為是否符合意圖，而非單一設備接受指令；然而現有基準多以靜態指令生成或過度簡化的單一路由器情境評估 LLM 代理。本文提出 NetConfArena，在 GNS3 模擬的多設備網路中進行封閉迴路評估：代理透過五個標準化動作（讀取設定、套用設定、執行驗證、等待、提交）與環境互動，使用廠商專屬命令列介面（CLI），最終由隱藏的任務專屬可執行測試案例檢驗網路行為，並記錄完整軌跡以進行結果與過程雙層面評估。基準建構採 LLM 輔助、以模擬為依據的管線，將廠商手冊與社群實驗材料轉為參數化任務模板，共 96 個涵蓋 IP 路由、MPLS 與 IP Overlay 的模板，產生 480 個任務實例與 3,840 條軌跡。評估發現 deepseek-v4-pro 表現最佳（測試案例分數 0.961），思考模式雖改善較小的 qwen3 模型，卻因提早提交增加而降低 deepseek-v4-pro 的表現。失敗歸納為知識不足、無效猶豫、過早放棄與偏離規格四類，顯示瓶頸不只指令生成，也在規格遵循與穩健的封閉迴路執行。限制包括任務為小型拓撲、未涵蓋回滾與多廠商環境，以及測試案例覆蓋不完整。

links.title: Beyond Surface Cues: Disentangling Sociocultural Signals in Multilingual LLMs

evidence: Abstract: analyzes 89,253 outputs from 12 LLMs in English, French, and Chinese, spanning 18 occupations and three task conditions

Section 3.1: two Prolific human studies validate cultural-marker annotations (39 raters; 624 marker-level comparisons) and protagonist-label extraction (116 raters); automated marker-inclusion endorsed at 80.0%
Section 4.1: language-task interaction detected for Balance (F(4,79)=21.63, partial omega-squared=0.495) and Stereotype (F(4,79)=9.07, partial omega-squared=0.278), all adjusted p<0.001
Section 4.2 Table 1: deleting names and direct gender terms reduces AUC by 0.230-0.365 in EN and 0.320-0.342 in ZH but only 0.003-0.037 in FR, with bootstrap 95% intervals
Section 4.3: source-language separability falls from balanced accuracy 0.991 [0.987, 0.994] to 0.721 after translation and 0.558 after named-entity masking against a 0.333 chance level
Limitations: evidence limited to three high-resource language-linked contexts; some aggregate estimates depend on the ANOVA specification; embedding probe measures recoverability, not causal effects

Appendix D.1: generation via unified Chat Completion API at temperature 0.7, target 50 outputs per cell, exact model versions listed; Appendix D states full prompt templates and occupation mapping are provided with accompanying materials, but no explicit code/data URL is given
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multilingual LLM bias-audit paper squarely within scope: it studies 12 frontier LLMs (GPT-4o, Mistral, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Grok), uses a multi-agent LLM auditing pipeline, LLM-as-judge scoring with human validation, and embedding probes, addressing bias/fairness (AI Safety) and evaluation methodology (Red Teaming & Evaluation). Methodological contribution is genuinely useful: separating apparent cultural grounding from surface cues via translation and named-entity-masking controls, plus a full-text positive-control probe design. Rigor is strong: pre-specified metrics, Type-III ANOVAs with BH-adjusted p-values and partial omega-squared, stratified group cross-validation with bootstrap CIs, two Prolific human-validation studies (39 and 116 raters), and multiple robustness specifications. Evidence is quantitatively well-supported within the corpus (e.g., cue-deletion AUC drops of 0.23-0.37 in EN/ZH vs 0.003-0.037 in FR; separability 0.991 to 0.721 to 0.558), though the authors honestly note specification dependence, non-causal probes, and coverage gaps. Generalizability is limited to three high-resource languages and 18 occupations, as acknowledged. Reproducibility is aided by detailed settings, exact model versions, seeds, and promised accompanying materials, but no explicit public code/data repository is stated.

primary_link.title: Beyond Surface Cues: Disentangling Sociocultural Signals in Multilingual LLMs

papers.summary: Multilingual LLM outputs can vary across sociocultural contexts. However, evidence of cultural grounding can be misleading: identity labels may be inferred from explicit or indirect textual cues, while names and wording can reveal the source language. Treating all these signals as evidence of cultural grounding may obscure potential biases. We present a human-validated, multi-agent audit that separates three questions: whether outputs reproduce social biases, whether identity groups are represen
papers.summary_zh: 多語言 LLM 的輸出會隨社會文化脈絡變化，但文化證據可能被表層線索誤導：身分標籤可由明示或間接文字線索推得，姓名與用詞也會洩漏來源語言，將這些訊號一律視為文化依據可能掩蓋偏誤。本文提出一套經人類驗證的多代理審計框架，分離三個問題：輸出是否再現社會偏誤、身分群體是否被不同呈現、輸出是否反映跨文化模式。研究分析 12 個 LLM 在英、法、中三種語言、18 種職業與三種任務條件下的 89,253 個輸出，並以刪除直接身分線索、翻譯與遮蔽具名實體等控制實驗檢驗表面效應。結果顯示偏誤呈現隨語言與任務系統性變化；刪除直接線索後，英文與中文的身分標籤預測能力大幅下降（AUC 下降約 0.23–0.37 與 0.32–0.34），法語因語法性別標記而降幅有限。所有語言—文體設定中，與來源語言連結的文化脈絡獲得最高平均相關分數，但翻譯與姓名遮蔽使來源語言可辨識度由 0.991 分別降至 0.721 與 0.558。限制包括僅涵蓋三種高資源語言、文化相關性評分具主觀性，且探針僅翻譯個別標記而非全文。此框架有助於將語言辨識捷徑與真正的跨文化模式分離。
papers.title: Beyond Surface Cues: Disentangling Sociocultural Signals in Multilingual LLMs
papers.title_zh: 超越表層線索：分離多語言 LLM 中的社會文化訊號

links.title: ExFold: Unified Expert Folding for Training-Free MoE Prefill-Decode Acceleration

evidence: Abstract: 'up to 1.41x TTFT and 2.45x TPOT speedups while retaining about 99% of the original average quality' with vLLM plugin and CUDA kernel
Table 1: ExFold-P4 average 69.26 vs Original TopK=8 69.04 and Direct Top-4 66.64 on Qwen3-30B-A3B; joint P4+D64 68.50 vs Direct Top-4 both phases 56.17
Table 3 (Projector ablation): pairwise scalar beats global/layer scalars; diagonal lowers PPL (3.308) but pairwise scalar wins 6/7 downstream metrics; low-rank R8/R16 add 2.44-4.87 GiB unfused state

Appendix F 'Calibration data and disclosure': DeepSeek-V4-Flash matrix calibrated on 64 inputs including 4 IFEval and 4 IFBench benchmark inputs, self-described as 'transductive, benchmark-aware calibration, not a zero-contact held-out evaluation'
Scaling to DeepSeek-V4-Flash: P3+D64 retains 97.68% vs Direct K=3 88.17%; D64 throughput 5.22k to 6.72k tokens/s (1.29x); TTFT peak at QPS 4 attributed to 'queueing amplification'
Appendix A: calibration on 32 unlabeled Nemotron sequences <=4096 tokens, lambda=1e-3, scalars clipped to [-4,4]; full hardware/software stack (8x H800, vLLM 0.10.2/0.11.0, Triton 3.4.0)
Table 6: decode-only ExFold-D64 avg 72.72 vs baseline 72.68 and REAP-D128 71.02 on DeepSeek-V4-Flash
Appendix F 'Open-source reproduction': repository contains runtime patches, CUDA/Triton kernels, final calibration matrices, correctness tests, one-command launchers
llm_evaluation.rationale: A training-free MoE inference-acceleration method squarely within LLM scope (LLM, inference/serving, scaling-efficiency preferences), unifying prefill token-level and decode batch-level expert budgets via calibrated scalar projectors folded into router metadata. Novelty is moderate: it builds on expert pruning/merging/re-routing (REAP, SERE, MC-MoE) but the explicit contribution-recovery formulation with a router-absorbed scalar is a genuine step beyond discard/implicit-approximation baselines. Rigor is solid: matched-budget comparisons against Direct Top-K, MC-MoE, MoDES, REAP, SERE; projector, calibration-corpus, and selection-criterion ablations; five MoE architectures. Evidence is strong for Qwen3-30B (Table 1 avg 69.26 vs 69.04 baseline at P4; 2.45x TPOT at 8 QPS) but tempered by small eval sets (AIME24: 30 problems), unsupported-by-text figure claims, and the honest disclosure in Appendix F that DeepSeek-V4-Flash calibration included 8 benchmark inputs ('transductive, benchmark-aware calibration'), weakening those headline retention numbers. Generalizability is good within MoE LLMs (Qwen, GLM, DeepSeek families) but untested beyond. Reproducibility is high: released repo with kernels, calibration matrices, launchers, and detailed Appendix A/B configurations.

primary_link.title: ExFold: Unified Expert Folding for Training-Free MoE Prefill-Decode Acceleration

papers.summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale capacity for strong quality while keeping per-token compute bounded through sparse expert activation. Yet low-latency MoE serving is increasingly challenging, because it spans two inference phases with fundamentally different bottlenecks: prefill is dominated by token-wise expert computation, whereas decode is constrained by memory traffic from the batch-wise activated expert set. However, existing training-free acceleration methods optimize only a single re
papers.summary_zh: 混合專家（MoE）模型以稀疏專家啟用控制每 token 運算量，但低延遲服務橫跨兩個瓶頸相異的階段：預填受 token 級專家計算主導，解碼則受限於批次級啟用專家的記憶體流量。既有免訓練加速方法僅最佳化單一資源代理指標，且直接捨棄被排除專家的貢獻或僅隱式近似。本文提出 ExFold，將預填與解碼統一為受限輸出近似問題：僅執行階段專屬的受限專家集合，並利用在校準資料上估計的成對純量投影器，將預算外專家的貢獻摺疊至保留專家。關鍵觀察是許多專家輸出方向對齊但量級差異大，因此單一純量修正即可低成本重建。預填採 token 級 Top-K 摺疊，解碼採批次級專家池摺疊，兩階段共用同一摺疊機制。ExFold 以即插即用外掛實作於 vLLM 並附輕量 CUDA 核心，實驗在 Qwen3-30B-A3B、GLM-4.5-Air 等多個 MoE 架構上達到最高 1.41 倍 TTFT 與 2.45 倍 TPOT 加速，同時保留約 99% 原始品質；在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 上聯合加速仍保留 97.68% 品質。消融確認成對純量優於全域或低秩投影器，且無需任務專屬校準；摺疊僅修改路由中繼資料，與核心、排程與平行化最佳化互補，將輸出重建確立為 MoE 推論加速的實用基礎。

links.title: The Illusion of Control: Why Bare Classifier Inversion Silently Fails in Concept-Bottleneck Text Generation

evidence: Abstract: 'Every inversion variant we test underperforms a simple post-hoc prior... across three backbone families spanning 124M to 8B parameters' and bare inversion 'silently collapses to chance'.

§5.1: Cls-Inv 4-axis accuracy 41.47% (LLaMA-3.2 1B), 42.99% (GPT-2 124M), 45.34% (Qwen-2.5 1.5B), 46.88% (GPT-2-Medium), all within ~5pp of the 42.5% chance baseline; failure invisible from training metrics.
§5.2 / App H Table 10: Cls-Inv Mahalanobis distance 3.34-3.74 vs 0.50-0.60 for prior and ~1.0 for Ref-Enc, plus kNN-distance separation — mechanism measured directly, not inferred.

§6.1 / Table 1: Prior reaches 55.18/61.50/64.18/76.10% on Hold-Out test_unseen vs collapsed Cls-Inv on identical checkpoints; artefact-free ACD within-split lifts of +7.4 to +18.8pp (Table 20, App R).
§7.1: honest matched-backbone result — GPT-2-Medium prior (61.50 HO / 59.52 ACD) is 'slightly below the strongest baseline' Meta-CTRL; only the cross-scale LLaMA-1B (+7.41pp) clears it.
App B Table 3: strictly backbone-matched YelpP check, Prior 0.964 vs byte-identical CB-LLMs reproduction 0.950; Cls-Inv 0.500 under DistilBERT evaluator with PPL 432 vs 17.
App J Table 13: 3x3 (lr, steps) grid — all 12 cells within ±5pp of chance, ruling out under-optimization as the collapse explanation.
App M Table 15: k-sample same-combination averaging rises with k and at k=256 matches the learned prior within 0.4pp, confirming conditional-mean denoising mechanism.
Limitations: scope restricted to injector-based concept-bottleneck CTG, English benchmarks, ≤3B multi-axis (8B single-axis), some single-seed cells; authors disclaim a state-of-the-art claim.

§4 Artefacts: code released under MIT licence with trained encoders, heads, injectors, LoRA adapters, and priors for all four main backbones on both splits (public GitHub link); full training/comparability policy in App O.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A careful LLM/NLP methodology paper on inference protocols for concept-bottleneck controllable text generation with LLM backbones (GPT-2, LLaMA-3.2, Qwen-2.5, LoRA), so it matches high-weight LLM/NLP/interpretability preferences and is not out-of-scope. Main claims are well supported: bare classifier inversion collapses to ~41.5-46.9% (≈42.5% chance) across four backbones (§5.1), traced to a directly measured off-manifold code (Mahalanobis 3.3-3.7 vs 0.5-0.6 for prior, App H) with depth-amplified injector over-modulation (§5.2, Fig 3); a simple post-hoc label-conditioned prior recovers control (55.2-76.1% on Hold-Out unseen, Tab 1). Rigor is high: inversion hyperparameter grid rules out under-optimization (App J), regularizer and conditional-flow ablations (Apps I/K), k-sample denoising control reproducing the prior within 0.4pp (App M), external official evaluators plus LLM-judge check (App G), and artefact analysis of the singleton split (App Q). Novelty is moderate: it is a protocol diagnosis/correction extending Sun et al. 2025 CB-LLMs and Gu et al. 2023 latent priors, not a new architecture; the deterministic per-combination mean prior is simple, and authors honestly note the matched-backbone prior does NOT beat the strongest CompMCTG baseline (§7.1) — only the cross-scale LLaMA-1B point does. Generalizability is explicitly scoped to injector-based concept-bottleneck CTG, English benchmarks, ≤3B multi-axis (Limitations), and the mechanism is not shown to transfer beyond this family. Reproducibility is strong: MIT code release with checkpoints (§4 Artefacts), public benchmarks/evaluators, full training and policy details (App O).

We study this problem in concept-bottleneck text generation under multi-axis compositional generalisation, comparing three ways to obtain the inference-time code: classifier inversion against the encoder heads, reference-text encoding, and a post-hoc label-conditioned prior. Since a concept code admits no
papers.summary_zh: 概念瓶頸可控文字生成在部署時需由目標屬性組態合成概念碼，直觀做法是對編碼器的分類頭進行分類器反演。本文系統性比較三種推論協定：分類器反演、參考文本編碼，以及事後擬合各屬性組合編碼均值的標籤條件先驗，並測試三種正則化反演變體，於多軸組合泛化設定下涵蓋 124M 到 8B 參數的多個骨幹。結果顯示所有受測反演變體均落後先驗 7 至 29 個百分點，裸反演更靜默崩潰至隨機水準——生成文本幾乎無概念訊號，訓練指標卻依然健康。作者直接測量發現反演碼偏離編碼器訓練分布 3 到 7 倍，並過度驅動 AdaLN 注入器造成逐層調變放大；加入流形正則化可脫離隨機水準，但最佳變體仍不及先驗。機制分析指出先驗作為條件均值去噪器，去除樣本特異的編碼變異，而概念碼的非可加殘差主要源自每樣本編碼雜訊而非屬性交互作用。此結果在 CompMCTG Fyelp、Amazon、單軸 YelpP 及外部評估器上均獲驗證。限制包括僅測試英文基準與有限規模的正則化方案。對此類模型而言，先驗推論應為預設的概念碼來源，而非裸分類器反演。

Introduction: 'The dataset and implementation will be released upon acceptance' — no live artifact link in the document.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/RAG/long-term-memory methodology paper: write-time state overwriting with entity version chains and lifecycle labels, plus a bilingual cross-meeting benchmark, evaluated against 9 baselines on 6 datasets and 2 readers. Strongly on-preference (RAG & Knowledge, Long Context & Memory, multi-hop Reasoning, LLM evaluation). Novelty is moderate: the Build-Read asymmetry and overwrite protocol combine known ideas (temporal KGs, event sourcing, structured memory like GraphRAG/HippoRAG) rather than introducing a new learning method; the benchmark is LLM-synthesized from simulated blueprints. Rigor is solid—matched ablations, 5-run stability with std devs, three-judge cross-validation (Table 8), blinded human pairwise eval, error attribution, abstention and cost analyses—but the primary metric is a single LLM judge for the main table, no significance tests, and headline macro-gains are driven by LongMemEval/MuSiQue while MeetingQA gains are marginal (39.16 vs 37.82). Evidence is internally consistent (ablation deltas 8.63/9.16/6.36/10.30 check out) yet contingent on synthetic data fidelity and judge validity; MeetingQA/ELITR gains are small. Generalizability is decent across languages/readers/datasets but Wiki-only linear reading (17,143 tokens/query, O(S_W)) limits scaling and ASR noise is acknowledged as a limitation. Reproducibility is middling: detailed configs are given but the dataset/code are only promised 'upon acceptance' and prompts are not shown.

primary_link.title: EvoWiki: Incremental State Overwriting and Traceable Question Answering for Cross-Meeting Knowledge Evolution

papers.summary: In long-term collaboration spanning multiple meetings, factual states such as decisions and risks are continually revised, overturned, and replaced. Existing long-context methods typically stack the entire history, while many RAG and structured-memory methods organize knowledge as static or append-only facts and rely on semantic relevance at read time. Without explicit modeling of knowledge lifecycles, these approaches may retain conflicting old and new states simultaneously or discard history,
papers.summary_zh: 跨多場會議的長期協作中，決策、風險與權責等事實狀態持續被修訂與推翻，但既有長情境、RAG 與結構化記憶方法多將知識視為靜態或僅附加的事實，可能同時保留過時與現行狀態，導致檢索過時且答案難以驗證。本文提出 EvoWiki，將離線增量建構與線上結構化閱讀解耦：Build 階段解析會議內提案—討論—決策的微演化，經寫入時共同指涉消解與實體路由，以細粒度狀態覆寫協定維護實體版本鏈，明確區分現行有效狀態與被取代歷史，並保留會議級出處錨點；Read 階段僅讀取完整 Wiki，進行確定性實體定址、時間解析與跨實體多跳聚合，繞過對原始會話的 Top-k 檢索。作者另建構雙語 CrossMeet 基準，每種語言含 100 個專案、500 場模擬會議與 2,000 個問答對，經三模型交叉驗證與人類審查確認品質。結果顯示在六個資料集與兩個閱讀器上，EvoWiki 的巨觀平均評分者準確率分別超越最強基線 9.72 與 10.00 個百分點；狀態翻轉與證據位置分析證實其對頻繁狀態變更更穩健，並緩解 Lost-in-the-Middle 效應。限制為 Read 受限於 Build 的擷取完整度，尤其在 ASR 噪音與非正式語句下。

links.title: Execution-Anchored Hallucination Calibration Reranking for Verilog Code Generation

evidence: Abstract: EAHC 'ranks first in 15 of 18 configurations', elevating average Pass@1 from 53.99% to 65.10% on VerilogEval-v2 and from 53.18% to 68.25% on ResBench, 'recovering over 60% of the gap to Pass@10 oracle'.
Section V-A1 (RQ1): McNemar's test vs. best baseline CodeT-GPT yields p=1.1e-10 (VerilogEval-v2) and p=1.8e-8 (ResBench); authors explicitly list the 3 configurations where CodeT-GPT still wins.

Section V-A3 + Table III: even with majority voting (n=3), EAHC-R scores disagree on 15.3%/27.4% of execution-equivalent pairs and byte-identical code gets unequal scores on 5.2%/16.4%, motivating execution anchoring (+2.33%/+5.15% over EAHC-R alone).

Section V-C + Table IV: independent fusion beats interactive fusion on all nine models (+4.49% VerilogEval-v2, +4.56% ResBench average), with qualitative anchoring-bias analysis of the interactive judge.
Table V (Section V-D): EAHC-T (k=5) testbenches false-accept 12.8%/6.6% but false-reject 47.3%/49.6% against hidden ground-truth testbenches (AUC 0.743/0.727), justifying fusion over filtering.
Section VI-D: contamination audit shows no benchmark problem has a nearest VeriTest-53K neighbour above 0.9 ROUGE-L or cosine (max 0.667 / 0.862).

Section VI-E (Threats to Validity): 'transferring it to another HDL requires rebuilding both corpora and retraining, so we make no claim beyond Verilog'; benchmarks are 156 and 56 problems, and per-problem latency is ~15-20s vs ~2s greedy.

Section I footnote 1: code and trained models open-sourced at github.com/NTDXYG/EAHC_CODE; Sections IV-C/IV-D detail VeriJudge-47K and VeriTest-53K construction (teachers DeepSeek-R1, GLM-4, GPT-4o, GLM-4.6 with compiler-in-the-loop filtering).
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-centric code-generation paper squarely inside the preferences: it fine-tunes a 4B LLM judge (LoRA/PiSSA) via multi-teacher distillation, uses RAG (BM25 + in-context demonstrations) for testbench generation, analyzes chain-of-thought 'reasoning hallucination' in LLM-as-a-Judge, and benchmarks GPT-5/DeepSeek-V3/GLM-4.6/Qwen2.5-Coder. Not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: execution-based reranking (CodeT) and LLM judges both exist; the contribution is the dual-channel independence design, execution-equivalence clustering as calibration, an honestly-scoped DPI argument (Theorem 1), and systematic quantification of judge inconsistency on execution-equivalent pairs. Rigor is high: 9 generators x 2 benchmarks, four baseline paradigms, component/alpha/aggregation/fine-tuning-vs-RAG ablations, McNemar significance tests, fault-detection validation of the self-generated anchor, and a contamination audit. Evidence is solid but rests on small benchmarks (156/56 problems), and the strongest configurations (GPT-5 testbenches) beat EAHC in 3 of 18 settings, which the authors report. Generalizability is explicitly constrained to Verilog (retraining required for other HDLs). Reproducibility is good: code/models/datasets are released and construction is detailed, though data curation depends on costly API teachers (GPT-4o, GLM-4(.6), DeepSeek-R1).

primary_link.title: Execution-Anchored Hallucination Calibration Reranking for Verilog Code Generation

papers.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in code generation, yet their performance degrades significantly on low-resource Hardware Description Languages such as Verilog. While multi-candidate sampling improves the likelihood of generating correct solutions, au-tomatically selecting the optimal candidate remains an open challenge. Through a systematic empirical study across nine models and two benchmarks, we identify two critical limitations:(1) existing execution-ba
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型在 Verilog 等低資源硬體描述語言上的生成能力明顯退化，而多候選取樣後如何自動挑選最佳候選仍是挑戰。本文透過橫跨九個模型與兩個基準的系統性實證研究，發現兩項關鍵限制：既有執行式重排方法因自我生成測試平台品質低落而領域轉移性差；LLM 評審則存在推理幻覺，對執行等價的程式碼給予不一致判斷。兩類訊號的錯誤性質正交，但直接讓推理者觀察執行結果反而使其錨定於測試結果而損失準確率，故本文獨立取得兩訊號並僅於決策階段融合。所提 EAHC 框架包含：僅依需求生成測試平台的 EAHC-T，運用 53K 語料之檢索增強；以及僅看需求與程式碼的 4B 推理判別器 EAHC-R，經多教師蒸餾與編譯器迴圈驗證，於 47K 判斷軌跡上微調。推論時依執行向量將候選聚成執行等價叢集並給予統一推理分數，再以融合分數進行階層式選擇。實驗顯示 EAHC 在 18 個設定中的 15 個奪冠，平均 Pass@1 由 53.99% 提升至 65.10%（VerilogEval-v2）、由 53.18% 提升至 68.25%（ResBench），恢復逾六成的 Pass@10 差距，並與訓練式方法正交互補。限制包括每題約 15–20 秒的延遲開銷，以及結論僅限 Verilog 領域。

links.title: The Interaction Tax: When Communication Erases Diversity in Multi-Agent Teams

evidence: Table 2 / Appendix J (Table 9): diverse-model MIG turns negative for Chain (-0.024), MAgICoRe (-0.035), and Debate (-0.078) while MoA stays positive (+0.012→+0.016), with bootstrap P(same>div) ≥ 88% — the central interaction-tax result.

Section 4 'A controlled check on the diversity advantage' and Appendix K (Table 10): 2×2 factorial diversity coefficient +0.188, CI [+0.073, +0.299]; Appendix L (Table 11) shows removing Erdős drops it to +0.014 with CI [-0.109, +0.139], disclosed in Section 5 limitations.

Section 5 'Limitations and future work': authors concede five seeds per condition, a factorial on only three tasks, a critique analysis resting on two hard-validity tasks, no transfer testing beyond verifier-scored optimization, and no direct test of lower-bandwidth channels.

Appendix B, C, and E: artifact includes pinned model IDs, verbatim prompt templates (src/config/prompts.ts), 1,556 saved JSON run traces, deterministic visible/hidden evaluators, and a <$1-per-cell re-run path via OpenRouter (~4 hours full benchmark).

Appendix N (Table 12): mean pairwise solution distance falls from 0.315 (MoA no synthesis) to 0.229 (diverse MoA + synthesis); Appendix AF (Table 27) shows diverse Debate distance collapsing 0.956→0.479 at the round 2→3 full-output exchange, supporting the single-round mechanism claim.

Section 3 Methods and Figure 2/Table 4: hidden and visible rankings diverge on three tasks, and no configuration achieves positive aggregate MEG, i.e., all multi-agent workflows fail to beat the best single-agent baseline under matched budgets.

Table 3 / Appendix AD (Table 26): feasibility results with n=10 per cell — diverse Debate 10/10 vs same-model 2/10 on Knapsack-50 but 0/10 vs 6/10 on 3AP-Free-100 — supporting the fault-localizability moderation claim on only two tasks.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core multi-agent LLM methodology paper squarely within preferred topics (multi-agent orchestration, frontier-LLM backbones, critique/debate reasoning workflows) and not a domain application. The 'interaction tax' concept—full-solution exchange erasing cross-model diversity—is a clean, useful framing connected to classical ensemble theory, and the diversity×synthesis 2×2 factorial with the MIG metric is a genuine design contribution, though convergence-to-consensus effects in debate are partially known, capping novelty. Rigor is above average: budget-matched protocols, hidden evaluators separating search from final scoring, bootstrap CIs, leave-one-out and cross-synthesizer sensitivity checks, and unusually candid limitations. However, evidence is uneven: the headline diversity coefficient (+0.188) collapses to +0.014 when Erdős is withheld (Appendix L), the main benchmark uses only five seeds, the factorial covers just three tasks, the critique-helps claim rests on two hard-validity tasks with n=10 cells, and several tasks (MaxCut, LJ-n=41) provide zero signal. Generalizability is limited by the verifier-scored optimization setting and three model families, which the authors themselves flag. Reproducibility is excellent: pinned model IDs, verbatim prompts, 1,556 saved traces, deterministic evaluators, and a cheap re-run path. Net: a solid, honest, well-instrumented contribution with moderate fragility in its headline quantitative claim.

primary_link.title: The Interaction Tax: When Communication Erases Diversity in Multi-Agent Teams

papers.summary: Does multi-agent LLM interaction help or hurt? Some work reports gains from debate (Du et al., 2024), critique loops (Chen et al., 2025), and mixture-of-agents synthesis (Wang et al., 2025), while other work finds that interaction adds cost without improving quality under equal budgets (Tran & Kiela, 2026; Xu et al., 2026; Jarrett et al., 2025), or that independent sampling already captures multi-agent gains (Li et al., 2024). We argue this contradiction partly reflects a missing distinction, be
papers.summary_zh: 多代理 LLM 系統究竟有幫助還是有害?文獻對辯論、評審迴圈與混合代理(MoA)的增益,與單代理在相同預算下不遜於多代理的證據並存。本研究在 11 個由驗證器評分的最佳化任務上,以相同資源預算比較 Claude Sonnet 4、GPT-4o 與 Gemini 2.5 Flash 組成的十種配置,主張此矛盾源於並非所有多代理溝通皆等價:當代理互讀彼此的完整解答時,提案會在一輪內趨同,抹消採用多模型所欲保留的差異,作者稱之為「互動稅」。實驗顯示每個單一模型家族至少在一個任務得零分,多元團隊則從未得零分;2×2 因子實驗中多樣性效應為 +0.188(95% CI 不含零),合成效應則近零。Chain、MAgICoRe、Debate 等全解互動配置在同模型時 MIG 為正,改用異質模型即轉負;唯 MoA 因提案者從不看彼此輸出而維持正值。批評僅在錯誤易於定位與修補時有效,如 Knapsack 的容量違規可讓多元 Debate 可行率達 10/10;在需推理才能找到違規的 3AP-Free 上反而跌至 0/10。限制包括:多樣性增益高度依賴 Erdős 任務(剔除後係數降至 +0.014、CI 跨零)、主要基準每格僅五個種子,且結論僅限驗證器評分的最佳化問題。本文指出多代理成效取決於交換的資訊內容與時機,而非代理數量;獨立生成加選擇,或以低頻寬訊號取代完整解答交換,才是較穩健的預設做法。

links.title: AgentRoom: Concurrent Multi-Agent Coding in a CRDT-Backed Shared Workspace

evidence: Abstract/§4.1: pooled CMH across 12 model×task strata puts Solo's abandonment odds at 13.7× AgentRoom's (95% CI [3.9,48], p<10^-5, Tarone homogeneity p=0.92); App. B.12 threshold sweep keeps T4-only CMH OR>=6.3, p<0.001 across all 12 threshold combinations

§4.2 Table 1: T4 Sonnet matched-compute six-condition ablation; AgentRoom 0.669 (n=14) vs parallel-merge 0.456 (n=12), +0.213, Welch t=3.35, p=0.003; parallel-merge underperforms solo (0.456 vs 0.544)
§5/App. B.13: bundle probe step from prompt-only (0.588, n=7) to AgentRoom (0.669) spans zero at n=7, so the substrate-vs-coordination split is claimed only as an ordering, not a percentage

§7 Limitations: all headline cells share one Express.js/TypeScript runtime; Rust+axum check (App. B.17, Δ=+0.026, Welch p=0.68, n=4 vs 5) and DevBench Python (App. B.16, 8/10 vs 7/10, n=10) are individually underpowered descriptive checks

§2.5/App. E: Sonnet LLM-judge tracks cross-vendor Codex judge at r=0.86 (n=26) and regex scorer at r=0.67 (n=246); App. B.18 execution-oracle replay corroborates ordering endpoints (AgentRoom 5.06/10 capabilities vs parallel-merge 1.00/10) but disagrees on interior pairs

§3: no seeds set for proprietary hosted models, bit-for-bit reproducibility not claimed; CLI versions pinned (Claude Code 2.1.119, Codex CLI 0.120.0, Gemini CLI 0.40.1); codebook, judge rubric, and scripts/ast_scorer.mjs stated to ship with the release

§4.5: agent-count sweep on T4 Sonnet peaks at N=2 (0.544/0.669/0.553/0.489 for ×1-×4) with super-linear broadcast traffic past ×3; §4.4 excludes GPT-5.4-mini for a vendor-CLI crash under concurrent MCP execution
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-preference: a multi-agent LLM coding system using MCP tool calling (room_claim/broadcast/state), frontier LLMs, and LLM-judge evaluation, squarely matching Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, and Code & Programming. Novelty is moderate: CRDTs, MCP, and advisory locking are existing components, but the explicit coordination layer vs. CodeCRDT's implicit observation-driven design, and the first matched-compute ablation isolating coordination from parallelism and substrate, is a genuine delta. Rigor is above average for the area: tiered evidence, CMH with Tarone homogeneity, pre-stated deterministic codebook with threshold sweep (OR>=6.3 across all 12 combos), pool sensitivity, three cross-validated scorers, and cross-vendor judges (r=0.86). Weakened by small per-cell n (7-35, some n=2-3), agent-authored tests with no held-out correctness suite, and a substrate-vs-coordination decomposition whose key step spans zero at n=7 (honestly reported as ordering only). Evidence is strong for abandonment suppression (CMH OR=13.7, p<1e-5, replicated across 3 models) and credible for the parallel-merge contrast (+0.213, p=0.003, same-producer bias-immune), but the headline attribution claim rests partly on underpowered cells, and the execution-oracle replay (App. B.18) corroborates only the ordering endpoints. Generalizability is limited: one Express.js/TypeScript runtime for all headline cells, descriptive Rust (p=0.68) and DevBench (8/10 vs 7/10) spot checks, N=2 sweet spot, proprietary models. Reproducibility is partial: pinned CLI versions, released codebook/scripts/rubric claimed, but no seeds and hosted-model drift preclude bit-level replication.

primary_link.title: AgentRoom: Concurrent Multi-Agent Coding in a CRDT-Backed Shared Workspace

papers.summary: Concurrent multi-agent coding promises division of labor across modules, robustness through redundancy, and parallel exploration at the natural granularity of multi-file projects. Realtime collaborative editing protocols solve this coordination problem for human teams via Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs), but the LLMs underneath generate one token at a time and existing multi-agent coding systems inherit this serial limit: they either sequence agents through phase handoffs or pool ind
papers.summary_zh: 並行多代理編碼承諾分工、冗餘與平行探索,但現有系統多採序列式階段交接,或僅獨立取樣後合併。AgentRoom 提出以 CRDT 為基底的即時協作協定:N 個編碼代理共享一個由 CRDT 逐字元合併的檔案系統,並透過 MCP 工具(room_claim、room_broadcast、room_state 等)執行檔案層級的宣告、廣播與狀態查詢,配合建議性的六步協作流程。實驗以五個前沿模型在四個 Express.js/TypeScript 後端任務上,比較 Solo、共享工作區、parallel-merge 與 AgentRoom 等條件。核心發現:第一,雙代理能壓制單代理的 stub-and-exit 放棄模式,跨 12 個模型×任務分層的 Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel 分析顯示 Solo 的放棄勝算是 AgentRoom 的 13.7 倍(p<10^-5);第二,在相同運算下,AgentRoom 的 LLM-judge 平均品質比未協調的 parallel-merge 高 0.213(Welch p=0.003),且未協調並行甚至低於單代理;第三,六條件呈單調排序,顯示增益主要來自明確的協調層而非 CRDT 基底本身,代理數以 N=2 最佳,之後品質下滑。限制:各格樣本數僅 7–35、主要結果限於單一 TypeScript 執行環境(Rust 與 Python 僅小規模抽查)、品質由 LLM 評審而非執行驗證,且託管模型無法逐位元重現。本研究首次在相同運算下隔離協調層的貢獻,對多代理編碼系統的設計與評估具直接參考價值。
