links.title: Enrich-Retrieve-Rank: Scaling Capability Discovery Beyond In-Context Routing

evidence: Abstract: in-context routing Match@1 collapses 0.85→0.12 from N=10 to 7,278 while retrieve-then-rank degrades 0.81→0.39; pipeline leads Search&Pick by 6.5pp at half cost and 70× cheaper than Full-Ctx.
§4.2 Table 2: Tools-ToolRet (7,961 queries, N=7,278) Ours+Titan 0.397 vs Search&Pick 0.332 vs Full-Ctx 0.166; Full-Ctx uses n=500 subsample on large registries due to context window (fn. 2).

§4.3/App E Table 9: enrichment neutral-to-negative on public registries (±0.1pp ToolRet, −4.4pp MCP) but +5.8/+9.1/+25.6pp Match@1 under controlled metadata degradation (McNemar p<1e-6), with Recall@15 0.134→0.467 at name-only.

§4.4/App C: ~70% of large-registry misses occur at retrieval; factorization 0.39 ≈ 0.56×0.70 shows first-stage recall is the bottleneck; ToolBench-IR fine-tuned retriever does not close it (App G Table 11).
§4.5: crossover at N≈500 in Nova Micro sweep; Full-Ctx drops −13pp per doubling above 500 and loses 4,023/7,278 tools to alphabetic truncation; CIs ±10pp on the 100-query slice (fn. 3).
§4.7 Table 4: reranker ordering Claude Sonnet 4 > Nova Micro ≈ Nova Lite >> Claude 3.5 Haiku stable across n=500 to full n; conditional accuracy stays in 0.70–0.87 band.
§4.8 Table 3: Ours+BM25 $0.066/1k queries vs Full-Ctx $4.48 (real token counts for baselines; Ours rows are post-hoc estimates ±5-10%).

§4.2/§4.6/Limitations: Agents-ToolRet shares 89% of registry with Tools-ToolRet (near-replicate), Agents-AppWorld saturates at 1.00, Skills-MCP queries paraphrase descriptions; no independent agent/skill win at scale.
§5/App H Table 12: production Quality+Intent signals add +4.5pp Match@1 (McNemar p=0.031) on an internal n=221 benchmark only.

App F: per-source breakdown shows broad gains (13/16 Tools, 12/16 Agents sources with n≥100) and identifies malformed 'ultratool' source; excluding it shifts all methods ~+2pp without changing ordering.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems-and-scaling study of capability discovery for agent ecosystems, squarely matching top-weight preferences: Agents & Tool Use (tool retrieval, MCP, multi-agent routing, production deployment), LLMs (Nova Micro/Claude rerankers), and RAG-style retrieve-then-rank. Novelty is moderate: the paper itself concedes it 'composes established components' (offline enrichment, BM25/BGE, listwise reranking, §3) and concurrent works (Tool-DE, Multi-Field Tool Retrieval, §2) do enrich-then-retrieve; the genuinely new pieces are the N=10→7,278 degradation curve with crossover ~N=500 (§4.5), the retrieval-vs-rerank decomposition (~70% of misses at retrieval, §4.4/App C), and production-grounded cost baselines. Rigor is strong for a systems paper: bootstrap CIs, McNemar tests (App E p<1e-6; App H p=0.031), enrichment/per-field/sparsity ablations, cross-model sweeps over 4-6 rerankers (Tables 4-5), error taxonomy (App D), per-source analysis including flagging a malformed benchmark source (App F). Evidence is solid but with honest caveats: the headline enrichment component is neutral-to-negative on public data (±0.1pp ToolRet, −4.4pp MCP, §4.3) and only helps under synthetic metadata degradation (App E); the N=500 crossover rests on a 100-query slice with ±10pp CIs (fn. 3); pipeline cost rows are post-hoc estimates ±5-10% (Table 3); Full-Ctx runs on n=500 subsamples at scale, and Agents-ToolRet shares 89% of its registry with Tools-ToolRet, so cross-type claims are weak (§4.2, §4.6, Limitations). Generalizability is partially demonstrated (one config across three registry types; ordering stable across rerankers) but the authors admit benchmarks cannot separate size from type and production-only signals (Quality/Intent) are untestable publicly. Reproducibility is middling: public benchmarks, named models, exact weights (0.50/0.05/0.30/0.15) and k are given, but no code/data release is stated and key components (internal registry, trust scores, enrichment LLM) are proprietary. A well-calibrated, honestly-limitationed engineering contribution rather than a methodological advance.

primary_link.title: Enrich-Retrieve-Rank: Scaling Capability Discovery Beyond In-Context Routing

papers.summary: Agent ecosystems now include thousands of MATS components (Models, Agents, Tools, and Skills), yet their discovery still relies on in-context routing. These systems read a registry (names, hints, or descriptions, as context budget permits), pick a candidate, invoke it, and retry on failure. This pattern degrades with scale, and registries are growing fast. We recast capability discovery as search over a registry by defining an offline enrichment step that turns sparse metadata into searchable pr
papers.summary_zh: 代理生態系統如今包含數千個MATS元件(模型、代理、工具與技能),但其探索仍依賴情境內路由:把註冊表內容塞進提示詞、由LLM挑選、失敗後重試。此模式隨規模惡化,而註冊表正快速成長。本文將能力探索重新表述為對註冊表的資訊檢索問題:離線富集階段在註冊時以LLM把稀疏詮釋資料改寫為含摘要、動作導向描述、關鍵詞與使用範例的結構化檔案;線上則執行「檢索後重排」管線,以BM25與BGE/Titan等稠密向量檢索取回前k名候選,再以單次LLM呼叫重排,全程不實際呼叫任何候選。證據顯示,當N從10成長到7,278時,情境路由的Match@1由0.85崩落至0.12,檢索後重排僅由0.81緩降至0.39,交叉點約在N=500;重排器條件準確度穩定於0.70至0.87,約70%的失誤源自檢索階段。完整規模下,管線Match@1領先Search&Pick 6.5個百分點且成本約其一半,較Full-Ctx便宜70倍。限制方面:富集在描述完善的公開資料上效果中性甚至負面,其價值隨詮釋資料稀疏度放大;代理與技能基準受建構限制,難以獨立驗證跨型別結論;Quality與Intent訊號所需的信任與型別詮釋資料為公開資料集所缺。此管線已在大型多代理平台生產環境部署,凸顯規模化下「先檢索、後精選」的架構必要性。
papers.title: Enrich-Retrieve-Rank: Scaling Capability Discovery Beyond In-Context Routing
papers.title_zh: Enrich-Retrieve-Rank:超越情境內路由的能力探索規模化

links.title: AQLoRA: A Zero-Search Recipe for Fast Quantized LoRA Fine-Tuning

evidence: Abstract and Table 4: speed setting 'trains 11.1±2.7% faster than well-tuned QLoRA', faster 'in every one of nine independent timing sessions, at worst by 7%', pooled over clean sessions per model (phi-1.5 +12.9, Llama-3.2-1B +11.4, Phi-3-mini +11.1±4.1).

Section 7.2 / Table 5: fixed-budget selection control on phi-1.5 (K=29) — 'Eight of the ten random draws beat it' top-K by NF4 error on base perplexity (top-K gain +0.036 vs matched random +0.074), downstream 8-task within seed spread (74.78 top-K vs 74.63 random), so the criterion's mechanism is unsupported.

Section 8 (Limitations): authors concede 'protecting the ones our criterion picks is not measurably better than protecting an arbitrary set of the same size' and 'the reason we gave for the recipe is not supported by our own control'.
Section 4 (Hardware): all results on 'One V100-SXM2-32GB per run'; Appendix E states edge figures are 'bandwidth-scaled projections', not on-device measurements.

Table 2 / Section 5.1: Qwen2.5-7B AQLoRA-q 89.0 matches fp16 LoRA 89.0 at 10.55 GiB vs 19.06 GiB; 14B AQLoRA-s 91.3 vs QLoRA 91.1 with fp16-protected layers computed in fp32 to avoid AMP collapse (Section 8).
Table 1 and Section 7.4: phi-1.5 accuracy parity — AQLoRA-q 74.78±0.25 vs QLoRA 74.69±0.22 over six seeds; Qwen2.5-7B AQLoRA-q 89.08±0.15 vs QLoRA 88.80±0.09 over three seeds.

Artifacts/reproducibility: 'Code and the raw per-run artifacts: https://github.com/Romyull-Islam/AQLoRA'; Section 4 states 'Every run writes a report.' so tables can be 'recomputed from the artifacts alone'; Appendix I gives per-baseline fidelity notes.
Appendix A / Table 7: shared-lever protocol is not neutral — QDoRA gains +0.89 under its native recipe and passes AQLoRA-q by 0.26, though at 1.9× training time (524 vs 274 min).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methods paper on faster quantized LoRA fine-tuning of LLMs (QLoRA/LoRA/rsLoRA/LoftQ across phi-1.5, Llama-3.2, Phi-3-mini, Qwen2.5), squarely in-scope for LLM training efficiency. Preference relevance is high; it is core LLM fine-tuning methodology, not a domain application. Novelty is genuinely limited: the paper itself states 'No single part is new' — sensitivity-based protection (Unsloth, QEFT/OWQ), depth-restricted adapter placement (AdapterDrop), and early backward stopping are all prior work, and its one nominally novel element (the zero-search top-K NF4-error rule) is refuted by its own control showing random budget-matched selections do as well or better. Rigor is unusually strong: multi-seed repeats, nine independent interleaved timing sessions with duplicate-arm noise floors, reporting of discarded sessions, two failed controls disclosed, corrections of earlier draft claims (rsLoRA composition significance, Llama-3.2-1B exception), and honest parity-not-win framing. Evidence is solid for the headline speed result (11.1±2.7% over QLoRA, faster in every clean session, min margin 7% exceeding all floors; Table 4) and for accuracy parity, but the mechanism evidence is negative, the quality-setting gain (4.8±2.4%) has spread equal to the effect, and edge/phone figures are bandwidth-scaled projections (Appendix E), not measurements. Generalizability is moderate: four architecture families and two task families (commonsense + GSM8K), but a single V100 GPU class, one epoch, rank sweep on phi-1.5 only, and an admitted budget-specification flaw across architectures (layer-fraction vs parameter-fraction). Reproducibility is excellent: code plus raw per-run report. artifacts released, hyperparameters and baseline fidelity notes given, and every table claimed recomputable without a GPU.

primary_link.title: AQLoRA: A Zero-Search Recipe for Fast Quantized LoRA Fine-Tuning

papers.summary: Quantized fine-tuning (QLoRA) saves memory but not time. It dequantizes every 4-bit weight on the fly, so it trains more slowly than fp16 LoRA. We present AQLoRA (Adaptive-Quantization LoRA), a recipe that buys part of that time back. One CPU pass over the weights sets everything, with no search and no calibration data. The pass ranks layers by NF4 reconstruction error and keeps the top-K in fp16 under a memory budget. Those layers skip dequantization, which is where the speed comes from. A qual
papers.summary_zh: 量化微調QLoRA節省記憶體卻犧牲速度,因每次前向與反向傳遞都須即時解量化4-bit權重,吞吐量僅為fp16 LoRA的0.7至0.8倍。本文提出AQLoRA,以單次CPU掃描、零搜尋且免校準資料的配方買回部分速度:掃描依各線性層的NF4重建誤差排序,在記憶體預算內將受損最重的前K層保留為fp16,使其跳過解量化;品質設定對所有層放置adapter,速度設定只在頂部區塊放置,使反向傳播提前停止。評估於Commonsense-170K涵蓋六個模型、四種架構家族(1.4B至14B):速度設定較調校良好的QLoRA快11.1±2.7%,約犧牲一個準確度百分點,且在九次獨立計時工作階段中每次皆更快;品質設定快4.8±2.4%,準確度與QLoRA持平、與fp16 LoRA差距在一點之內,僅多約0.2 GiB記憶體;此規則於數秒內重現Unsloth手工策展的dynamic-4bit選擇。作者誠實報告陰性對照:以權重密度挑選adapter層、或以量化誤差挑選保護層,皆不優於隨機;帶來速度的是受保護層的數量而非其身分。論文亦詳述共用硬體上的計時方法學:跨工作階段變異遠大於單一工作階段內的雜訊地板,隨機種子幾乎不解釋任何變異。限制包括14B於pre-bf16硬體上fp16保護層可能溢位(以fp32計算緩解)、rsLoRA組合在共享學習率與高rank下崩潰。此配方讓無法執行自訂核心或FP8方法的V100級與邊緣裝置,也能以接近4-bit的記憶體快速微調。
papers.title: AQLoRA: A Zero-Search Recipe for Fast Quantized LoRA Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: AQLoRA:零搜尋的快速量化LoRA微調配方

links.title: AgentFlow: A Flow-Centric Policy Language and Framework for Securing LLM Agent Systems

evidence: Abstract: 'On 949 AgentDojo injected test cases across four suites, AgentFlow reduces confirmed compromise from 33.0% to 0.0% while improving aggregate utility from 46.7% to 63.3%' and AgentDyn 200-case stress test reduces compromise 73.5% to 0.0% with utility 44.5% to 43.5%.

§1 Contributions: formal model with multi-dimensional label lattice, append-only provenance graph, tool propagation functions, and small-step operational semantics; SMT-based verifier for a bounded structured policy fragment with counterexample traces.

§5 & Appendix A: operational semantics (RTA/RTD/RTP rules) and Theorems 1-7 including Runtime Preservation, Policy Enforcement Soundness, Delegation Safety, Trust Preservation, External Disclosure Control, and Path Safety with proofs.
§8.3 Table 3: mechanism ablation on 12-case slices per suite (A0-A6); A6 raises Travel utility from 3/12 to 11/12 and Banking from 3/12 to 8/12 while retaining 0/12 compromise.
§8.6 Table 5: all seven safety properties verify UNSAT with k=10 in under 0.5s using Z3; seeded verifier-bug study catches 12/12 unsafe policy variants.

§8.8 Table 6: feature comparison with FIDES, CaMeL, FORGE, SAMOS; CaMeL public artifact reproduction completes 949 cases at 60.1% utility vs AgentFlow 63.3%, described as 'an artifact-level comparison, not a head-to-head security ranking'.

§8.9 Limitations: overtainting in message-heavy workflows because runtime cannot recover token-level dependencies; SMT verifier provides guarantees only for 'the verifier's bounded, structured abstraction'.

§8.1: 'We use a fixed frontier LLM configuration' with the model never named; Progent comparisons denominator-aligned only for Slack and Banking; §8.5 notes replay checks 'test policy-gate coverage, not end-to-end agent utility'.
§8.7: average per-intercept policy latency 6.4μs (P50 6.0μs, P99 9.7μs), negligible relative to LLM inference.

No public code/artifact release URL for the AgentFlow prototype is stated anywhere in the document; §8.1 mentions only that 'The artifact includes case-level traces and the classifier script' for the AgentDojo post-processing.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: a declarative policy language and runtime reference monitor for securing tool-using LLM agents against indirect prompt injection, exfiltration, trust laundering, and unsafe delegation, aligning with the highest-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation). Novelty is moderate: the paper itself concedes IFC/reference monitoring is not new (§1) and competes with CaMeL, FIDES, FORGE, SAMOS, and Progent; its distinct deltas are a standalone policy layer over labeled runtime edges, explicit path/history (temporal trace) rules, task-scoped capabilities, and a bounded SMT verifier. Rigor is solid: formal label lattice and operational semantics (§5), six theorems with proofs in Appendix A, ablation over mechanism configurations (Table 3), seeded verifier-bug study catching 12/12 variants (§8.6), and 6.4μs median-path overhead (§8.7); deductions for a custom four-way compromise taxonomy defined by the authors (§8.2), small 12-case ablation slices, and only partial denominator-aligned baseline comparisons (Slack/Banking for Progent; CaMeL artifact-level only). Evidence is detailed and honestly scoped as preliminary (Abstract, §8.9), with zero confirmed compromise on 949 AgentDojo and 200 AgentDyn cases, but the defense's utility depends on per-suite hand-written policies, overtainting limits message-heavy workflows (§8.9), and replay checks are deterministic policy-gate tests rather than end-to-end utility (§8.5). Generalizability is supported by seven benchmark surfaces and a model-agnostic middleware interface, tempered by policy-authoring burden and bounded SMT guarantees. Reproducibility is limited: no public code release of the prototype is stated, and the 'fixed frontier LLM configuration' is never named (§8.1), though case-level traces and a classifier script are mentioned.

primary_link.title: AgentFlow: A Flow-Centric Policy Language and Framework for Securing LLM Agent Systems

papers.summary: LLM agents increasingly read untrusted content, invoke external tools, access private data, and delegate work to other agents. Harm often arises not from a single unsafe action but from the flow of sensitive data across a sequence of otherwise plausible steps. We present AgentFlow, a flow-centric policy language and runtime enforcement model for specifying where data may travel in agent systems. Policies are defined over labeled runtime edges and constrain which tools may receive sensitive field
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理人會讀取不可信內容、呼叫外部工具、存取私人資料並委派任務給子代理人，危害常來自一連串看似合理步驟之間的資料流動，例如機密紀錄經 LLM 摘要後寄出電子郵件即構成外洩。本文提出 AgentFlow，一套以資料流為核心的政策語言與執行框架：以敏感度、類別與可信度三維標籤描述資料，流程規則約束單一步驟（哪些工具可接收敏感欄位、哪些輸出端點可接收資料），路徑規則處理多步驟歷史（如先偵察後外洩的時間模式），並支援任務範圍的能力授予與可控解密。執行期由參考監控器攔截工具呼叫與回應端點，判定 Allow、Deny 或 Pause；部署前另以 SMT 驗證器檢查有界政策片段的安全性質。在 AgentDojo 949 個注入案例中，確認的攻擊成功率由 33.0% 降至 0.0%，效用由 46.7% 提升至 63.3%；AgentDyn 200 例壓力測試亦將妥協率由 73.5% 降為 0.0%，並在 ASB、InjecAgent、BIPIA 等基準的回放檢查中封鎖攻擊流程。驗證器抓出全部 12 個植入的錯誤政策變體，七項安全性質各於 0.5 秒內驗畢，單次攔截平均延遲約 6.4 微秒。限制包括訊息密集流程中汙點標記過度保守、需明確的釋放情境，且保證範圍限於政策可見的行為。此研究讓資訊流控制成為可宣告、可驗證的政策層，對 LLM 代理人安全深具實用價值。
papers.title: AgentFlow: A Flow-Centric Policy Language and Framework for Securing LLM Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: AgentFlow：以資料流為核心的政策語言與框架，守護 LLM 代理人系統安全

links.title: XTC: Head-Aware Sampling by Excluding Top Choices

evidence: Abstract: XTC improves Distinct-2 by 11-15% and repeat trigram rate by 27-47% across four tested models, with 60 experiments over Gemma 3 27B/12B, DeepSeek R1 14B, and Llama 3.3 70B

Section 3.1 Algorithm 1: complete sampling step with eligibility threshold tau, intervention probability rho, and protected-token guard; closed-form specification in Appendix A with KL-projection proof (Appendix B, Proposition 5)
Section 4.3.2: blinded AMT study with 150 Master-qualified raters, 3 annotators per pair, 62.3% creativity preference for XTC (p<10^-4, Fleiss kappa 0.58) on EQ-Bench v3 prompts

Section 4.4 and Appendix H.2 Table 4: IFEval strict accuracy drops only -0.4/-1.7 pp for XTC Light/Medium vs -8.8 pp for temperature matched on Distinct-2; caption admits per-prompt 95% CIs are 'pending re-import' of result CSVs
Appendix D Table 1: cross-model Distinct-2 gains +11.4% to +15.1% with CIs excluding zero; caption notes cross-model runs use 10 prompts per condition vs 24 for primary runs
Appendix C.1 Limitations: eval pass rate degrades above rho=0.15 on code and rho=0.20 on structured extraction; evaluation conducted entirely on quantized open-weight models
Appendix E.2: design ablation shows Keep Least (Distinct-2 0.494) beats Keep Second, Keep Random, and Drop Top-1 Only (0.434), replicating on DeepSeek R1 14B and Gemma 12B q6
Appendix C.4: code and evaluation infrastructure claimed publicly available but URL is '<redactedforanonymity>'; abstract notes prior adoption in llama.cpp, ExLlamaV2, and text-generation-webui
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM decoding methodology paper (sampling operator for autoregressive LLMs), directly matching LLM/inference/NLP/evaluation preferences and not in any out-of-scope category. Novelty is moderate: the head-exclusion rule is simple, positions itself as an inversion of locally typical sampling, and was already merged into llama.cpp/text-generation-webui before formalization, so the paper's contribution is formalization plus evaluation rather than a new capability. Rigor is above average: 60 experiments across four model families (12B-70B), pre-registered judge criteria, design ablations (Keep Least vs. Keep Second/Random/Drop Top-1), factorial composition studies, bootstrap CIs with permutation tests, a blinded AMT study (150 Master raters, 62.3% creativity preference, kappa 0.58), and a cross-vendor GPT-4o judge control mitigating same-family bias. Evidence is strong but with admitted gaps: IFEval per-prompt CIs are 'pending re-import' (Appendix H.2 Table 4), cross-model runs use only 10 prompts per condition (Table 1 caption), and a DeepSeek reasoning-trace measurement error required a re-run. Generalizability is decent across architectures and scales but limited to quantized open-weight English models, with acknowledged model/tokenizer sensitivity of the absolute threshold. Reproducibility is mixed: the algorithm and closed-form specification are complete and implementations ship in public inference engines, but the code URL is redacted.

primary_link.title: XTC: Head-Aware Sampling by Excluding Top Choices

papers.summary: Standard decoding rules for autoregressive language models promote diversity by rescaling the full next-token distribution or truncating its low-probability tail. These strategies overlook a common regime of open-ended generation in which several continuations are plausible but too much probability mass remains concentrated on the most generic choice. We introduce XTC (Exclude Top Choices), a lightweight head-aware decoding operator that targets this regime directly. XTC identifies tokens whose
papers.summary_zh: 自迴歸語言模型的開放式生成常出現「頭部歧異」情境：模型對數個合理續寫皆賦予可觀機率，卻仍過度集中於最平庸的選項；傳統 top-k、top-p 截斷尾部或以溫度全域重整分配的方法，對此無法對症下藥。本文提出 XTC（Exclude Top Choices）解碼算子：先找出機率高於絕對門檻 τ 的合格 token，當其數量達兩個以上時，以機率 ρ 觸發介入，移除其中較強勢的選項、僅保留最弱但仍合格的替選，再重新正規化；頭部明確或未觸發時完全不作用，因此具時間稀疏性，且可插入任何取樣器堆疊組合使用。涵蓋 Gemma 3 27B、Gemma 3 12B、DeepSeek R1 14B 與 Llama 3.3 70B 的 60 項實驗顯示，XTC 在創意生成上將 Distinct-2 提升 11–15%、重複三元組率減少 27–47%；與溫度縮放疊加時，總改善分別達 38% 與 71%。150 名 Master 評審的盲測人類研究顯示 62.3% 的創意偏好（p<10^-4）且不損流暢度；IFEval 上 XTC Medium 僅損失 1.7 個百分點，而達到相近 Distinct-2 的溫度設定會損失 8.8 個百分點。限制方面，程式碼等講求精確的任務在 ρ>0.15 後明顯退化，門檻為絕對機率、跨模型與分詞器需個別調校，且實驗僅限於量化開源模型。XTC 已獲 llama.cpp 等開源框架採用，對實務文字生成極具影響力。
papers.title: XTC: Head-Aware Sampling by Excluding Top Choices
papers.title_zh: XTC：透過排除首要選項實現頭部感知取樣

links.title: Toward Effective and Reliable LLM Agents via Dynamic Ontology

evidence: Section 1/3: proposes OaK, an ontology-as-a-kernel framework where kernel K=(S,F) mediates all agent access to evidence and operations
Section 3.2 Step 1: drafted schemas are encoded as OWL and checked with HermiT (five validity kinds detailed in Appendix A) before use
Section 4.2: backbones DeepSeek-v4-flash and gpt-4o-mini; judge fixed to claude-sonnet-4.6; 20% training sample per round, at most 5 iterations, 20-step ReAct cap
Table 1 (Section 4.3): TravelPlanner final pass rate 55.90 (OaK) vs 51.50 (MemP) on DeepSeek-v4-flash and 68.00 vs 54.50 on gpt-4o-mini; ReCode leads CS Micro 86.60 over OaK 86.11
Table 2 (Section 4.3): CRMArenaPro highest Avg. for OaK in all four B2B/B2C x backbone cells, e.g., 78.38 vs MemP 66.44 (B2B, DeepSeek-v4-flash)
Table 3 (Section 4.3): ToolQA weighted average 64.58 (DeepSeek) and 59.32 (gpt-4o-mini), highest among compared methods
Section 4.4 / Figures 2-4: ablations removing function composition, function module, and iterative refinement all degrade performance across the three benchmarks
Appendix C / Table 4: multi-seed TravelPlanner final 55.90 +/- 2.13, CS Macro 58.60 +/- 2.38, HC Macro 61.57 +/- 1.04
Section 4.7 / Figure 8: OaK uses fewer input tokens than ReAct/MemP but higher runtime and output tokens due to per-query graph instantiation
Section 5: limitations include graph-instantiation cost and dependence on the LLM extractor, judge, and a reliable task evaluator; no code or artifact release stated anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope agent paper: an LLM-agent framework (OaK) coupling dynamically constructed ontologies, schema-guided knowledge graphs, typed reasoning functions, and judge-driven refinement, directly matching Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RAG & Knowledge, and multi-step reasoning preferences. Novelty is moderate: individual ingredients (LLM schema drafting, KG construction, LLM-as-judge, ReAct tool calling) are established, but the ontology-as-kernel framing with formal HermiT verification of the drafted schema and joint schema/function repair is a fresh combination. Rigor is solid but not exceptional: three benchmarks, two backbones, five baselines, three ablations, and multi-seed variance are present, yet there are no significance tests, baseline tuning/fairness under the same training data is unspecified, and some baseline scores (e.g., ReCode at 26.25/24.41 on CRMArenaPro, Table 2) look anomalous without explanation. Evidence is credible and text matches tables (e.g., MemP leads HC Micro 63.91 vs OaK 59.31 while OaK leads Final 55.90 vs 51.50), but no code or artifact release is claimed anywhere. Generalizability is supported by diverse task settings but constrained by the need for training data, reference corpora, and a reliable automated evaluator (acknowledged in Section 5). Reproducibility is middling: good implementation detail (Section 4.2, Appendices A-B) but no availability statement and prompts/feedback templates not fully shown.

primary_link.title: Toward Effective and Reliable LLM Agents via Dynamic Ontology

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents rely heavily on knowledge encoded in model parameters or presented as unstructured context. In domain-specific tasks, this leaves important semantic connections implicit. This often results in incomplete evidence use and brittle multi-step decisions. Ontologies offer a way to externalize domain concepts and relations as machine-interpretable structures, but constructing task-usable ontologies traditionally requires substantial effort from domain experts and is d
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理人多半依賴模型參數或非結構化上下文，領域語意連結隱而不顯，導致證據運用不完整、多步驟決策脆弱；而傳統本體建構又需要大量專家投入且難以規模化。本文提出 OaK（ontology-as-a-kernel）框架，為每項任務動態建構以本體為核心的介面：先經需求分析、綱要草擬與 HermiT 形式驗證產生任務導向綱要，再以分塊—映射—合併流程從資料實例化知識圖譜，並將通用圖操作編譯成型別化推理函式；評審模型依官方分數與執行軌跡，逐輪提出增刪修補建議以精煉綱要與函式，收斂後凍結核心，由 ReAct 代理人在推論期以函式為工具、於受限的語意空間內取用證據作答。在 TravelPlanner、CRMArenaPro 與 ToolQA 三個基準上，OaK 於 DeepSeek-v4-flash 與 gpt-4o-mini 兩種骨幹皆取得最佳整體成績，如 TravelPlanner 最終 pass rate 達 55.90%、CRMArenaPro B2B 平均 78.38%、ToolQA 加權平均 64.58%；消融實驗證實函式模組、函式組合與迭代精煉缺一不可，多次隨機種子結果亦穩定。限制在於每項查詢需即時建構圖譜的成本、品質取決於 LLM 抽取器與評審，且需可靠的任務評估器。此研究將領域語意轉為可檢視、可執行的契約，兼顧效果與多步驟推理的可靠性。
papers.title: Toward Effective and Reliable LLM Agents via Dynamic Ontology
papers.title_zh: 以動態本體邁向有效且可靠的 LLM 代理人

links.title: Compositional Chain-of-Relations for Faithful Knowledge Graph Question Answering with Large Language Models

evidence: Section I: paper states it is 'an extended version of conference paper CoR [28]', with the constraint chain and refined KGR/FF1 as the additions — bounds novelty of the core relation-centric paradigm
Section VI-E1, Table III: CCoR achieves 66.0 Hits@1 / 57.5 F1 on CWQ vs PoG 63.2 and RoG 62.6 under GPT-3.5-turbo; best on CWQ and QALD10 among compared methods
Section VI-E2, Table IV: KGR rises from 63.3 (PoG) to 90.4 on WebQSP and 37.1 to 69.1 on CWQ under GPT-4.1-mini; IO-Prompt and CoT-Prompt score KGR 0.0, illustrating the metric's purpose

Section VI-B: baseline results 'taken from their original papers' for tuning/retrieval methods while ToG/PoG are 'reproduced from official codebases' — mixed evaluation provenance without unified settings

Section VI-I, Table IX: cumulative ablation on CWQ — removing constraint chain drops KGR 69.1→49.8, plus backtracking removal→42.6, plus GEF removal→29.8; cumulative design weakens per-component attribution

Section V: KGR assigns fixed weights (1.0/0.5/0) to author-labeled grounding states, and baseline grounding states are categorized 'under the same criteria and protocol' defined by the authors — circularity risk for the headline faithfulness gains

Section VI-C: implementation details given (temperature 0.01, beam k=3, depth l=3 or 4, official Freebase snapshot and Wikidata SPARQL endpoint), but no code, data, or prompt release is stated anywhere in the document
Section VI-G, Table VII: token consumption 59.2M on CWQ vs PoG 113.2M and calls 10.20 vs 19.43 (ToG) — efficiency claims quantitatively supported on complex queries
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM methodology paper: KG-augmented LLM reasoning spanning agents/tool-use, RAG/grounding, multi-hop reasoning, and prompting, with faithfulness/hallucination as the central concern. Methodologically clean: relation-centric exploration plus an explicit constraint chain that executes constraints via SPARQL instead of parametric judgment, and new grounding metrics (KGR, FF1). Experiments are broad (4 benchmarks, 4 backbones incl. non-OpenAI, efficiency, ablations, case study). Main weaknesses: it is explicitly an extension of the authors' own conference paper CoR, so the core paradigm is not new; KGR/FF1 are self-defined and self-scored (circularity risk); baseline numbers mix published results and in-house reproductions; ablations are cumulative rather than single-factor; no significance testing; no code/data release. Quantitative gains are consistent and fairly large (e.g., CWQ Hits@1 66.0 vs 63.2 PoG; KGR 90.4 vs 63.3 on WebQSP), supporting the claims, but they come from author-controlled evaluation protocols.
topics: LLM agents / tool use over knowledge graphs

primary_link.title: Compositional Chain-of-Relations for Faithful Knowledge Graph Question Answering with Large Language Models

papers.summary: Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) is a key task for evaluating KG-augmented Large Language Models (LLMs), and complex KGQA that requires multi-hop reasoning is especially challenging. Solving a complex query involves two coupled phases: candidate retrieval, which locates answer candidates over the KG, and constraint handling, which filters these candidates against the query constraints. Faithful reasoning requires grounding both phases in the KG. However, existing agent-based methods gro
papers.summary_zh: 複雜知識圖譜問答（KGQA）包含候選檢索與限制處理兩個耦合階段，但現有以實體為中心的代理人方法有兩大缺陷：一是不可靠的實體剪枝，因圖譜實體資訊常不完整、固定大小子集難以保留所有合法節點，推理路徑易被截斷；二是未錨定於圖譜的限制處理，將限制交由 LLM 參數知識判斷，答案無法驗證且易生幻覺。本文提出以關係而非實體為搜尋單位的關係中心探索典範，並據此設計 CCoR 框架：主鏈自主題實體沿關係鏈建構候選空間，中間實體不剪枝；約束鏈則針對明確限制，透過 SPARQL 在圖譜上顯式執行過濾；另設全域實體過濾與直接生成兩層備援以維持穩健。並提出 KGR 與 Faithful-F1 兩項忠實度指標，區分答案源自圖譜執行、部分圖譜或純參數記憶。在 WebQSP、CWQ、QALD10 與 GrailQA 上，CCoR 於 GPT-3.5-turbo、GPT-4.1-mini、DeepSeek-V3.1 等骨幹皆優於強基線：CWQ 的 Hits@1 由 PoG 的 63.2 升至 66.0，WebQSP 的 KGR 由 63.3 提升至 90.4，每題 LLM 呼叫次數約減半，token 消耗在複雜資料集上僅約對手一半。限制是複雜推理仍需多次 LLM 呼叫，且備援層會降低忠實度。
papers.title: Compositional Chain-of-Relations for Faithful Knowledge Graph Question Answering with Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 以組合式關係鏈實現大型語言模型忠實的知識圖譜問答

links.title: The Geometry of Low-Resource Language Representations

evidence: Abstract: low-resource languages exhibit representational degeneration in final layers; geometric regularisation reduces it during CPT and marginally improves performance for larger models.

Section 4.2, Table 1: the final layer is the only layer where representational degeneration correlates with data scarcity across all 9 models and both metrics (negative Spearman ρ for cosine similarity, positive for IsoScore).
Section 5.1, Table 2: CosReg consistently decreases final-layer cosine similarity and I-STAR consistently increases IsoScore, with negligible cross-metric or cross-layer effects.

Section 5.2, Table 3: CosReg average gains over vanilla CPT are marginal for larger models (e.g., Llama 3.1 8B 25.0→25.1, Gemma 3 12B 36.3→36.4), with larger gains only on AfriMGSM (9.0→9.6 Qwen3 8B; 15.6→16.5 Gemma 3 12B).

Section 7 Limitations: authors state most gains are small in absolute terms, regularisation is only validated during CPT, and instruction-tuning experiments failed to reliably improve IrokoBench performance.
Section 3, footnote 1: code for geometric analysis and regularised CPT is available at github.com/francois-meyer/cpt-geometry.

Appendix A.1/A.2: hyperparameter tuning is documented (lr 1e-5 with cosine decay, 1 epoch, λ=1 for CosReg; λ=1, ζ=0.2, N=250,000 for I-STAR), with final-layer-only regularisation chosen via layer ablations.
Section 3.3: evaluation uses LM Evaluation Harness on IrokoBench (AfriXNLI, AfriMMLU, AfriMGSM) with fixed shot settings and prompt templates from Adelani et al. 2025.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM interpretability paper: analyzes representational geometry (cosine similarity, IsoScore) across 30 languages and 9 open LLMs, then applies CosReg/I-STAR regularization during continued pretraining for 10 African languages. Strongly matches LLM, Interpretability, Training/Optimization, and NLP preferences. Novelty is moderate: metrics and regularizers are borrowed (Gao et al. 2019; Rudman & Eickhoff 2024); the contribution is their first application to decoder-only CPT and the first systematic data-scarcity-vs-geometry link in modern LLMs. Rigor is solid (correlation analysis in Table 1, hyperparameter tuning in Appendix A, layer-placement ablations, honest negative results for small models), but downstream gains are tiny (e.g., Gemma 3 12B average 36.3→36.4 in Table 3) with no statistical significance testing or seed variance reported, so the practical claim is weakly supported relative to the headline framing. Evidence for the analytical finding is consistent across models; evidence for intervention benefit is marginal and mixed. Generalizability is bounded by one CPT phase, one corpus (WURA), and IrokoBench evaluation, though 3 model families and 10 languages partially mitigate this. Reproducibility is good: public code (footnote 1), public data/benchmarks, documented prompts, shots, and hyperparameters.

primary_link.title: The Geometry of Low-Resource Language Representations

radar.summary: The performance gap between low- and high-resource languages in LLMs is widely known, but it remains unclear which internal model factors drive these disparities. In this paper, we characterise this gap through the lens of representational geometry. Comparing the geometric properties of hidden representations across 30 languages reveals that LLM geometry is systematically related to language data availability. The most consistent effect is in final layers, where low-resource languages exhibit re
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型在低資源語言上的表現普遍落後於高資源語言，但哪些內部因素造成此落差尚不清楚。本文從表示幾何的角度切入，以餘弦相似度與等向性兩項指標，比較 30 種語言、9 個開源模型在各層隱藏表示的幾何特性。結果發現 LLM 幾何與語言資料規模系統性相關：語言資料越少，餘弦相似度越高、越缺乏等向性，且最終層的表示退化最一致，顯示模型未能為低資源語言學到幾何豐富的表示。作者據此提出幾何正則化持續預訓練：以 CosReg 懲罰高餘弦相似度、以 I-STAR 提升等向性，在 10 種非洲語言上對 9 個模型進行單語持續預訓練。實驗顯示兩種正則化皆能有效降低最終層退化且不影響其他層；CosReg 在較大模型上帶來小幅一致增益，於最困難的 AfriMGSM 推理任務提升最明顯，並優於 I-STAR。限制方面：平均增益在絕對值上偏小，方法僅於持續預訓練階段驗證，資料可得性也只是影響幾何的因素之一（如使用吉茲字母的阿姆哈拉語即為離群值）。此研究將表示退化與資料稀缺直接連結，示範可操作的可解釋性如何指導低資源語言建模。
radar.title: The Geometry of Low-Resource Language Representations
radar.title_zh: 低資源語言表示的幾何特性

links.title: Data Mixing as Mixture Experiment: Response Surface Methodology and Optimal Design for Large Language Model Pretraining

evidence: Abstract: reports that model-robust I-optimal designs recover the relevant mixture ordering after removing about 25% of the original proxy runs.

Section 4.2, Table 3: sparse second-order Scheffé achieves Spearman ρ=0.975 and PRA=0.937 at 1B scale (n=64) versus LightGBM ρ=0.962 and PRA=0.927, with overlapping 95% bootstrap CIs; the text explicitly cautions against claiming superiority.
Section 3.1: specifies the L1-penalised second-order Scheffé model with λ chosen by 10-fold cross-validation over a log grid from 1e-5 to 1 (selected λ=1.4175e-5), retaining 80 of 153 terms.

Section 5: the design-efficiency simulation uses the sparse Scheffé surface fitted to the full RegMix proxy data as the data-generating mechanism with Gaussian noise from fitted residuals, 1,000 simulated datasets per design size.

Section 6 (Discussion): acknowledges limitations of relying on one publicly available proxy-training dataset, the simulation-based dependence of design conclusions on the fitted surface, and the idealised unconstrained-simplex assumption.

Section 4.1: reports F=6.5145 on 136 interaction and 359 residual degrees of freedom (p<0.001) for the nested-model comparison, and identifies pile_cc-centered negative interactions (e.g., β=-2.62 with arxiv).
Data and Code Availability: states data and code 'will be made publicly available in a GitHub repository upon publication', i.e., not yet available at review time.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodological contribution squarely in LLM pretraining scope: it reframes proxy-based data mixing (RegMix-style workflows) as classical mixture experiments on the simplex, introducing sparse Scheffé response surfaces and model-robust I-optimal designs. The reframing is genuinely novel for the LLM setting and yields interpretable additive/interaction decompositions, though the constituent statistics are standard. Rigor is solid: L1-penalised second-order Scheffé with 10-fold CV, bootstrap CIs (2,000 replicates) on rank metrics, an F-test for interactions, and honest caveats (e.g., overlapping CIs at 1B, single dataset). Evidence is credible but bounded: all empirical results reanalyze one public dataset (RegMix, Pile, 512 proxy runs) and the headline ~25% proxy-run saving is simulation-based, using the paper's own fitted surface as ground truth, a circularity the authors acknowledge. Generalizability claims (multimodal, multilingual, instruction tuning) are plausible but untested. Code is only promised upon publication, though the underlying RegMix data are public. No unsupported prestige-driven inflation; the paper stays within its evidence.

primary_link.title: Data Mixing as Mixture Experiment: Response Surface Methodology and Optimal Design for Large Language Model Pretraining

radar.summary: Data mixing is a central design problem in large language model pretraining: given a fixed token budget, practitioners must decide how much data to allocate to each domain. Recent proxy-based methods address this problem by training small models on candidate mixtures, fitting a response model, and using the response to select mixtures for larger-scale training. We show that this workflow has the structure of a classical mixture experiment. Under this view, data domains are mixture components, to
radar.summary_zh: 選擇預訓練資料混合比例是大型語言模型訓練的核心難題：token 預算固定下，各領域配置互相排擠。本文指出，近年以小型代理模型試跑候選混合、擬合反應模型再外推到大規模訓練的工作流程，本質上就是統計學的混合實驗：資料領域是成分、token 佔比是比例、代理訓練是設計點、驗證損失定義機率單體上的反應曲面。作者以稀疏二階 Scheffé 多項式建模，並建構模型穩健的 I-最佳設計，以 RegMix 公開資料為案例。分析顯示領域價值高度關聯：多個在加成效應下看似不佳的領域（如 arxiv、pubmed_central、github），透過與網路文本 pile_cc 的成對互動反而有利，且模型中最大的四個係數全是 pile_cc 配對。稀疏 Scheffé 模型在 1M、60M、1B 規模間保持混合排序，於 1B 規模甚至略勝 LightGBM，同時提供可解釋的加成與互動分解。模擬研究中，模型穩健 I-最佳設計在移除約 25% 代理訓練後仍能恢復相關排序，直接省下 token 與運算成本。限制在於實證僅基於單一資料集、設計評估依賴模擬，且二次模型未必涵蓋高階互動或閾值效應。本文將資料混合從預測問題重新框定為實驗設計問題，對多模態、多語言等固定預算配置情境皆有啟發。
radar.title: Data Mixing as Mixture Experiment: Response Surface Methodology and Optimal Design for Large Language Model Pretraining
radar.title_zh: 資料混合作為混合實驗：大型語言模型預訓練的反應曲面法與最佳設計

links.title: StrategyBench: Evaluating Explicit Strategy Induction in Large Language Models

evidence: Section 5.2: 'We use Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, 8B, and 14B as backbone models... Qwen3-8B serves as the default strategy generator and Qwen3-4B as the default executor' with k=3 few-shot examples.
Table 3: CoT+Ours achieves best BBH Corr (69.58 vs. CoT 57.30, L2M 58.43), while Ours alone scores 15.90, below Direct ICL 34.31, showing strategy-based ICL is not uniformly beneficial.

Section 3.4 / Table 2: reference strategies generated with gemini-3-flash-preview and filtered by downstream utility vs Direct ICL, yielding S_eff (11,993 strategies, 22 tasks) and S_sig (7,801 strategies, 21 tasks).
Table 1: task filtering reduces 108 tasks / 1,614,716 examples to 44 tasks / 123,845 examples via model-assisted pre-filtering plus human verification (Appendix A).
Table 7: Ours+SFT raises ID Fmat from 6.68 to 62.06 and Sta_rob from 68.08 to 77.79, but Corr slightly drops (22.71 to 21.33); Section 6.3 admits the SFT model does not become 'smarter'.

Section 9 Limitations: evaluation restricted to Qwen3 family 'due to computational resource constraints', data sourced mainly from BIG-Bench/BBH, and failure sources (generation vs. execution errors) not disentangled.

Appendix E Table 10: full SFT hyperparameters (base Qwen3-8B, LoRA rank 16, alpha 32, lr 1e-4, 2200 steps, bf16); decoding settings given (generation temp 0.2, application temp 0.7, seed 42); no code or dataset release statement appears anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM benchmark paper: evaluates explicit strategy induction from few-shot examples in LLMs (Section 1), with Qwen3 backbones explicitly named in the LLM preference list, plus CoT baselines, ICL prompting variants, and LoRA/SFT experiments. Novelty is moderate rather than high: instruction induction and abstraction prompting exist (Honovich et al. 2023; Zheng et al. 2024, cited in Section 1), so the contribution is a systematic benchmark plus dual-axis metrics (strategy quality vs. downstream utility, Section 4), which is a solid but incremental evaluation contribution. Rigor is decent: formal metric definitions (Eqs. 6-12), three baselines (Section 5.1), and ablations over generator/executor scale, shot count, prompt variant, and SFT (Tables 4-7); but evaluation is limited to one model family (Qwen3, acknowledged in Section 9), the statistical test defining S_sig is not specified in the text, and some results are anomalous (Ours alone scores 15.90 Corr on BBH vs. Direct ICL 34.31 in Table 3, and the structured prompt yields lower Fmat than free-form in Table 6, discussed but not fully explained). Evidence strength benefits from honest negative findings (SFT improves Fmat 62.06 vs 6.68 on ID but slightly hurts Corr in Table 7), yet lacks confidence intervals or significance reporting for main comparisons. Generalizability is capped by BIG-Bench-only task sourcing and single-family models (Section 9). Reproducibility has detailed hyperparameters (Appendix E, Table 10: LoRA r=16, alpha=32, lr 1e-4) and prompt templates (Appendix F), but no explicit code or dataset release statement, a notable gap for a benchmark paper.

primary_link.title: StrategyBench: Evaluating Explicit Strategy Induction in Large Language Models

radar.summary: As large language models are increasingly used in data-scarce and evolving task scenarios, few-shot in-context learning (ICL) has become a key paradigm for task adaptation. However, direct ICL often uses a small set of examples without explicitly abstracting task rules, making it sensitive to example construction. In contrast, human learners often reduce such sensitivity by first summarizing task rules from examples and then applying them to new instances. To evaluate this ability, we propose St
radar.summary_zh: 少樣本情境學習常直接餵入範例而不歸納任務規則，對範例構成敏感且難以因應分布變化。人類學習者則傾向先從範例總結規則再套用。為評估模型能否顯式歸納任務層級策略，本文提出 StrategyBench：從 BIG-Bench 篩選出適合策略歸納的任務（由 108 個任務縮減至 44 個），建立參考策略資料集，並從策略品質（簡潔度、格式遵循）與下游效用（正確性、取樣與擾動下的穩定性、答案效率）兩個面向設計指標，同時提供 ID、OOD 與 BBH 測試集。實驗以 Qwen3 系列為主，比較直接 ICL、CoT、Least-to-Most 等基線。主要發現：策略搭配 CoT 在多數類別表現最佳，顯示任務層級規則與逐步推理互補；但策略方法在數值與程序類任務上未必勝過基線，且生成器與執行器的規模配比、範例數量與提示格式都會影響成效。監督式微調可提升簡潔度、格式遵循與穩定性，卻未能提高單次正確率。限制包括資料源集中在 BIG-Bench、僅評測 Qwen3 家族，且尚難區分策略生成與策略執行的失敗來源。此基準將評估焦點從最終答案推向中間的策略表徵，對改良 few-shot 適應具參考價值。

links.title: From Causal Plausibility to Causal Reliability: Evaluating LLMs as Calibrated Direct Causal-Edge Classifiers

evidence: Abstract: 'We systematically evaluate 12 instruction-tuned open-weight models across six benchmark causal graphs, five prompting strategies, and four confidence sources: verbalized, logit-based, cross-prompt agreement, and cross-model agreement.'

Section 3.2: 'We use six graphs from CausalGraphBench (4): AsiaM, River Status, COVID, Coal Gasifier, Hepar2, and Munin1... the six graphs already require approximately 2.5M queries, making full 35-graph evaluation prohibitive.'
Section 4.1.1 / Table 1: 'Recall exceeds precision in 68 of 72 model-dataset combinations (94.4%) after averaging across prompts.'
Section 4.2.1: 'pairwise two-sided Wilcoxon tests over the six datasets show no significant differences after Holm adjustment (minimum adjusted p=0.1875; Appendix Table A9).'
Section 4.3 / Table 4: 'models predict a direct edge for 40.0% of indirect non-edges and 36.0% of reversed direct non-edges, compared with 28.2% of other non-edges.'
Section 4.1.4: 'The benchmark-familiarity audit flags five model-dataset pairs as high risk, all involving AsiaM.'

Limitations: 'Our evaluation covers six of the 35 CausalGraphBench graphs... We treat the published structures as fixed reference graphs... not every prediction labeled as a false positive can be established as causally invalid.'
Abstract: 'Replication materials are available on GitHub.'; Section 1 contributions: 'We will release the code and evaluation artifacts to support reproducibility.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systematic, in-scope LLM evaluation study: 12 open-weight instruction-tuned models are tested as calibrated pairwise direct causal-edge classifiers over six CausalGraphBench graphs, five prompt styles, and four confidence sources, directly touching LLM reasoning, prompting, and evaluation/calibration preferences. The work is methodologically careful: ~2.5M queries, recall-dominance quantified (recall>precision in 68/72 combinations), structural FP analysis (40.0% indirect / 36.0% reversed vs 28.2% other non-edges), Wilcoxon+Holm tests that honestly report non-significant agreement advantages (min adjusted p=0.1875), a three-way label-space ablation, and a contamination audit that flags five AsiaM pairs rather than hiding them. Novelty is moderate rather than high: the framework recombines known pieces (CausalGraphBench, verbalized/logit confidence, agreement-based uncertainty, CoT/FS prompting, temperature scaling) and extends prior reliability work rather than introducing a new method; findings are plausible but largely confirmatory of LLM overprediction and overconfidence. Evidence is strong for the descriptive claims but rests on single reference graphs, one judge model for the familiarity audit, and no significance for the headline confidence-method ranking. Generalizability is limited by coverage of only 6 of 35 graphs, open-weight models only, and a language-only pairwise formulation without acyclicity constraints. Reproducibility is supported by full prompt templates, appendix result tables, Hugging Face model availability, and a stated GitHub release of replication materials. Solid, honest empirical contribution of moderate impact.

primary_link.title: From Causal Plausibility to Causal Reliability: Evaluating LLMs as Calibrated Direct Causal-Edge Classifiers

radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型常被用作因果發現的先驗知識來源，但其邊判斷與信心是否可靠仍不明。本文將 LLM 視為經校正的直接因果邊分類器，系統評估 12 個開源指令微調模型、6 個基準因果圖、5 種提示策略，以及口述信心、logit 信心、跨提示一致性與跨模型一致性四種信心來源。三大發現：第一，判斷呈召回主導，模型傾向預測過密的圖，提示主要改變精確率—召回率權衡，模型規模放大在最難圖上幫助有限；第二，模型往往抓得住因果相關性卻無法正確辨識直接性與方向——相對於參考圖，40.0% 的間接與 36.0% 的反向非邊被誤判為直接邊（其他非邊為 28.2%），且其中逾八成偽陽性獲得至少 80% 的口述信心；第三，傳統信心估計不可靠，logit 信心常在 1.0 附近崩塌，一致性類指標在校正與判別上較佳，但經 Holm 校正後統計優勢不顯著。基準熟悉度稽核另標記五組涉及 AsiaM 的模型—資料集組合；評估亦僅涵蓋 CausalGraphBench 35 張圖中的 6 張。整體結論：LLM 判斷宜視為需外部驗證的軟性因果先驗，而非結構的直接證據，對因果發現管線設計有直接警示意義。

primary_link.title: From Preferences to Principles: Rubric-Based Alignment for Grounded Knowledge Answers

radar.summary: Designing effective reward signals for open-domain question answering is challenging because high-quality responses must simultaneously satisfy multiple aspects of answer quality that are difficult to capture with a holistic scalar objective. We introduce a rubric-based reward framework that generates query-specific rubrics grounded in retrieved evidence and decomposed into multiple quality dimensions, providing fine-grained supervision during post-training. Averaged across three evaluation axes
radar.summary_zh: 在開放式檢索增強問答中，答案品質是多維度的，單一標量獎勵難以捕捉，偏好訊號也易引發獎勵駭取與冗長膨脹。本文提出以評量規準為基礎的獎勵框架：離線階段依查詢、檢索證據與參考答案，用強大模型生成查詢特定、有證據依據且分解為 accuracy、composition、safety、general 四個維度的規準，每項附權重；訓練階段以 GPT-4o 作為裁判對 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 的候選回答逐項評分，聚合為標量獎勵並以 GRPO 進行強化學習。在三個評測集（Search Arena、RAGBench、FACTS Grounding）上，結合檢索條件化與多維分解的方法平均較指令微調基準提升 6.5%，較扁平規準變體提升 4%。消融顯示：以檢索證據條件化規準主要改善 Grounding 事實支持，而分解為多維度則進一步提升 Composition 與指令遵循；Optional 規準提供細粒度獎勵亦有助益。在 OpenGenAlign 偏好對齊驗證中，檢索條件化將與偏好標籤的一致率自 43.4% 提升至 54.0%，並降低分歧錯誤。限制包括結果來自單次訓練與評測、僅限英文、依賴 LLM 裁判與參考答案品質，且固定檢索設定未涵蓋端到端檢索誤差。此工作示範結構化、原則化獎勵設計對複雜開放式任務對齊的價值。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM post-training methodology research squarely within preferred topics (LLMs, RL post-training/RLHF alignment, reasoning, prompting distributions), not an out-of-scope domain application. The controlled experimental design (SFT+/SFT- prior manipulation, sparse vs dense rewards, narrow vs broad prompt distributions across Qwen and OLMo families) is careful and the claims are honestly scoped, but the paper self-identifies as a primer whose conclusions may be 'obvious' to RL experts; findings largely confirm the coverage principle and classical reward-shaping wisdom while reconciling spurious-reward reports. Main rigor limits: math reasoning is tested on a single AIME problem with a hand-crafted, idealized PRM built for that problem, no statistical significance/variance reporting, and the dense-reward result depends on having an accurate dense reward that rarely exists in practice. Evidence is quantitative (10,000-sample probability estimates, tracked entropy, benchmark curves) but derived in deliberately simplified settings, tempering generalizability. Code, website, hardware, and algorithm details are released, supporting good reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Demystifying Reinforcement Learning Post-Training of Language Models

radar.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has emerged as a powerful framework for enhancing the capabilities of large language models (LLMs), enabling impressive reasoning, math, and coding capabilities. Yet for many researchers and practitioners, the principles behind classical RL remain a "black box". In this work, we deconstruct the RL post-training algorithm, investigating each step to clarify what is actually happening beneath the surface. By isolating the mechanics of RL with Verifiable Re
radar.summary_zh: 強化學習後訓練雖成效顯著，其機制對許多研究者仍是黑箱。本文以控制實驗逐一拆解後訓練演算法：在可精確測量的沙盒中，讓模型生成特定目標語句或解 AIME 數學題，並以 SFT+（提高目標行為先驗機率）與 SFT-（壓制至近零）操弄基礎模型分布，再變化獎勵訊號與提示分布。結果證實涵蓋原則：在稀疏二值獎勵下，基礎模型對目標行為的先驗機率決定學習成敗——機率近零的模型幾乎無法透過探索觸及正解。但此限制並非 RL 本質：以 Levenshtein 距離或製程獎勵模型提供稠密而準確的中間回饋後，先驗近零的模型也能學會全新行為，甚至超越人工注入目標的 SFT+ 模型，駁斥「RL 只是重加權 pass@k 能力」的流行說法。關於隨機獎勵的假象增益，本文指出關鍵在提示分布：狹窄分布且模型已具強數學先驗時（如 Qwen）可見提升；廣布分布則使策略熵上升，造成全域性能力崩壞（OLMo 的 GSM8K、MMLU、IFEval 同步下滑）；狹窄分布則僅腐蝕訓練領域。這些結果調和了文獻中看似矛盾的發現，並以策略熵為透鏡比較預訓練、SFT 與 RL 對輸出分布的塑形，是理解 RLVR 的實用入門資源。

Method is a plausible but largely incremental synthesis: reflection-conditioned self-teacher (Reflexion/SCoRe lineage) plus on-policy reverse-KL distillation (Agarwal et al.; Thinking Machines OPD) with a reset-with-memory trick. primary_link.title: SRPO: Self-Reflective Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Reasoning

radar.summary: Self-reflection is a powerful mechanism for credit assignment in human learning, converting sparse outcome feedback into actionable guidance. However, its potential for post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) remains underexplored. We propose Self-Reflective Policy Optimization (SRPO), a framework that internalizes this capability. SRPO enables LLMs to analyze their own completed trajectories, synthesize errors into concise "reflection patches," and use reflection-conditioned teacher scores o
radar.summary_zh: 長程任務中的稀疏終端獎勵使信用分配成為強化學習後訓練的瓶頸：無論軌跡多長，每個回合僅提供 O(1) 位元資訊。本文提出自省式策略最佳化 SRPO，讓 LLM 內化人類「從經驗反思中學習」的機制。流程分兩階段：第一階段對初始 rollout 執行結構化自省，產出簡潔的反思補丁，並以「重置但保留記憶」方式將補丁前置於原提示，構成反思條件化的教師分布；第二階段讓學生模型在原提示下做 on-policy 取樣，透過教師強制評分計算每個 token 的反向 KL，作為稠密訓練訊號，再以 PPO 式裁剪目標更新。此設計將稀疏監督轉為 O(T) 位元的 token 級訊號，且不需外部評論者或更大的教師模型。實驗上，Qwen3-8B 於 AIME'24 達 73.3%，僅用規模化 SFT 所需 FLOPs 的 8%，WebShop 64.7%、ALFWorld 76.8%、SWE-Bench-Lite 31.2%，全面超越 SCoRe、RISE、R3L 與 72B 教師蒸餾，總運算量約為 GRPO 的 3.8 分之一。消融證實簡潔反思、反向 KL 與狀態重置皆不可或缺，錯配反思控制實驗排除僅靠額外 token 的解釋；持續學習下數學能力保留率達 95.2%。限制在於目前限於可驗證結果任務，反思品質亦受模型既有知識約束。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an analysis of Large Reasoning Models' (LRMs) chain-of-thought traces via Bloom's Taxonomy directly serves the LLM and Reasoning & CoT preferences, with secondary fit to evaluation and behavioral interpretability. The framework (LLM-based segmentation + Bloom labeling) is a reasonable but incremental complement to existing taxonomies (Schoenfeld episode theory, DeepSeek-R1 thoughtology, prior Bloom-in-NLP work by the same authors). Rigor is mixed: human validation of labels is solid (Cohen's Kappa ~0.91-0.92), yet segmentation is validated only qualitatively on 50 samples by one author, and no alternative annotator/prompt ablations are reported. The correctness case study shows only modest gains (AUC 0.676 vs 0.613 length-only; F1 essentially flat at 0.667 vs 0.666), weakening the 'paves the way for improved reasoning' claim, and the analysis is correlational. Generalizability is limited to math datasets plus two BBH tasks and 7 models, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is decent: prompts fully provided, Apache 2.0 code/data release, though LLM annotation stochasticity and seeds are unaddressed.

However, understanding the types of thinking employed during reasoning - which offers critical insights into models' reasoning patterns and enables actionable applications - remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introdu
radar.summary_zh: 大型推理模型會產出長篇推理軌跡，但每一步用了何種思維型態仍少被研究。本文以布魯姆分類學為透鏡，提出自動標註框架：生成 CoT 後，以 Llama-3.3-70B 將推理軌跡切分為認知步驟並標註六個層級（記憶、理解、應用、分析、評鑑、創造），與兩位人工標註者的一致性 Cohen's Kappa 超過 0.91。跨 Qwen3、DeepSeek-R1 蒸餾系列與 Phi-4-reasoning 等七個模型，在 GSM8K、GSM-hard、MATH500 及 BBH 的 Formal Fallacies、Hyperbaton 任務上進行大規模分析。主要發現：數學推理呈現自發的記憶—理解—應用—評鑑弧線，應用型思維占主導，創造近乎缺席；蒸餾小模型更偏應用，Qwen3 家族評鑑比重最高，Phi-4-reasoning 記憶占比異常突出且為模型本身特性；內部軌跡比輸出 CoT 認知更廣，後者壓縮為回憶與執行；題目越難，認知越從執行轉向分析；各任務皆有後置驗證傾向。正確性研究顯示 Bloom 特徵具預測力：43 特徵邏輯迴歸 AUC 為 0.676，優於僅長度的 0.613，其中應用→評鑑與記憶→理解的轉移為正向預測子。限制是尚未以這些結構訊號主動改善推理，任務範圍也可再擴充，但此框架為逐步分析模型思維與改良推理提供了可行工具。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A genuine LLM-agent methodology paper, not a pure domain application: VAT determination is used as an oracle-labeled testbed to study the single-agent vs. multi-agent decomposition question, squarely matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, prompting/budget confounds, hallucination robustness). Methodological discipline is unusually strong: pre-registered falsification criteria (§6.6), a matched-token control for the prompt-budget confound (§6.3), case-clustered bootstrap with Holm-Bonferroni correction (§6.5), and candid disclosure of three harness defects (§10.2). However, confirmatory evidence is weak: no headline test survives correction (Table 2), the intermediate-optimum hypothesis is explicitly unsupported, and the matched-token criterion fires, so the central finding is directional only at n=40 with one pinned model (claude-haiku-4-5). Generalizability is deliberately scoped to one synthetic workload and one merge policy; the availability-vs-content injection taxonomy (§8) is the most interesting but purely descriptive contribution. Artifact release claims are detailed and verifiable in principle (§6.7, Appendix D hashes, GitHub/Zenodo).

primary_link.title: Right-Sizing LLM-Agent Decomposition in VAT Determination: A Pilot Controlled Sweep

radar.summary: Recent LLM-agent systems make conflicting design bets: decompose work across many narrow agents, or use one strong tool-using agent. This pilot studies that choice on bounded cross-border VAT determination with reverse charge, where every case has an oracle label and each intermediate decision is independently scoreable. We hold the activity surface fixed (subtasks, tools, I/O schemas, validation checks, orchestrator, base model, and merge policy) and vary only the assignment of subtasks to work
radar.summary_zh: LLM 代理系統在設計上存在衝突抉擇：把工作拆給多個狹窄代理，或交給單一強大的工具使用代理。本文以具反向收取機制的跨境 VAT 判定為測試平台，執行預註冊的代理粒度控制掃描：固定活動面——子任務、工具、I/O 結構、驗證檢查、orchestrator、基礎模型與合併政策——僅改變子任務在四種編排配置 C1–C4（一名寬廣到五名狹窄工作者）的分配，另與調校過的無編排 ReAct 單代理 S0 比較，並以確定性規則引擎作為 oracle；整體 4,400 次執行皆依預登記的否證準則評估。主掃描呈非單調曲線：兩個中間配置以 0.830 準確率領先（端點 0.720 與 0.770），但未達對精細端點的預設門檻，中間最優假說在先導規模下僅屬方向性結果；S0 亦未 Pareto 支配編排組合。錯誤定位顯示寬廣配置最早敗於管轄權判定，最細配置敗於反向收取合成。匹配 token 對照觸發預註冊條件：預算匹配單代理雖落後 6.5 個百分點，但信賴區間含零，優勢被視為與提示預算解釋一致。故障注入顯示逾時與共用工具中斷等可用性故障在各粒度皆被吸收，寬範圍重啟甚至超出自身基線 +0.160；單一符合架構的幻覺紀錄則使所有配置退化，對碎片化配置傷害最大並逆轉排序。貢獻是釋出可檢驗的有界啟發式——在依賴層中點設一個分割邊界——並隨附 oracle、資料集、harness、原始軌跡與分析管線。限制包括單一工作負載、單一模型家族、40 個合成案例與先導規模的統計力。

links.title: The Retriever Should Remember: Experience-Amortized Reranking for Long-Term Agent Memory

evidence: Abstract: mixed observed-and-estimated reranking improves answer accuracy over semantic retrieval by up to 6.62% and remains effective when only 17.5% of candidates receive direct LLM relevance scores
Section VI-A, Table I: rank-8 EARM Top-10 overall 88.83% vs Semantic 82.21% and Full LLM reranking 91.62%; EARM uses 78,736 reranker calls vs 307,982 for full reranking (74.43% reduction)
Section VI-C, Table III: Observed-only improves over Semantic by 1.36–3.83%; re-enabling completed scores (Mixed) adds a further 0.78–2.79% in every configuration
Section V-A: evaluation only on LoCoMo with the Mem0 extraction pipeline, Qwen3.5-4B-Q8_0 as relevance scorer, and GPT-4o-mini for both answer generation and LLM-based answer evaluation
Section IV-E and Section VII-C: expanded ranking domain D_t = C_t ∪ E_t is proposed, but 'The experiments use D_t = C_t', so candidate expansion beyond the semantic pool is not empirically evaluated

Section VIII Limitations: budget schedule is predetermined and non-adaptive, matrix completion assumes reusable low-dimensional structure, and noisy/miscalibrated pointwise scores mean 'completion can propagate reranker errors'

Section V-B: hyperparameters specified (N=200, stage budgets 200/80/50/40/35, λ=0.1, r∈{2,8}, ALS ≤5,000 iterations, tolerance 1e-6), but the semantic retriever's embedding model is never named; code claimed at github.com/FengQi-HITSZ/earm
Section V-A: memory store is constructed before processing questions and kept fixed (M_t = M), so the growing-store setting described in Section III is not tested
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-topic for high-weight preferences: LLM agent memory (Agents 2.5), LLM reranking (LLMs 2.5), retrieval/relevance (RAG 1.8), long-term memory (Long Context 1.8). The core idea—treating pointwise LLM relevance scores as persistent 'retrieval experience' and amortizing reranking via causal biased low-rank matrix completion—is a genuinely fresh framing, though the underlying technique is standard matrix factorization and adjacent to EcoRank-style budgeted reranking and MemRL-style memory utilities. Evaluation is coherent: clear RQs, endpoint baselines (Semantic, Full reranking), an Observed-only ablation isolating the completion contribution, stage-wise budget decay, and internally consistent numbers (82.21→88.83 = +6.62; 78,736 vs 307,982 calls = 74.43% reduction). However, all evidence comes from one benchmark (LoCoMo) with one fixed memory store, one scorer (Qwen3.5-4B), and GPT-4o-mini as both generator and judge, with no significance testing, only two latent ranks, no embedding model named, and small per-stage blocks; the claimed candidate-expansion capability (D_t=C_t∪E_t) is described but never empirically tested. Limitations are honestly stated. Code link and detailed hyperparameters support reproduction, but missing prompts/embedder and LLM-judge noise temper it.

primary_link.title: The Retriever Should Remember: Experience-Amortized Reranking for Long-Term Agent Memory

radar.summary: Long-term language-model agents accumulate memories across interactions, but their retrievers typically do not accumulate retrieval experience. Semantic retrieval is efficient, but embedding similarity does not always reflect whether a memory contains evidence relevant to the current query. Large language model (LLM) rerankers provide stronger query-conditioned relevance scores, yet stateless reranking repeatedly scores a large candidate pool and discards these scores after each query. We introd
radar.summary_zh: 長期 LLM 代理會累積互動記憶，但其檢索器通常不會累積檢索經驗：無狀態的 LLM 重排序器每次查詢都重新為大量候選記憶評分，隨後丟棄分數。本文提出 EARM（Experience-Amortized Reranking for Memory），把先前取得的 LLM 相關性分數視為可重用的檢索經驗。系統將稀疏的查詢—記憶分數存入線上矩陣，透過因果矩陣補全（帶偏項的低秩模型，以交替最小平方法暖啟動求解）學習共享結構，再以少量新觀測分數搭配估計分數重排其餘候選；隨經驗累積，分階段排程把直接評分比例由 100% 降至 17.5%，並以分層抽樣選取錨點（一半取自高相似區、一半探索其餘）。在 LoCoMo 長期對話記憶資料集上，採 Mem0 記憶管線、Qwen3.5-4B 評分、GPT-4o-mini 生成與評估答案：Top-10 設定下 rank-8 的 EARM 將整體準確率由 82.21% 提升至 88.83%（+6.62%），與完整 LLM 重排序的差距縮至 2.79%，多跳問題增益最大（+10.29%），LLM 評分呼叫次數減少 74.43%；在最終階段僅 17.5% 候選獲直接評分時，Top-10 仍較語意檢索高 5.53%。消融實驗顯示由補全分數選出的記憶額外貢獻 0.78–2.79%。限制包括預算排程預先固定、假設可重用的低秩結構，以及 LLM 分數的雜訊可能經補全被放大。其意義在於把重排序分數從拋棄式推論痕跡轉為持久的檢索記憶，讓長期代理不僅記得內容，也學會更有效地檢索自身的記憶。

links.title: How Useful are LLMs for Grammar Engineering? Cantonese ParGram Resources and Controlled Experimental Evaluation with English Baselines

evidence: Section 4.1 (p.5): 'We set the temperature to 0 and kept top_p as 1.0 to minimize stochastic variation and encourage reproducible generation.'

Table 1 (p.6): 2x2 designs yielding 240 generated XLE grammars and 4,654 rules total (Exp.1: 100 grammars/1602 rules sentence-to-grammar, 100/1652 f-structure-to-grammar; Exp.2: 20/699 and 20/701), plus English GPT-5.4 baselines.
Section 4.2 (p.7): GPT-5.4 f-structure-to-grammar achieved QR 2.88 / AR 90% vs gpt-oss-120b QR 2.02 / AR 75%; Table 5 (p.8) reports Wilcoxon Z=5.31 (QR) and Z=5.95 (AR), adjusted p<.001, r=.88/.84.

Table 6 (p.8): error analysis for gpt-oss-120b sentence-to-grammar with N=151 identified error instances; most frequent error missing/incorrect subcategorization frames (42% of grammars, 14% of errors).

Section 4.1 (p.6) and footnote 5: AR is a generated-rule accuracy measure, not precision/recall against a fixed gold inventory, because one-to-one rule alignment is not well defined; QR is a four-point expert scale (Appendix G, p.18) adopted from Lam and Ui Dhonnchadha (2026), with no inter-annotator agreement reported.

Limitations (p.9): only two OpenAI models, only the first 50 ParGram sentences, limited statistical power in Experiment 2, one-shot prompting only (no fine-tuning), and evaluation focused on formal well-formedness rather than computational efficiency or downstream NLP performance.

Appendices C-F (pp.14-17) provide full system/user prompts and the English toy grammar; Appendix A (pp.12-13) lists all 50 English and Cantonese sentences; p.18 states English treebank f-structures are openly accessible via clarino.uib.no INESS, though no explicit release of the Cantonese grammar, treebank, or LLM outputs is stated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled LLM-methodology evaluation (LLM capability assessment, one-shot in-context prompting, NLP resource construction) squarely within preferred topics, not a pure domain application. Strengths: genuinely novel resources (new Cantonese ParGram treebank) plus the first systematic 2x2 controlled evaluation of LLM generation of XLE/LFG grammars, temperature-0 setup, dual metrics separating rule-level formal accuracy from parse-level quality, Holm-corrected Wilcoxon tests with effect sizes, and a detailed error taxonomy. Weaknesses: single expert rater with no inter-annotator agreement for the subjective 4-point QR scale, small samples (Experiment 2 has only 20 grammars per condition with several non-significant prompt-source tests), only two models from a single vendor, and non-standard AR metric without gold-inventory precision/recall. Prompts and English treebanks are published, but no explicit release of the Cantonese grammar or LLM outputs, and the proprietary frontier model limits replication. Findings support model and prompt-source effects but generalization beyond one vendor, two languages, and 50 sentences is limited, as the authors themselves note.

primary_link.title: How Useful are LLMs for Grammar Engineering? Cantonese ParGram Resources and Controlled Experimental Evaluation with English Baselines

radar.summary: This paper presents new Cantonese ParGram resources and evaluates LLMs for knowledge-driven grammar engineering within a controlled experimental paradigm. Using Cantonese ParGram resources as gold standards, with corresponding English baselines, we investigate whether OpenAI's gpt-oss-120b and GPT-5.4 can generate machine-processable grammars from sentences and target formal structures under systematically varied prompting conditions. GPT-5.4 outperformed gpt-oss-120b, while grammars generated f
radar.summary_zh: 本文探討大型語言模型能否協助知識驅動的文法工程，並發表新的粵語 ParGram 資源。作者以詞彙功能文法（LFG）與 XLE 環境手工撰寫粵語文法，解析 ParGramBank 前 50 句產生樹庫作為黃金標準，並納入對應的英文 ParGram 基準。實驗系統性操弄文法資訊來源（僅給句子或給目標 f-structure）與涵蓋範圍（單一結構或多重結構），評估 OpenAI 的 gpt-oss-120b 與 GPT-5.4 產生片語結構規則、功能標註、模板與詞彙條目的能力。結果顯示 GPT-5.4 全面優於 gpt-oss-120b；提示含目標 f-structure 通常優於僅給句子，例如實驗一中 GPT-5.4 於 f-structure 條件達 QR 2.88、規則準確率 90%；多重結構設定分數普遍下滑，gpt-oss-120b 約九成輸出被評為 Bad。錯誤分析指出最常見問題為次分類框架缺失或錯誤、資訊寫入錯誤區塊、功能標註遺漏與語法功能錯誤等，顯示難點不在 XLE 記法本身，而在協調規則、詞彙、模板與功能限制之間的互動。作者主張 LLM 適合支援中間分析與候選元件產生，並建議由模型先產生初步 f-structure、經專家校正後再據以產生文法的協作流程，人類語言學專業仍應居於核心。限制包括僅測兩個模型、語料有限、實驗二樣本小，且只採單次提示學習而未探討 fine-tuning。此研究對 AI 輔助文法工程與低資源語言的符號資源建設深具價值。

links.title: The Disconnect Between Better Descriptive Reasoning Trace Quality and Recommendation Effectiveness

evidence: Section 3.5 formalizes the alignment-tax hypothesis (Delta_Title > Delta_SID); Section 5.1.1 reports Table 2 does not support it, with Title reasoning deltas significantly negative on Video Games and Office (p<0.05, paired bootstrap, 1,000 iterations) while no SID degradation reaches significance.

Section 5.1.2 (Table 3) and Section 5.2.1 (Table 4): the eight-task SID-A alignment raises trace quality to the highest aggregate (3.51 vs. 3.33 Title) but reasoning SFT loses 17-23% R@10 relative to its own baseline, isolating that grounding improvements do not improve ranking effectiveness.

Section 5.1.3 (Table 3): composite LLM-judge reward R=0.5*R_acc+0.25*R_trace+0.25*R_rel pushes SID beyond the no-reasoning baseline on Office (.1646 vs. .1595) and Industrial (.1401 vs. .1361) while trace quality is essentially unchanged (Table 4: 2.23 vs. 2.22).

Appendix C (Table 6): GRPO+Emb with cosine E5 reward nearly matches GRPO+Judge (Office SID .1640 vs. .1646) with item-token-only gradients, supporting the claim that reward density, not judge semantics, drives recovery.

Appendix F (Tables 7-9): prefix-faithful generation rates are unchanged or higher with reasoning (Office .980 vs. .980 at rank 1), drifted generations are rare and symmetric, and oracle resolution bounds leave the reasoning gap intact, ruling out the BM25 decoding confound.

Section 6 'Limitations': single backbone (Qwen3-1.7B), GPT answer-conditioned teacher traces as a candidate root cause, entirely offline evaluation; Section 5.3 playlist-continuation results (Table 5) use a proprietary O(10^8)-track catalog not available for replication.
Section 6 'A note on terminology' connects the decoupling of trace quality and task utility to Kambhampati et al.'s prompt-augmentation framing, indicating broader relevance beyond recommendation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-centric controlled study (Qwen3-1.7B backbone) of whether chain-of-thought trace quality translates into task effectiveness, instantiated in generative recommendation. It strongly engages high-weight preferences: CoT reasoning (2.5), RLHF-style reward design with GRPO and LLM-judge rewards (2.0), LLM-as-judge evaluation (1.8), and RL fine-tuning (1.5); the recommendation domain itself is not a listed preference but is not on the out-of-scope list, and the language methodology is central rather than incidental. Novelty is solid: the 2x2 factorial isolation of item representation (SID vs. title) and reasoning, plus the 'alignment tax' framing, is a genuinely new controlled comparison, and the negative result is consequential. Rigor is high: significance testing, SID-collision-aware item-level evaluation, an unusually thorough confound analysis (Appendix F rules out BM25 resolution artifacts via prefix-faithful rates and oracle bounds), reward-sparsity diagnostics, and an embedding-reward ablation isolating reward density. Evidence for the central disconnect claim converges across six configurations, the alignment-tax arm, the judge-reward arm, and a production-scale playlist experiment. Generalizability is deliberately and appropriately hedged: single small backbone, single-holdout offline protocol, answer-conditioned teacher traces, and a non-reproducible proprietary Spotify experiment. Reproducibility is moderate: public datasets/traces and full prompts/hyperparameters, but no stated code release and commercial judge APIs.

radar.summary_zh: 本文由 Spotify 團隊撰寫，探討生成式推薦中「描述性推理軌跡品質」的提升能否轉化為推薦效能。生成式推薦常以語意 ID（SID）表示商品，此類不透明識別碼需付出「對齊稅」——額外的訓練階段、輔助目標與模型容量——LLM 才能據以推理，自然語言標題則可望免除。作者以共享的 Qwen3-1.7B 為骨幹，在三個 Amazon 商品資料集上進行 2×2 因子實驗，獨立操弄商品表示（SID 與標題）與顯式推理，並依 SIDReasoner 的三階段流程訓練。結果顯示：在標準 SFT 與 GRPO 下，加入推理反而降低傳統離線推薦效能，標題條件在 Video Games 與 Office 顯著下降約兩成，與對齊稅假說相反；完整支付對齊稅的 SID-A 軌跡品質最高，離線效能卻最差。LLM 評審（Gemini 2.5 Pro）的六維評分證實標題軌跡更扎實、可解讀，但品質提升未轉為效能。分析發現獎勵稀疏是主因：七至九成提示的取樣全數零獎勵，模型甚至收斂到空的推理區塊；改用結合準確率與 LLM 評審的複合獎勵可部分挽回效能，純嵌入相似度獎勵效果相近，顯示獎勵密度而非軌跡語意才是關鍵。生產級播放清單實驗亦顯示推理雖引入互補候選，整體效能未穩定提升。作者據此主張軌跡品質、相關性評分與離線效能量測的是不同性質，並提醒中間詞元或僅是提示增強。限制包括單一模型規模、教師蒸餾軌跡與純離線評估。

evidence: Abstract: claims over 90% accuracy on offline trajectory verification and that the framework 'performs closest to rule-based methods'.
Table 2 (Section 4.2): GSAR average Acc 91.5 / F1 91.8 across Qwen3-VL-8B/32B, GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Pro vs StepCritic 77.6/81.8 and DistRL 75.0/74.5.
Table 3 (Section 4.3): ablations — w/o reference drops Acc to 64.4 (Qwen3-VL-8B), w/o history to 87.6, w/o anchor to 87.3, supporting each component.
Section 4.1: self-built benchmark contains only 86 queries, half used as the training split, and results are 'verified through both manual assessment and GSAR' (partial circularity).
Section 5.3: on AndroidWorld, UI-TARS-7B-DPO baseline 26.7%, GSAR 30.2% (+3.5%), rule-based rewards 32.8% (+6.1%) — rule-based still clearly better.
Section 5.3 / Table 5: GSAR rollout time 2342.02s vs rule-based 2754.92s per training step, an efficiency advantage.
Limitations section: single final state as success criterion, premature rewards on QA tasks, and goal states not expressible visually; manual execution still needed for tasks GPT-4o cannot complete.
Appendix C: hyperparameters for SFT (LoRA r=8, lr 1e-5) and RL (GRPO, lr 1e-6, KL 0.001) on 2x8 H100s with 128 emulators; Appendix G provides prompts; no code or data release is mentioned anywhere.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic agentic AI: VLM-based mobile GUI agents trained with online RL (GRPO), reward design, and automated data synthesis, matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, RL, reward engineering, multimodal LLMs). The goal-state-anchor reward idea is a genuine, if incremental, contribution over prior model-based judges, but the data synthesis pipeline explicitly reuses OS-Genesis's filtering and the infrastructure (GPT-4o task generation/execution) is borrowed. Rigor is moderate-to-good: ablations (Table 3), four judge models, two RL backbones, task-category breakdowns, and an honest comparison showing rule-based rewards still outperform GSAR (+6.1% vs +3.5% on AndroidWorld, Section 5.3). Evidence is weakened by a small self-built benchmark (86 queries, half used for training per Section 4.1), evaluation on the 'full task set' mixing train/test, and verification partly via GSAR itself (circularity, Section 4.1), with no significance testing. No code/data release is stated despite detailed hyperparameters (Appendix C) and prompts (Appendix G); closed-source GPT-4o dependence further limits reproducibility. Generalizability is confined to Android GUIs, with limitations acknowledged (single goal state, QA premature rewards, visually inexpressible completions).

However, their training is bottlenecked by two fundamental issues: current data synthesis methods for GUI Agents rely on specific environments and struggle to generate diverse data, while existing evaluators either suffer from limited scalability or provide inaccurate and unreliable reward signals. To overcome these challenges, we introduce GSAR (Goal-State-Anchor Reward), a RL
radar.summary_zh: 以 Vision-Language Models(VLMs)為基礎的 GUI 代理在線上強化學習(RL)訓練時面臨兩大瓶頸:現有資料合成方法依賴特定環境、難以產生多樣化任務;模型式評分器常給出不準確的獎勵訊號,規則式方法則難以隨任務自動擴充。本文提出 GSAR 框架,包含兩個核心機制:其一為自我演化資料合成,讓任務分布、環境狀態與軌跡透過持續互動共同演化,並以繼承、合併、改寫三種策略進行任務複雜化,自動產生任務、初始環境與軌跡三元組;其二為狀態錨點機制,從成功軌跡的最終截圖自動標註與任務相關的 UI 元素作為參考錨點,結合動作歷史提供準確且可擴充的獎勵。實驗顯示 GSAR 在離線軌跡驗證達到超過 90% 的準確率與 F1,最接近規則式方法;以 GSAR 訓練的 UI-TARS-7B-DPO 在自建基準的訓練分割提升 23.2%,完整任務集提升 8.1%;每步平均 rollout 時間亦低於規則式驗證。消融實驗證實目標狀態參考、錨點標註與動作歷史皆不可或缺。限制包括:每個任務僅考慮單一最終狀態作為成功標準、問答任務可能提前給予獎勵、無法以視覺完整表達的任務難以標註,且軌跡品質受限於 GPT-4o 等模型能力。此研究為 GUI 代理的大規模 RLVR 訓練提供可擴充且可靠的資料與獎勵基礎。
