links.title: TRACE: A Self-Evolving Skill Bank for Consistent, Limit-Aware LLM Agents

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: this is core LLM-agent methodology (agents/tool use, LLM backbones, agent reliability/limit-awareness, benchmark evaluation, safety-relevant refusal behavior), squarely within high-weight preferences. Novelty is moderate: trajectory-derived skill/experience libraries with retrieval at deployment are well-established (Reflexion, skill/memory-evolution work the authors cite); the distinguishable contributions are contrastive success/failure skill refinement, deployment-faithful trajectory reconstruction, a de-hardcoding validation step, and per-turn re-orchestration focused on consistency (Pass^k) rather than one-shot success. Rigor is mixed: the controlled baseline-vs-TRACE comparison and cross-backbone transfer are good design, and cost/latency trade-offs are honestly reported, but Table 1 is computed on a combined train+test split that overlaps the data used to evolve the Skill Bank (a contamination confound only partially mitigated by the 30-task hidden set), there are no component ablations (hierarchical abstraction, de-hardcoding, deployment-faithful reconstruction are not isolated), and no variance or significance testing over the 3 trials. Evidence strength is solid on effect magnitude (Pass^3 +22.0/+34.6 on the full set, +20 points on the official hidden set, numbers internally consistent) and includes a first-place hidden-set result, but small hidden-set sample (90 trials) and absent ablations/statistics cap confidence. Generalizability is claimed (model-agnostic, cross-backbone transfer shown) but demonstrated on a single benchmark/domain with a hidden set from the same benchmark. Reproducibility is limited: algorithms are given and a project page exists, but Curator prompts, skill bank contents, and code/data release are not provided, and experiments rely on proprietary frontier models.

primary_link.title: TRACE: A Self-Evolving Skill Bank for Consistent, Limit-Aware LLM Agents

radar.summary: Reliable deployment of LLM agents in user-facing products depends not on raw task-solving ability but on consistency and limit-awareness: behaving the same way across repeated trials, and recognizing when a request cannot, or cannot yet, be safely fulfilled. CAR-bench exposes this reliability gap in the domain of in-car assistants: an LLM-simulated user issues incomplete or ambiguous requests, requiring the agent to resolve uncertainty through multi-turn dialogue and tool use while strictly adhe
radar.summary_zh: 將 LLM 代理部署於車用助手等使用者導向產品時,關鍵不在原始解題能力,而在一致性與能力界限感知:重複執行相同任務時行為是否穩定,以及能否辨識請求無法安全達成,而非虛報成功。CAR-bench 揭露此可靠度落差:即使前沿模型,至少成功一次的 Pass@k 與全部成功的 Pass^k 之間差距顯著。本文提出 TRACE,在不修改模型權重的前提下,以自我演化技能庫改善代理的行為知識。技能庫由模組化、可檢索的 markdown 技能檔案組成;Curator 代理先以任務層、類型層、操作層三階段階層式抽象初始化技能庫,再於每輪評估後將軌跡依所呼叫的技能分組,以部署忠實方式重建後對比成功與失敗行為來改寫技能,並以去硬編碼約束保留可遷移的工具使用與決策原則。部署時 Actor 每輪執行狀態條件化的技能編排,動態決定啟用哪些技能及其順序。實驗顯示在 GPT-5.5 上 Pass^3 由 59.9% 升至 94.5%(+34.6 分),落差縮小至 4.0 分;在官方隱藏測試集以 GPT-5.6-Sol 奪得第一,Pass^3 達 70%,相對基準提升 40%;僅以 GPT-5.5 軌跡演化的技能庫也能遷移至 GLM-5.2。代價是延遲增加 22%、每試驗 token 增加 72.4%。限制包括編排器隨技能庫擴大而難以擴充,以及部署時缺乏從執行結果回饋至技能的通道。此工作展示將模型潛力轉化為穩定可靠行為的可行路徑。
radar.title: TRACE: A Self-Evolving Skill Bank for Consistent, Limit-Aware LLM Agents
radar.title_zh: TRACE:為一致性與能力界限感知 LLM 代理設計的自我演化技能庫

links.title: LITERARYBIGFIVE: Author-Personalized Text Generation in a Unified Interpretable Space

evidence: Section 5.2, Table 1: LiteraryBigFive achieves the best ROUGE-1/L, SIM, GPT-4, and human scores across all four held-out books, reported with two-tailed paired t-test p<0.01.
Section 4.1 and Appendix D: axis decomposition via SVD removes a shared principal direction, reducing mean absolute off-diagonal cross-axis cosine similarity from 0.87 to 0.27 (Figure 6).
Section 6.1, Table 2: ablations show removing style-gap steering (-w/o Style Gap, ROUGE-1 49.3) hurts more than removing decomposition (-w/o Decomposition, ROUGE-1 52.1) vs full method (53.0).

Section 6.2 and Appendix G, Table 6: coordinate interpretability is validated by Pearson r=0.96 against an ensemble of GPT-5, Claude-Sonnet-3.5, and Gemini 3 ratings on only 4 books x 5 dimensions, not against human literary experts, despite abstract claims of 'real-world literary consensus'.

Section 5.1/Appendix L: implementation details are specified (layers {20,24,28}, lambda=1, 10 reference passages, temperature 0) and baselines are adapted to train on anchor books, supporting the cross-author generalization design.
Appendix B, Table 4: gains replicate on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct across all four books, supporting backbone generality.
Limitations section: authors acknowledge English-classics-only scope and the requirement for white-box activation access, precluding closed-source API models.
Appendix H, Table 8: measured latency 19.88 ms/token vs 18.93 ms/token for Mean-Centering, quantifying the overhead of dynamic style-gap steering.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper (activation steering for author-personalized generation with an interpretability framing) that strongly matches LLM, Interpretability, and NLP preference clusters, though it misses the highest-weight agent/reasoning/Japanese clusters. The unified five-axis style space with SVD-based removal of a shared 'expressiveness' direction is a genuine but incremental advance over existing steering methods (CAA, RepE, ICV, Mean-Centering), all of which appear as baselines. Experimental protocol is solid: three baseline families, two backbones (Llama2-7B-Chat, Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct), ablations on both components, paired t-tests, human evaluation with kappa=0.59, and latency analysis. Main weaknesses: the central interpretability claim ('aligns with literary consensus') is validated only by correlation (r=0.96) with other LLM judges on just 4 books x 5 axes (Section 6.2, Appendix G) — small-n, potentially circular, and not human literary scholarship; axis construction relies on GPT-4 neutralization, risking entanglement of model-identity artifacts with style; ROUGE against the source-derived original is a partly circular reconstruction metric. English-only, white-box models required (Limitations).

primary_link.title: LITERARYBIGFIVE: Author-Personalized Text Generation in a Unified Interpretable Space

radar.summary: Personalized text generation for authors and literary writing is essential for applications such as adaptive writing assistants, creative support tools, and computational literary analysis. However, existing approaches to author modeling and personalization often represent writing behavior as independent labels, requiring large-scale corpus collection or fine-tuning for each author or stylistic category. Such formulations are costly, difficult to interpret, and poorly suited for generalizing acr
radar.summary_zh: 針對作者個人化文字生成,既有方法多將個別作者視為孤立標籤,需為每位作者蒐集大量文本或重新訓練模型,成本高昂且缺乏可解釋性。受心理學 Big Five 模型的維度觀點啟發,本文提出 LiteraryBigFive,將作者寫作特徵重新表述為統一且可解釋的五維空間座標:古典性、華麗性、敘事性、情感性與分析性。方法上,先為每個維度選取代表性經典作品,以 GPT-4 將作者原文改寫為保留語意的中性版本,利用兩者隱藏狀態的對比向量萃取各軸方向;再透過軸分解步驟移除共享的整體表現力方向,降低軸間相關性,得到精煉的軸系統。接著採用 localize-and-steer 機制:先將參考文本投影至五軸取得作者座標,生成時依當前 token 與目標座標的風格差距,自淺至深層動態調整隱藏狀態。實驗以 Llama2-7B-Chat 為基礎,在 Burke、Orwell、Stevenson、Austen 四本書上,LiteraryBigFive 在 ROUGE、語意相似度、GPT-4 與人類評估皆優於 Few-shot、LoRA、ICV、CAA、RepE 等基線;作者座標與 GPT-5、Claude、Gemini 共識的平均 Pearson 相關達 0.96,且每 token 延遲僅增加約 1 毫秒。限制包括軸主要源自英語經典、調變於全域殘差層運作、且需白箱存取內部激活向量,無法用於封閉式 API。此框架為可解釋的風格分析與低成本的跨作者個人化生成提供新範式。
radar.title: LITERARYBIGFIVE: Author-Personalized Text Generation in a Unified Interpretable Space
radar.title_zh: LiteraryBigFive:統一可解釋空間中的作者個人化文字生成

links.title: Beyond the Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Context Artifacts for Enterprise Text-to-SQL

evidence: Section 2.4, Table 1: adding retrieved KB context to the full oracle graph gives the largest jump (Sonnet AST 0.341 to 0.582; Qwen 0.291 to 0.558), motivating context-artifact optimization
Section 4.1, Table 2: with baseline harness, optimized cards improve AST 0.490 to 0.550 (Sonnet) and 0.407 to 0.509 (Qwen), exceeding harness-only gains 0.490 to 0.503 and 0.407 to 0.456

Section 4.1, Appendix C Table 4: bootstrap 95% CIs computed for every cell (2000 resamples); Sonnet AST intervals [0.461,0.520] vs [0.521,0.579] barely separate, EX cohort n=102 has all intervals overlapping

Section 4.2, Table 3: BEAVER held-out N=300, cards+raw scores 9.00% vs 6.33% baseline with p=0.12, explicitly labeled 'directional rather than statistically significant'; cards-only 6.67% ties raw-query 6.33%

Limitations (Section 4.2): internal scoring is structural proxies plus LLM judge; execution accuracy limited to n=102 cohort; compositional nested-CTE queries stay at ~1.5% across all conditions (Table 5)

Appendix B: 'We use Qwen Coder 3-30B to annotate each DAG node with a natural-language sub-problem description and each full profile with a natural-language intent' while Qwen Coder 3-30B is also an evaluated model in Table 2 - potential self-annotation bias not discussed
Appendix A: positions contribution against TailorSQL, Baek et al. 2025, AgentSM, DeepRefine, DSPy/MIPRO/TextGrad/AlphaEvolve, distinguishing optimization of the distillation function itself

Section 3.3 and Algorithm 1: search space restricted per surface ({f,P_sum} vs {H,P}), 100-query inner-loop sample, 8192-token artifact cap; Appendix D lists accepted harness mutations; no code or data release is stated, and the internal benchmark is proprietary
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methods paper: optimizes RAG knowledge-base context artifacts (SQL reference cards distilled from production traces) for enterprise Text-to-SQL with an AlphaEvolve-style search, and attributes gains across context vs. harness surfaces using Claude Sonnet and Qwen Coder models. Strong preference fit (LLMs, RAG, agents/harness, code/SQL, LLM-judge evaluation). Novelty is incremental but genuine: unlike TailorSQL/Baek et al. (fixed mining pipelines) or DSPy/TextGrad/Meta-Harness (harness/prompt surfaces), the distillation function itself is optimized against downstream quality, with an oracle-graph ablation locating the bottleneck. Rigor is above average: 2x2 factorial across two models, bootstrap CIs for every cell (Appendix C), leakage controls, and unusually honest reporting of non-significant external results. Evidence is weakened because the primary internal metrics are structural proxies (AST/string similarity) that could be inflated by retrieving stylistically similar historical SQL, the executable cohort is n=102 and non-significant, and the execution-graded BEAVER check is underpowered (p=0.12). An undisclosed circularity: Qwen Coder 3-30B both generated the NL intents (Appendix B) and is an evaluated model. Gains depend on usage-signal-rich production regimes; on BEAVER, cards-only ties raw SQL (6.67% vs 6.33%). Internal benchmark is proprietary with no code release, limiting reproducibility, though the BEAVER protocol (seed, N=300 stratified subset) and Algorithm 1 are specified.

primary_link.title: Beyond the Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Context Artifacts for Enterprise Text-to-SQL

radar.summary: Deploying LLMs for enterprise Text-to-SQL is bottlenecked less by the model than by what context reaches it: business logic spans thousands of tables, and no model can ingest a full catalog at once. We argue that the most effective place to intervene is therefore the \emph{knowledge-base context} the model consumes, and that this context should be \emph{constructed} from historical usage rather than tuned for as a fixed input. Using a query-DAG decomposition--the same family of intermediates tha
radar.summary_zh: 企業級 Text-to-SQL 的瓶頸往往不在模型本身,而在送進模型的脈絡:商業邏輯橫跨數千張資料表,沒有模型能一次讀入完整目錄。本文主張最有效的介入點是模型消費的知識庫脈絡,且該脈絡應從歷史使用紀錄「建構」而來,而非視為固定輸入。作者將生產環境 SQL 解析為子問題的 DAG(節點為 CTE 或子查詢,邊為資料流),提供可驗證的中間產物,並以 I1 至 I4 的圖保真度層級進行消融,診斷「查詢圖保真度」與「檢索內容」何者更重要。結果顯示在完整 oracle 圖之上加入檢索知識庫脈絡帶來最大邊際改善。據此,本文以 AlphaEvolve 式的外層搜尋,端對端最佳化將歷史查詢概況蒸餾為可重用 SQL 參考卡的選擇器與摘要提示,並搭配失敗診斷器將錯誤歸因至不同可最佳化表面。在 5176 筆生產查詢的內部基準上,最佳化脈絡素材帶來約 12-25% 的 AST 相似度提升,高於最佳化檢索 harness 的約 3-12%。在公開 BEAVER 基準上效果較不顯著:最佳變體(同時檢索卡片與原始 SQL)得分 9.00%,對照 6.33%,p 值 0.12,僅屬方向性差異。限制包括內部基準主要依結構代理指標評分、N=300 的 BEAVER 子集統計檢定力不足、深層組合式查詢準確率仍近於零,且僅研究單次呼叫的檢索式 harness。此研究指出企業場景中,把歷史使用訊號當作可最佳化的輸入,比調校腳手架更值得投入。

links.title: MARS: Multi-Specialist LLM Relay System for Competitive Programming

evidence: Abstract: MARS reaches 0.624±0.006 pass rate at 2.3 recorded pipeline stages per task (+14.4 points over direct prompting), closing most of the gap to CodeSIM (0.731) at 3.3× lower wall-clock cost
Table 1: CodeSIM* rerun reaches 0.73±0.01, exceeding MARS 0.62±0.01 on Gemma 4; MARS trails despite simpler protocol
Table 3: Generalists-no-RAG ablation reaches 0.615±0.013, only 0.009 below MARS and within one standard deviation, weakening the specialization claim; w/o RAG grounding costs only 2.0 points
Section 3: evaluation on 165 tasks from CodeContests test split; logged Direct and Single-RAG runs use top-p 1.0 while MARS, ensemble, Base relay, and CodeSIM use top-p 0.95 (protocol confound)

Section 4.2: MARS ordering holds across Qwen3.5-27B (0.297 vs 0.264 Single-RAG) and GPT-5.4-mini (0.503 vs 0.364), and on Python (0.622 vs 0.485 Direct); PairCoder reaches 0.705, 8.3 points above MARS at 1.4× cost
Limitations: evaluation covers 165 CodeContests tasks, three backbones, two languages, one corpus; local gate rejects only same-turn public-test regressions and misses hidden tests
Abstract: source code available on GitHub (https://github.com/fckand/mars); Appendix A provides full prompt templates and Appendix C pseudocode for MARS and every baseline
llm_evaluation.rationale: A prompt-only multi-agent LLM system for competitive programming that directly matches high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents & tool use, code generation, RAG). The core contribution—topic-specialist agents grounded by per-specialist RAG over an algorithm-theory corpus, replacing generic planner/coder/debugger roles with a relay of specialists—is a genuine but incremental combination of established components (multi-agent code pipelines, execution feedback, retrieval). Rigor is solid but flawed: 165 CodeContests tasks only, ablations that the authors admit do not isolate specialization (generalists-no-RAG trails MARS by only 0.009, within one standard deviation, Table 3), inconsistent decoding settings across baselines (logged Direct/Single-RAG runs used top-p 1.0 vs MARS top-p 0.95, Section 3), and honest disclosure that CodeSIM (0.731) and PairCoder (0.705) still outperform MARS on pass rate, though at higher cost. Evidence strength benefits from detailed uncertainty estimates over 3 runs, per-tier breakdowns, relay decision statistics (Appendix D), and infrastructure-fixer analysis (Appendix E). Generalizability is limited to one benchmark, one corpus (cp-algorithms), Codeforces tags, and two languages (C++17, Python), though the Direct < Single-RAG < MARS ordering persists across three backbones. Reproducibility is aided by released code (GitHub link), full prompt templates (Appendix A), and pseudocode for all baselines (Appendix C).

primary_link.title: MARS: Multi-Specialist LLM Relay System for Competitive Programming

radar.summary: Large Language Models excel at code generation, yet competitive programming exposes a persistent failure mode: existing multi-agent pipelines distribute work over generic planner, coder, and debugger roles and delegate the choice of algorithmic technique to the backbone alone. We present MARS (Multi-Agent Relay of Specialized LLMs), a prompt-only framework in which each agent is a topic specialist---dynamic programming, graphs, strings, geometry, and so on---grounded by retrieval-augmented gener
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型雖擅長程式碼生成，但在競技程式設計上，現有多代理系統多半採用通用的規劃、編碼與除錯角色，把演算法選題完全交給骨幹模型。本文提出 MARS，一個純提示的多專家接力框架：每個代理都是單一演算法主題（如動態規劃、圖論、字串、幾何）的專家，並以 RAG 檢索 cp-algorithms 語料作為根據。系統先由各專家自我評估組成至多三人的小組，起始代理撰寫 C++17 初稿，之後每一步都在沙箱中對公開範例測試執行，由當前專家決定保留、修復或交接，最後由基礎設施修復器整理樣板程式碼。在 CodeContests 測試集上以 Gemma 4 為骨幹，MARS 達到 0.624±0.006 的通過率，較直接提示提升 14.4 個百分點，以 3.3 倍更低的時間成本逼近 CodeSIM 的 0.731，且每任務 token 花費變異更小；此優勢在 Qwen3.5-27B、GPT-5.4-mini 與 Python 上依然成立。消融實驗顯示移除 RAG 約損失 2 個百分點。限制包括僅評估 165 題與單一語料，且本地閘門只比較同輪草稿、無法涵蓋隱藏測試。本工作證明主題對齊的專業分工搭配逐步執行回饋，能以低成本取得可靠的解題表現。
radar.title: MARS: Multi-Specialist LLM Relay System for Competitive Programming
radar.title_zh: MARS：競技程式設計的多專家 LLM 接力系統

links.title: CyberFactory: Scaling Cyber Security Capabilities with Instances from the Wild

Sections 3.1-3.2 describe the instance pipelines but the document reports no counts of instances, trajectories, or QA samples; no error bars or seeds appear in Section 4
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM/agent methodology paper: agentic trajectory synthesis from CVEs, skill-guided teacher data generation, and SFT internalization on a 397B MoE base, touching high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents/tool use, code, training, long context). Novelty is moderate since key components are borrowed: the differential oracle and instances follow CyberGym/ARVO (Section 3.1), the compaction protocol is adopted from prior context-management work (Section 3.3), and skill elicitation echoes cited skill-program literature (Section 1). Rigor is decent—same scaffold/budget baselines (Section 4.3), compaction-threshold ablation (Table 2), and trajectory analysis (Tables 4-6)—but evaluation is confined to a single benchmark (CyberGym), the teacher skill comparison is explicitly not compute-matched (Section 5.2), and the paper concedes that patch generation and CyberQA lack equally rigorous evaluation (Section 6). Evidence strength is limited by absent dataset statistics (no instance or trajectory counts anywhere in Sections 3-4) and no variance or seed reporting for headline Pass@1 numbers (Table 1). Generalizability is capped by C/C++/CVE-specific pipeline and skill design. Reproducibility is supported by released pipeline/instances (HuggingFace and GitHub links in Abstract) and detailed training hyperparameters (Section 4.2), though full-parameter SFT on 256 GPUs is impractical for most labs and the model-weight release wording is ambiguous (footnote 2 emphasizes released instances).

primary_link.title: CyberFactory: Scaling Cyber Security Capabilities with Instances from the Wild

radar.summary: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance in coding capabilities, their potential in cybersecurity has drawn increasing research attention, with closed-source LLMs (e.g., Mythos) delivering advanced cybersecurity capabilities. However, existing open-source efforts remain limited: frontier open-weight models do not provide reproducible cybersecurity training solutions, open-source training solutions focus on isolated tasks and lack scalable agentic data, and scaling agentic rollouts req
radar.summary_zh: 隨著 LLM 編碼能力提升，其網路安全潛力受到重視，但開源社群缺乏可重現的訓練方案、可規模化的代理資料與足夠的領域先驗。本文提出 CyberFactory，一套統一的開源框架，串聯資料建構、軌跡合成與模型訓練，涵蓋概念驗證（PoC）生成、漏洞修補與網安問答三類任務。框架將 ARVO、OSS-Fuzz 與野外 CVE 等公開漏洞素材轉為可執行、可驗證的任務實例，採用差分判定：輸入必須在修補前版本觸發崩潰、在修補後版本不觸發。軌跡合成以可重複使用的漏洞分析技能引導教師模型進行原始碼檢視、領域先驗探索與證據驗證，並在上下文用量達 90% 時進行結構化壓縮。以這些代理式軌跡對 Qwen 3.5-397B 進行監督微調後的 OpenAegis，在一小時預算的 CyberGym 上達 58.1% Pass@1，較基礎模型提升 28.5 分，並在同一評測協定下超越更大的 GLM 5.2 與 Kimi K2.7。技能導引亦使教師 GLM 5.2 在僅四分之一時間內將成績由 43.3% 升至 46.5%，提升資料合成產量；軌跡分析顯示模型在推論時不需技能即可內化探索與驗證流程。限制包括評估受限於既有 CVE 素材與一小時預算，修補與問答任務的嚴謹評估尚待補齊。本工作為開源、可稽核的防禦性網安能力規模化提供完整配方。

links.title: WARP: Wasserstein-Aligned RAG for Population Opinions

evidence: Abstract: 'Across three review domains spanning 35K documents, 156 queries, and 26 entities, WARP's domain-matched variants reduce distributional error by at least 43% with sub-second latency.'
Section 4.1 / Table 1: W1 Minimizer 2.76 vs Top-k 13.03 on Yelp; EG + W1 Min reaches W1 1.52 with EM 99.2%; all re-rankers under 330ms latency.

Section 4.5 / Appendix E: independent-target validation against Yelp star ratings (Spearman rho=0.881, Pearson r=0.908), yielding worst-case W1 reduction >=44.4% against a target the LLM labeler never touched.
Appendix D: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across 57 paired Wilcoxon tests with 14/14 W1-family tests surviving, plus entity-clustered bootstrap (10,000 resamples) with all 95% CIs excluding zero.

Appendix G.1 / Table 2: 5-judge panel (Claude Sonnet 4, Llama 3.3 70B, Mistral Large 3, Nova Pro, DeepSeek v3.2) with position-swap control and directional kappa 0.61-1.00; W1 Minimizer Fair% 86% at k=5 vs Random 31%.

Limitations section: offline-only evaluation (no live user outcomes), P_pop is corpus-observed so corpus bias is not removed, pre-computed labels required, single ordinal axis with multi-issue extension unevaluated, and scale/temporal drift beyond 14K documents untested.

Appendix C.1: metric-isolation analysis showing KL(JS)-MMR's apparent advantage is an entity-match confound (1.7-2x more entity-matched docs); controlled Minimizer comparison flips to W1 winning on both Yelp (2.76 vs 3.00) and OpinRank (4.14 vs 4.54).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A RAG-methodology paper squarely within LLM-adjacent scope: post-retrieval re-ranking that calibrates evidence to a population opinion distribution via Wasserstein-1, with LLM-based labeling, generation, and a 5-judge LLM-as-judge panel. Relevance is strong (RAG, retrieval, LLM judging, opinion NLP) though the core contribution is a retrieval/selection algorithm rather than LLM modeling. Novelty is moderate: the paper itself situates WARP as instantiating a prior coverage objective (Agrawal et al., companion work) using W1 instead of W2, combining known calibrated-selection (Steck 2018, KL/PM-2) and OT-ranking (WassRank) traditions; the runtime ordinal W1 objective, deficit-aware pool expansion, and deployment decision matrix are incremental but genuine. Rigor is high: five baselines (Top-k, MMR, DPP, OpinionMMR, KL/JS Minimizer), FDR-corrected Wilcoxon tests, entity-clustered bootstrap, metric-isolation and entity-filter confound controls, Gaussian noise control, mislabel/Dirichlet robustness, hyperparameter sweeps, and an unusually careful circularity defense via independent Yelp star ratings. Evidence is detailed and mostly internally consistent (43-88% W1 reductions, sub-310ms p99 latency), though generation evidence rests on LLM judges with high tie rates (62-104/156 ties), results are criterion-dependent per the prompt ablation, and there are minor text/table mismatches (e.g., stated 73-88% range at k=10 vs MMR 70% in Table 20; abstract's 86% cites the best variant). Generalizability is capped: three product/service review domains, a single ordinal sentiment axis, pre-computed per-document labels required, scale beyond 14K docs and multi-issue opinion spaces untested, and P_pop is corpus-observed rather than a true population target. Reproducibility is partial: public datasets (Yelp, OpinRank), full prompts (App. A.3), pseudocode (App. B), and hardware/latency specs, but no code release and the Seller Forums corpus and labeling-LLM versions are only loosely specified.

primary_link.title: WARP: Wasserstein-Aligned RAG for Population Opinions

radar.summary: RAG systems are increasingly used to summarize what large collections of documents say. A user asks "What do people think about X?" and receives an answer that reads as consensus. But standard top-k retrieval ranks documents by query similarity, not by how faithfully they represent the population, so minority views quietly disappear. Existing fixes fall short. Diversity re-rankers like MMR and DPP spread retrieved documents apart, but with no target distribution to aim for. Calibration methods b
radar.summary_zh: RAG 系統常被用來彙整大量文件中的意見，但標準 top-k 檢索只依查詢相似度排序，會系統性放大多數派聲音，讓少數意見在摘要中消失。既有的多樣性重排方法（如 MMR、DPP）缺乏目標分布，而以 KL 或 JS 散度為基礎的校準方法又把意見箱視為無序，混淆極端正負面與相鄰箱的代價相同。本文提出 WARP，一類檢索後校準演算法，先透過感知缺口的候選池擴充（實體門檻式或自適應再檢索）找回被埋沒的意見，再以 Wasserstein-1 距離選出情感強度分布最貼近群體目標 P_pop 的文件集合，保留意見的序數結構。作者設計三種變體以因應不同情境：實體密集池用 W1 Minimizer、稀疏池用結合相關性的 W1-MMR、未知情境用免調參的 WassRank OT。在三個評論領域（Amazon 賣家論壇、Yelp、OpinRank）共 35K 文件、156 個查詢上，各變體至少降低 43% 的分布誤差，重排延遲低於 330 毫秒；五評審 LLM 小組在 k≤5 時有 86% 的裁決偏好 WARP 生成的答案。作者另以 Yelp 星等獨立驗證，排除標註循環偏誤。限制包括僅離線評估、P_pop 仍反映語料偏誤、只處理單一序數軸且未處理時間漂移。此方法不需微調或更換檢索器，即可在生產環境中呈現更忠實的群體意見比例。

links.title: EarthVerse: Benchmarking Scientific Agents Across Dynamic Earth Systems and Natural Hazards

evidence: Abstract: 'the best mean answer-unit accuracy is 84.65%, while the highest Strict@95 is only 34.81%' establishing the reliability-gap headline claim.

Section 5.1, Table 2: 25 systems under one package interface; Claude Fable 5 leads Core at 84.97, GPT-5.6 Sol leads Strict@95 at 34.81, with trajectory means (rounds, tokens) reported but excluded from scores.

Section 5.2, Table 4: relevant-file oracle +14.72 Core with 95% CI [+5.48, +24.69] and evidence-map oracle +11.34 with CI [+2.34, +21.25]; these are the only interventions whose intervals exclude zero, supporting the evidence-localization bottleneck claim.
Section 3.3: release contains 10,879 answer units; every task includes an expert solution, structured ground truth, a deterministic compute_gt.py program, and a task-specific process rubric.
Appendix A.2.3 (Table 6c): long bounded retention gains 13.66 Core over aggressive compression and 5.27 over full replay, supporting the selective scientific-memory finding.

Appendix B.4 Limitations: 'Process scores also rely on an LLM judge... cannot remove judge error. Future releases should measure agreement with domain experts'; controlled studies use paired subsets and several intervals include zero.

Appendix C.2: fixed execution limits (48 turns, 1,680 s research, 1,800 s overall), judge is a fixed gpt-4.1 endpoint, seed 2026, plus retained audit artifacts per Appendix C.5; abstract lists Hugging Face, GitHub, and Website release badges.

Section 5.3: GPT-5.5 EarthSE fill-in accuracy rises 20.29 to 61.90 and GeoMMBench 84.52 to 98.01 under answer-free structured adaptation, supporting the supplied-observation vs evidence-construction contrast.
Table 11: frontier evaluations cost more than $2,500 (Claude Fable 5 $3,271.57) versus under $45 for flash models, documenting cost as a reproduction constraint.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agent-evaluation benchmark (not a pure domain application): 405 tasks over 199 disaster packages require LLM agents to discover evidence, call tools, compute, and preserve provenance, evaluated across 25 model/agent systems with controlled studies on reasoning effort, tool routing, context retention, and answer-free oracles. Strong fit to Agents & Tool Use, LLM evaluation, and reasoning preferences, diluted by the Earth-hazards testbed. Novelty is incremental over DORA/BLADE/ScienceAgentBench, with the reliability gap metric (mean unit accuracy 84.65% vs Strict@95 34.81%) and claim-evidence-state framing as the main fresh angles. Rigor is solid: paired bootstrap CIs, release gates, ablations, and honest limitations, but process scoring depends on a single fixed LLM judge whose agreement with domain experts is explicitly deferred to future work, and most paired intervention CIs include zero. Evidence is detailed and internally consistent (leaderboard, oracle deltas, costs, traces). Generalizability is constrained by a domain-specific benchmark and controlled studies run mostly on GPT-5.5; reproducibility is supported by released prompts, configs, seeds, and manifests but is expensive and dependent on proprietary endpoints and judge availability.

primary_link.title: EarthVerse: Benchmarking Scientific Agents Across Dynamic Earth Systems and Natural Hazards

radar.summary: Earth-system analysis reconstructs changing physical processes from observations that differ in source, scale, timing, and modality. Natural hazards make this work consequential because incomplete evidence can change estimates of severity, exposure, and mechanism. We introduce EarthVerse, a benchmark that evaluates scientific agents through package-scoped investigations. Its 405 reproducible tasks are grounded in 199 documented events and 19 hazard families. Agents inspect heterogeneous event pa
radar.summary_zh: 地球科學分析需要從來源、尺度、時間與模態各異的觀測中重建動態過程，天然災害更使證據完整性直接影響災情與機制判斷。既有基準多在已給定的文章、圖表或影像上測驗，無法檢驗代理自行建構證據庫的能力。本文提出 EarthVerse，一個以套件為範圍的科學代理基準，包含 405 個可重現任務，以 199 起真實災害事件、19 個災害家族與 6,709 個本地檔案為根基；每個套件約 34 個檔案，解題平均需整合 7 個以上不同來源。任務附有可執行的真值程式與任務專屬評分規準，把答案拆解為細粒度答案單元，並以 Strict@95 衡量近乎完整的可靠完成度。在控制協定下評測 25 個模型與代理系統，最佳平均答案單元準確率為 84.65%，但最高 Strict@95 僅 34.81%，顯示代理能完成個別步驟卻難以維持橫跨證據、尺度、單位與物理解釋的一致鏈結。控制實驗指出：唯有在證據可編輯時推理才有幫助，互動式檢索搭配最終審查可將 Core 由 51.3 提升至 86.3；相關檔案定位是最明確的瓶頸，可帶來 14.7 分增益；評測一個前沿模型成本超過 2,500 美元。跨基準實驗顯示詮釋已給定觀測遠比建構證據庫容易。本基準為端到端科學可靠性提供了可重現的量測基礎。

links.title: SWE Refactor Bench: Can Coding Agents Complete a Long-Horizon, Whole-Repository Stack Migration?

evidence: Abstract: 'only 28 of 520 runs (5.4%) pass all three stages, 13 of the 20 tasks receive no accepted solution, and the best model (claude-opus-5) scores 47.0/100'

Section 2.1 'Why behavioural tests fail here': 'rate(R_A;T)=1 for any T—by construction... Setting R_S=R_A (the empty diff) therefore earns full marks on any behavioural suite' — formalizes the Blindness claim
Section 2.3 Scoring, Eq. (4): composite score defined as veto × all-or-nothing Stage II × (0.4 + 0.6·s/6) Stage III per-verifier factor
Section 3.4.1: 'Judge and human agree 89.7% of the time (140/156, κ=0.795)... of the 16 disagreements, 14 are the judge being too strict'

Section 3.3.2: 'Among the 340 runs that passed Stage I... 58% reach 99% and 36% reach 99.9%—but only 26% make no error at all' with concrete failure cases (fw03 hash routing 21768/21769, build03 wheel METADATA 380/381)

Section 3.4.3 Finding 1: 'the two held by claude-opus-5 are 55.7% and 53.4%, the other four between 21.6% and 26.1%... retire the two strongest and the remaining four would accept 46 submissions instead of 28'
Table 1 / Appendix C Table 10: 20 tasks, 130,118 fixed checks, 262 criteria, per-task versions, LoC, and time budgets listed
Section 1 (scoping limitation): 'these results establish a capability gap on the 20 tasks in SWE Refactor Bench; they do not rank the intrinsic difficulty of all migration projects'

Reproducibility gap: homepage URL given in metadata, but the paper text nowhere states code or task images will be publicly released; Stage I judge is gpt-5.6-sol (Section 3.4.1) and Stage III 'tests... vary across verifier runs' (Section 1)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to core preferences: an LLM coding-agent evaluation benchmark (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Code & Programming, Red Teaming & Evaluation). Novelty is solid: the identified 'Blindness' failure mode (Section 2.1 shows rate(R_A;T)=1 by construction for untouched repos) and the three-stage protocol with a Migration Audit veto plus Agentic Verification via executable counterexamples (Section 2.3, Eq. 4) are genuinely distinct from red-to-green suites like SWE-bench (Table 7). Rigor is strong: 520 runs over 8 models/26 configurations, an explicit scoring formula, funnel decomposition that is internally consistent (340/118/88/28, 30 blindness, 252 behavior-breaking), and a dedicated validity section including human-judge agreement (κ=0.795, Section 3.4.1) and family-bias controls (Section 3.4.3). Evidence is detailed (per-task Tables 9-10, concrete counterexample cases in 3.3.2/3.4.2, cost data in Table 3) but weakened by single-run-per-configuration sampling with no variance estimates and a small task set (20 tasks; platform and toolchain classes have only 3 tasks each, so category-difficulty claims rest on thin counts, acknowledged in Section 1). Generalizability is moderate: conclusions are scoped to these 20 tasks and the verifier panel is explicitly non-stationary ('retire the two strongest and the remaining four would accept 46 submissions instead of 28', Section 3.4.3). Reproducibility is partial: a homepage and a meticulous task catalogue with versions, licences, budgets and a construction procedure (Appendix A-C) are given, but no explicit code/data release statement appears in the text, and both the Stage I judge and verifiers rely on proprietary models with inherently variable Stage III output.

primary_link.title: SWE Refactor Bench: Can Coding Agents Complete a Long-Horizon, Whole-Repository Stack Migration?

top5.summary: Modern software systems accumulate technical debt over decades of development, which makes migration expensive and largely manual. As coding agents become increasingly capable at bug fixing, can they autonomously perform such migrations? Existing benchmarks cannot answer this question because they evaluate only behavioural correctness, not whether the migration actually occurred. This leads an easy hack: agents copy the original implementation to make tests pass. We call this Blindness. To address this problem, we introduce SWE Refactor Bench, a benchmark comprising 20 whole-repository migrations, covering 4 kinds of technical debt. A three-stage evaluation protocol measures both migration completeness and behavioural correctness. (1) Migration Audit verifies that the migration occurred. (2) Behavioural Tests measure correctness with a fixed test suite. (3) Agentic Verification uses 6 independent coding agents to generate targeted tests for hidden behavioural differences. Across 520 runs from 8 frontier models and 26 model-effort configurations, only 28 of 520 runs (5.4%) pass all three stages, 13 of the 20 tasks receive no accepted solution, and the best model (claude-opus-5) scores 47.0/100. Migration completeness and behavioural correctness are distinct abilities: a few runs preserve behaviour by skipping the migration and are stopped at Migration Audit; most attempt it and break behaviour, and are stopped at Behavioural Tests. Agents cannot deliver a perfect migration: among the 340 runs that pass Migration Audit, 58% reach 99% of the fixed checks, yet only 26% reach 100%. Agent capability differs across migration categories: agents score 31.4 on build toolchain rewrites but only 5.6 on language rewrites. Together, these findings position SWE Refactor Bench as a rigorous testbed for developing coding agents for reliable whole-repository migrations.
top5.summary_zh: 本論文探討編碼代理(coding agents)能否自主完成整個儲存庫的行為保持式技術堆疊遷移。現有基準僅以固定測試衡量行為正確性,但遷移任務起點的測試本就全數通過,代理照抄原實作也能拿滿分,作者稱此漏洞為 Blindness。為此團隊建立 SWE Refactor Bench:20 個取自真實開源基礎設施的整庫遷移任務(如 SQLite、zlib、GraphHopper),涵蓋語言、框架、平台與建置工具鏈四類技術債,並採三階段評測:遷移稽核以三取二多數決驗證遷移是否真的發生並握有否決權;行為測試要求 130,118 項固定檢查全數通過;代理驗證則由六個獨立編碼代理各花一小時搜尋差異,僅接受可執行的反例。在 8 個前沿模型、26 種組態共 520 次執行中,僅 28 次(5.4%)通過全部三階段,20 個任務有 13 個無人解出,最佳的 claude-opus-5 得分 47.0/100。「完成遷移」與「保持行為」是兩種不同能力:30 次執行跳過遷移卻保住行為,252 次完成遷移卻破壞行為;通過稽核的 340 次中僅 26% 全數通過固定檢查,而通過前兩階段的 88 個提交又有 60 個被驗證代理找出反例。類別間能力亦有差異:建置工具鏈改寫得分 31.4,語言改寫僅 5.6。限制上,結論僅針對這 20 個任務,不代表所有遷移專案的內在難度排序;評審與驗證代理的強度也會影響分數,且隨模型進步,同一任務集將被更嚴格評分。此基準為發展可靠的整庫遷移代理提供嚴謹的測試場域,並點出行為測試無法證明遷移確實發生的根本盲點。

links.title: Large language models simulate intersectional synthetic identities with a budget of one to two dimensions

evidence: Results, 'Two features: collapse, not combination': best single feature beats additive combination in 78.4% of pair cells for GPT-4o-mini (95% CI [77.8, 79.0], wave-cluster bootstrap), 75.3-81.2% across eight models including frontier GPT-5.5 (79.1%) and Claude Sonnet 5 (77.8%) on a two-wave subset (Table 1).

Methods, 'Noise floor and noise corrections': empirical split-half TV floors of 0.079/0.120/0.147 at depths 1/2/3, closed-form multinomial expectation certified within 0-4% down to n=20, and exact squared-distance decomposition for the 2.5x distinctiveness growth claim.

Methods, 'Human additivity contest and contest calibration': calibration endpoints measured rather than assumed (additive-truth 40.3%, collapse-truth 84.3%; depth-3 endpoints 67.2%/6.6%), with self-calibrated indices 0.83-0.95 and a noise-scaling sweep (0.5x unchanged at 0.86; 2x softens to 0.74).

Methods, 'Base-versus-tuned contrast': race deficit -10.8 points and religion -5.3 points present in Llama-3.1-8B base weights, with tuning shifts of +0.6 and -0.6 against minimum detectable effects of 5.9 and 2.7 points; Mistral-7B replicates.

Methods, 'Data/Code availability': all 21.1M simulated records and artifacts on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21267988) with regeneration script run_all_figures.sh on GitHub; snapshots pinned for flagship models, with GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet 5 queried via unversioned aliases flagged as reproducibility caveats that carry no load-bearing result.

Discussion: claims explicitly scoped to 'demographic-feature conditioning and the US English-language ATP context (2017-2021)' with portability elsewhere untested, tempering generalizability despite the eight-model, two-generation replication.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodological audit of LLM synthetic survey respondents demonstrating that demographic personas collapse to a one-to-two feature 'identity budget'. Directly in scope: the objects of study are eight LLMs, and the work engages persona prompting, chain-of-thought controls, bias/fairness, and evaluation methodology rather than being a pure domain application. Novelty is high: the compositional question at distribution level against real intersectional ground truth, the near-additivity-plus-growing-distinctiveness characterization, and the measured calibration-endpoint machinery appear genuinely new relative to the cited audits. Rigor is exceptional: human sampling-noise floors, null calibration (random-dimension cosine 0.84), per-model self-calibrated collapse indices, cluster/wild bootstrap, permutation nulls, minimum detectable effects for null contrasts, feature-order and framing controls, three elicitation paradigms, base-vs-tuned decomposition, and a memorization-confound analysis. Evidence is strong with CIs and cross-model replication (75.3-81.2% best-single win rates, Index_self 0.83-0.95), bounded by reliance on measured-noise endpoint modeling (sensitivity-swept) and two-wave coverage for frontier models. Generalizability is explicitly scoped to US English ATP closed-form items 2017-2021. Reproducibility is high: 21.1M records on Zenodo, code with seeds and run_all_figures.sh, pinned snapshots for load-bearing models with two unpinned aliases honestly flagged as non-load-bearing.

primary_link.title: Large language models simulate intersectional synthetic identities with a budget of one to two dimensions

top5.summary: Large language models are increasingly used as synthetic survey respondents, promising cheap access to rare intersectional populations. We test standard demographic-persona methods against every real intersectional subgroup across 15 waves of Pew's American Trends Panel -- 21 million simulated response distributions from eight models. In real respondents, subgroup opinion is approximately the additive sum of its single-identity components, yet grows 2.5x more distinctive as identities intersect.
top5.summary_zh: 本研究檢視大型語言模型（LLM）作為合成問卷受訪者時，能否真正整合多重人口身分。作者以Pew美國趨勢小組（ATP）15波調查的微資料建立真實交叉次群體基準，讓八個模型（GPT-4o-mini、GPT-5.5、Claude Sonnet 5與開放權重模型等）以一到三個特徵的身分設定模擬回答分布，共約2,100萬筆，並以「組成競賽」檢驗：用餘弦相似度判定模型的誤差向量較貼近兩單一特徵偏誤之和（加法）或單一特徵偏誤（塌縮），搭配以模型自身重複執行雜訊建立的校準端點、人類抽樣雜訊下限與分割樣本複製。結果顯示，真實次群體的方向近似加法，且隨身分交織更趨鮮明（平方距離增至2.5倍）；模型卻在75–82%的雙特徵細格中由最佳單一特徵勝出，塌縮指標達0.83–0.95，第三特徵幾乎無貢獻；保留哪個維度近乎盲目，並系統性捨棄真實意見最強驅動因素種族與宗教，族裔與宗教少數身分最易被丟棄；個別取樣、log-probability讀出與各種提示策略皆無法緩解。限制在於僅涵蓋美國英語封閉式題項（2017–2021）、未預先註冊、僅為行為層次描述而未探究表徵機制，且基礎與微調對比僅限開放權重模型。對欲以矽取樣（silicon sampling）廉價補足稀少交叉人口的應用而言，這是明確警示：準確度缺口主要來自單一特徵校準失準，塌縮則是結構性缺陷；作者建議以雜訊下限、零假校準及多層次回歸事後分層（MRP）為基準，並以實測群體差異進行校準。
top5.title: Large language models simulate intersectional synthetic identities with a budget of one to two dimensions
top5.title_zh: 大型語言模型模擬交叉合成身分時，僅有一至兩個維度的預算

links.title: Semantic Overlays: Mitigating Prompt Injection with Annotations Beyond Tokens and Steering Vectors

evidence: Abstract: SEP separation rises from 24.3% to 96.5% with utility unchanged, TensorTrust ASR falls 34.8% to 6.6%, all four PIArena families drop to 0% compliance, marked spans stay readable at 92.5% exact copy rate.
§7 Training: adapter is 50M parameters, base model untouched; training items share SEP's shape so SEP measures in-distribution generalization while TensorTrust and PIArena are zero-shot transfer.

Table 1 (§4): embedding-conditioned shared MLP reaches 99.5% exact span retrieval and 100% refusal-when-absent vs 63.3%/89.7% for a 604M per-overlay MLP, attributed to supervision sharing and state-conditioned writes.

Appendix I, Table I.1: replication on frozen Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct moves SEP 31.0%→96.2%, TensorTrust hijacking 68.9%→4.4%, all PIArena families to 0%, with hyperparameters unchanged and corpus re-derived per Appendix D.

Appendix E: red team of 222 adaptive black-box probes; no direct authority attacks succeeded, but trusted instructions that delegate to marked spans override the overlay, and no instruction hierarchy was trained.

Appendix F: documents SEP witness substring false positives (pen matches 'open'), a TensorTrust harness discarding 606 of 776 rows non-randomly, and substring scoring inflating extraction; main tables lead with the corrected rule and give published-rule numbers in parentheses.
Appendix G.1: three seeds at temperature 0.7 reproduce every SEP number within 0.4 points; run-to-run noise floor measured at ~2 points on a 300-item paired subset.
§8 and Appendix C: held-out instruction embeddings fail 0/120 by nearest-neighbor substitution (codes collapse to effective rank two), while held-out pointer concepts score 95%.

Reproducibility statement: code at github.com/JoshuaSP/semantic-overlays, corpus and adapter checkpoints on HuggingFace, ≈32 GPU-hours per overlay set, Appendix B gives full recipe and hyperparameters.

Appendix J: limitations include one base model at one scale, channel experiments not replicated, binary non-executable overlay, unmeasured agentic multi-turn settings, and unprofiled end-to-end serving latency.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology and safety paper, squarely in scope: a trained span-targeted residual-stream adapter on frozen LLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, Llama-3.1-8B) that defends against prompt injection, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, Agents security, Interpretability/steering). Novelty is a genuine but incremental advance over prior defenses: unlike ISE/ASIDE/AIR it keeps the base frozen, applies edits only at designated prefill spans across all layers, state-conditioned and multiplexed; position-targeted steering is explicitly named as future work by Rimsky et al. Rigor is above average: four architectures compared on identical data (Table 1), loss ablation (CE vs KL vs hybrid, 93.5/88.5/79.6), Muon multiplier sweep, payload screening, mechanical target validation, a 222-probe adaptive red team, and honest reporting of failure modes (haiku 18% compliance; delegation attacks succeed; novel descriptors fail 0/120). Evidence is strong and specific (SEP 24.3→96.5 with utility ~unchanged on 9,160 items; TensorTrust 34.8→6.6 on all 776 rows; PIArena four families to 0%; replication on a second model family; seeded reruns within 0.4 points), and the authors surface defects in the very benchmarks they use, reporting both corrected and published-rule numbers. Generalizability is capped by single-scale testing (8-9B), channel experiments (§4-6) not replicated across families, single training runs outside the injection benchmarks, binary overlay only, and unmeasured multi-turn/agentic settings. Reproducibility is excellent: full pipeline code, corpus, and adapter checkpoints released, ~32 GPU-hours per set, recipes and harness deviations documented. Self-reported results and reliance on a small LLM judge for some scoring keep it short of the top band.

primary_link.title: Semantic Overlays: Mitigating Prompt Injection with Annotations Beyond Tokens and Steering Vectors

top5.summary: Everything a language model sees is tokens. The serving stack knows what each span is -- user input, tool output, instructions -- but the model must keep track of that itself, and it can lose track or be confused: text can be written to read like anything. Prompt injection is a natural exploit of this phenomenon. By scrambling the model's understanding of span identity, an attacker can induce unwanted and potentially dangerous actions. Adding a non-textual channel to the model's input -- a way t
top5.summary_zh: 語言模型的輸入全是token:部署端雖然知道每段文字來自使用者、擷取文件或工具,卻只能以可偽造的文字傳達這項資訊,提示注入攻擊正由此而生。本文提出Semantic Overlays:在凍結模型的殘差流上,於指定prefill位置套用小型學習式adapter,以頻外方式為跨度加上標記;標記是激活編輯而非文字,任何輸入皆無法模仿,基底模型完全未被修改,可依請求開關,其中以嵌入條件化的共享MLP效果最佳。實驗顯示:模型能讀回堆疊的視覺標記(99.5%精確跨度召回,缺席時100%正確拒答);標記能覆寫模型對內容的認知,例如宣稱片段是Python時,模型會忠實地以Python重寫該程式(97%);標記也能攜帶僅作用於該跨度的指令。將一個「勿執行」標記套用於不受信任內容即成提示注入防禦:SEP分離度自24.3%升至96.5%而效用不變(作者並發現且修正SEP評分器缺失),TensorTrust劫持成功率由34.8%降至6.6%,PIArena四類攻擊全數歸零,被標記內容仍可92.5%逐字引用;防禦亦在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上重現,紅隊222次自適應探測中直接權限攻擊皆未得手。限制:僅驗證單一規模、可信任指令委派至標記跨度時行為不一致、對最佳化式攻擊未經檢驗、未訓練的指令嵌入無法零樣本泛化,且假設部署端本身未被入侵。此法顯示頻外詮釋資料通道能兼顧安全與可用性,為不動權重的指令層級防護開創新路徑。
top5.title: Semantic Overlays: Mitigating Prompt Injection with Annotations Beyond Tokens and Steering Vectors
top5.title_zh: Semantic Overlays:以超越Token與引導向量的標註緩解提示注入攻擊

links.title: What Does Activation Steering Control? Attribution Across Answer Encodings and Output-Sensitive Subspaces

evidence: Abstract and Table 1: across all five A/B/C remappings on NormBank strict split, extraction-index effects (3.00-4.13) exceed semantic-label effects (up to 2.18), with advantage 1.95-4.04 and 93.8-97.6% positive pairs
Section 5.1/Table 17-18: norm-matched layer sweep shows extraction-index advantage rises from -0.061 at 50% depth to +0.236 at 75% and +0.208 at 87.5%, with paired depth contrasts excluding zero

Section 5.1/Table 22-24: validation-selected identifier-readout subspace contains 15.4% of CAA squared L2 energy yet retains 96.3% [95.8, 96.7] of the extraction-index effect; residual (84.6% energy) retains 1.0%; per-model retention 93.3-103.5%

Appendix C.1/Table 28: ITI-style replication across three retained models shows positive extraction-index advantage (5.63-9.33) under all five alternative mappings; wrong-sign control exceeded by 14.13 [14.09, 14.17]

Section 5.2/Table 3 and Appendix D: open-ended verdicts diverge from MCQ (refusal MCQ +3.28 vs open -0.13; sycophancy MCQ -0.48 vs open +1.11), with judge panel validated on 180 blinded human-scored responses (Pearson .927, QWK .929)

Section 4 and Appendix A: locked interventions (zero-based blocks 20/23/23/31, alpha=0.8), strict group-disjoint splits with zero cross-split overlap (Table 7), five seeded Gaussian controls, and group-cluster bootstrap with Holm correction (Appendix E.3)

Section 7 Limitations: audit covers only three three-label tasks and four instruction-tuned model families; factorial audit, localization, and ITI confined to NormBank; gradient subspace functionally localizes without identifying a complete circuit
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM interpretability/evaluation methodology paper: it audits what CAA/ITI activation steering actually controls by freezing interventions and counterfactually re-encoding MCQ answers, separating semantic-label, extraction-index, and extraction-row following, and localizing the effect to a low-rank output-sensitive subspace. Preference relevance is high (LLMs, interpretability, safety behaviors like hallucination/refusal/sycophancy, evaluation methodology). Novelty is solid: applying verbalizer/selector-remapping logic to attribute steering-induced changes is a genuinely new evaluation framework, though it builds on known MCQ-selection-bias work. Rigor is exceptional: 108-condition factorial audits, L2- and covariance-matched random controls, competence gating, wrong-sign controls, norm-matched layer sweeps, position controls, prespecified positive-gain criteria, cluster bootstrap with Holm correction, and blinded human validation of LLM judges (r=.927). Evidence is strong and quantified with tight CIs (Table 1: 3.00-4.13 extraction-index effects; Table 22: 15.4% energy retaining 96.3% of effect), and limitations are honestly scoped to three three-label tasks and four model families. Generalizability is decent but the paper itself documents reversals (Qwen, SC101), tempering universal claims. Reproducibility is aided by exact templates, locked hyperparameters, seeds, and split audits, though no explicit repository URL is stated. Score ~0.86.

primary_link.title: What Does Activation Steering Control? Attribution Across Answer Encodings and Output-Sensitive Subspaces

top5.summary: Activation steering is often evaluated under the answer encoding used to construct the direction. A reported gain may reflect the intended judgment or compatibility with answer identifiers seen during construction. We introduce Cross-Encoding Steering Evaluation, which freezes an intervention while re-encoding answers to the same held-out items. On NormBank, after A/B/C identifiers are reassigned, contrastive activation addition (CAA) induces larger target-versus-source score changes for the ext
top5.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討激活導引(activation steering)的根本證據問題:當對比激活加入(CAA)等介入手法在特定答案編碼下提升分數時,它究竟控制了什麼?作者提出「跨編碼導引評估」,在凍結介入方向的前提下,對同一批保留測試項目重新編碼答案(改變標籤對應、識別碼詞彙與列序),藉此區分語意標籤追隨、抽取索引追隨(extraction-index following)與抽取列追隨三種可能。在 NormBank 上,重新指派 A/B/C 後,CAA 對抽取索引的目標分數變化大於對語意標籤者;因子式審計(6 種語意映射、3 種識別碼詞彙、6 種列序,共 108 條件)證實效果追隨索引而非顯示列位置。經範數匹配後,此效果主要在較深層(75% 與 87.5% 深度)出現;一個僅佔方向平方範數 15.4% 的低秩輸出敏感子空間,卻保留了 96.3% 的效果,顯示高度集中。ITI 式方法在 NormBank 的三個模型重現同樣排序;MNLI 整體偏向抽取索引追隨(唯 Qwen 反轉),SC101 則偏向語意標籤追隨,顯示歸因隨模型與任務而異。開放式生成測試亦顯示選擇題分數與生成行為可能得出不同結論:幻覺在兩種評估皆為正,拒答僅在選擇題有增益,諂媚僅在開放式評估有增益。限制包括僅涵蓋三個三標籤任務與四個模型系列,子空間分析屬功能性定位而未找出完整電路。其重要性在於:單一答案編碼下的導引增益無法證明語意控制,導引主張須有與所宣稱控制層級相符的證據。

links.title: Unlearning Is Not Just Erasing: Temporal Decoupling via Generation Inequality

evidence: Abstract: 'ADU achieves the strongest aggregate performance among evaluated baselines on the TOFU and WMDP benchmarks, including a Forget Quality of 0.93 on TOFU. It preserves 87–98% of model utility (92.9% on average versus 81.9% for baselines)'
Table 1: On Llama3.1-8B-Instruct, ADU Bio 27.32 / Cyber 27.97 vs Base 71.86 / 45.37, with MMLU 62.84 and GSM8K 58.82 retained; best or near-best across seven baselines

Table 5 (Discussions, Path-specific causal validation): 'Base − Selected C̃e' lowers WMDP Avg from 58.62 to 36.37 vs 57.09 for cardinality-matched random edges; 'ADU ← Base selected' restores 27.65 to 47.23 vs 28.82 for matched-random replacement, with MMLU shifts of only -0.58/+0.53

Table 4 (Component ablation): removing pathway loss raises WMDP Avg to 47.79 (vs 27.65); removing retain objective drops MMLU to 56.32 and GSM8K to 52.10; random heads degrade both forgetting and retention

Robustness Analysis (Fig. 5): six attacks grouped into prompt scaffolding (few-shot, masking, role-play CoT) and adaptive recovery (anchor shift, multi-turn probing, repeated sampling); ADU has the smallest increase and lowest final accuracy under adaptive recovery

Method section: LoRA adapters update W_Q, W_K, W_V, W_O in layers containing selected global heads; head partition computed once with ρ=0.3 and fixed; defaults q=0.4, α=0.3 from Fig. 4 sensitivity analysis
Contributions item 3 states evaluations on 'WMDP, TOFU, and MUSE-Books' while the Experiments section and Table 3 use 'MUSE-Harry Potter' with Llama2-7B — an internal naming inconsistency

Metrics section: fluency 'evaluated by GPT-4o on a 1 to 5 scale' (single-judge, no inter-annotator check reported in provided text); no code-release or artifact-availability statement appears anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM research with strong preference fit: parameter-level unlearning for LLMs (Llama3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-14B, Llama2-7B) intersecting AI safety/privacy (WMDP hazardous-knowledge removal, GDPR motivation), interpretability-style analysis (local/global attention head partition, bidirectional activation exchange for causal mediation), and evaluation robustness. Not a pure domain application, so in scope. Novelty is solid but not maximal: attention-based unlearning exists (ASU suppresses attention to salient tokens), and the contribution is the shift from static token salience to context-specific preplan-anchor retrieval pathways plus a temporal 'generation inequality' characterization. Rigor is good: three benchmarks, seven baselines across three method families, component ablations (Table 4), hyperparameter sensitivity (Fig. 4), and six-attack robustness analysis. Evidence is strengthened by controlled causal interventions (Table 5: Base minus selected edges drops WMDP Avg 58.62→36.37 vs 57.09 matched-random; ADU restored to 47.23 vs 28.82 random), but weakened by conditional theory resting on unverified directional-alignment assumptions, single-judge GPT-4o fluency, an unverified seed-stability claim deferred to Appendix D.4, and an internal inconsistency (contributions/conclusion say 'MUSE-Books' while experiments use MUSE-Harry Potter). Generalizability is moderate: two model families and three task types, but the method presupposes the extended context-rich retrieval regime the authors themselves flag, and requires retain sets and calibration splits. Reproducibility is middling: hyperparameters (ρ=0.3, q=0.4, α=0.3) and appendices A–F are specified, but no code or artifact availability is claimed in the provided text.

primary_link.title: Unlearning Is Not Just Erasing: Temporal Decoupling via Generation Inequality

top5.summary: Large language models (LLMs) require effective unlearning to address privacy regulations and safety concerns. However, achieving precise forgetting without compromising general utility remains challenging. Existing sequence- and token-level methods penalize target outputs without modeling their context-dependent retrieval paths, which can disrupt linguistic structure or suppress benign knowledge. We present ADU, a fine-grained, training-based framework that shifts unlearning from token erasure t
top5.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討大型語言模型(LLM)的機器遺忘(unlearning)問題:模型須依 GDPR 等規範遺忘敏感或私人內容,同時保留一般能力。既有序列級與 token 級方法只懲罰可見輸出,未建模情境相依的內部檢索路徑,容易破壞語言結構,或在無害情境造成過度遺忘。作者提出「生成不平等」概念:局部注意力頭維持短程依賴,全域注意力頭則在語義轉折的前規劃位置回溯檢索遠處持續被關注的錨點。據此提出 ADU 框架:先在原始模型上定位前規劃—錨點路徑並固定,再訓練注意力投影 adapter 抑制這些路徑的注意力質量,並以保留集語言建模與局部注意力保存損失約束副作用;訓練後以雙向激活交換驗證所選路徑的因果中介角色。實驗顯示,ADU 在 WMDP 上將 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 的 Bio/Cyber 準確率降至 27.32/27.97,MMLU 與 GSM8K 保留 62.84/58.82;TOFU 遺忘品質達 0.93,平均保留 92.9% 效用(基線 81.9%);MUSE 上 ROUGE-L 最低;面對提示框架與適應性恢復等攻擊仍維持最低敏感準確率。消融實驗證實路徑損失與保留損失缺一不可。限制在於路徑識別依賴注意力且僅在原始模型計算一次,錨點自動建構與殘留知識防護仍待改進。此研究將遺忘從擦除 token 轉為抑制情境化檢索路徑,對隱私合規與安全部署深具意義。
top5.title: Unlearning Is Not Just Erasing: Temporal Decoupling via Generation Inequality
top5.title_zh: 機器遺忘不只是擦除:以生成不平等達成時間解耦
